Bava Metzia 71a:3-71b:3: Ikka dematne la leha derav huna aha detane rav yosef: "im kesef talve et ammi et heani immach". ammi vegoy – ammi kodem, ani veashir – ani kodem. "aniyyecha vaaniyye irecha" – aniyyecha kodmin, aniyye irecha vaaniyye ir acheret – aniyye irecha kodmin.
Amar mar: ammi vegoy ammi kodem, peshita! amar rav nachman amar li huna: la nitzrecha, daafillu legoy beribbit uleyisrael bechinnam.

Tanya, amar rabbi yose: bo uree samyut enehem shel malve beribbit. adam kore lachavero "rasha" – yored immo lechayyav. vehem meviin edim velavlar vekulemos udeyo, vechotvin vechotmin: peloni ze kafar belohe yisrael.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol mi sheyyesh lo maot umalve otam shello beribbit, alav hakkatuv omer "kaspo lo natan beneshech veshochad al naki lo lakach ose elle lo yimmot leolam". ha lamadta shekkol hammalve beribbit nechasav mitmottin. veha ka chazenan dela mozfi beribbit veka mitmottin! amar rabbi elazar: hallalu mitmottin veolin, vehallalu mitmottin veenan olin.
"Lamma tabbit bogdim tacharish kevalla rasha tzaddik mimmennu". amar rav huna: tzaddik mimmennu – bolea, tzaddik gamur – eno bolea.
Tanya, rabbi omer: ger tzedek haamur leinyan mechira, veger toshav haamur leinyan ribbit, eni yodea ma hu.
Ger tzedek haamur leinyan mechira, dichtiv: "vechi yamuch achicha immach venimkar lach". velo lecha, ella leger, shenneemar: "leger".
Velo leger tzedek ella leger toshav, shenneemar: "leger toshav". "mishpachat ger" – ze haggoy. keshehu omer "o leeker" – ze hannimkar laavoda zara atzmah.
Amar mar: velo lecha ella leger, shenneemar: "leger", lememra deger kane eved ivri? vrminhi: en hagger nikne beeved ivri, veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri.
Ger lo nikne beeved ivri: "veshav el mishpachto" baenan, veha lekka. veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri: ishsha – lav orach ara. ger name gemiri: demikkene – kane, dela mikkene – la kane.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: eno kone vedino keyisrael, aval kone vedino kegoy.
Detanya: hannirtza vehannimkar legoy eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat.

Amar mar: veen ishsha veger konin eved ivri. nema dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel? detanya: ishsha kona et hashshefachot, veenah kona et haavadim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af kona et haavadim! afillu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel, vela kashya: kan – beeved ivri, kan – beeved kenaani.
Eved ivri tzenia la, eved kenaani peritz la.

Ella ha detane rav yosef: armalta la terabbe kalba, vela tashre bar be rav beushepiza. bishlama bar be rav tzenia la, ella kalba, kevan dimsarech ba miratteta! amri: kevan dechi shadya leh umetza mesarech batra, amri inashe: mishshum umetza deshadya leh hu dimsarech.

Ger toshav haamur leinyan ribbit may hi, dichtiv: "vechi yamuch achicha umata yado immach vehechezakta bo ger vetoshav vachay immach. al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit veyareta meelohecha veche achicha immach". ureminhi: lovin mehen umalvin otan beribbit, vechen beger toshav!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mi ketiv "al tikkach meittam"? "meitto" ketiv, miyyisrael.
Tanu rabbanan: "al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit" – aval atta naase lo arev.
Arev leman? ilema arev leyisrael, veha tana: ellu ovrin belo taase hammalve vehallove, hearev vehaedim!
Ella legoy vechevan dedineh degoy deazel batar arva, ihu nihu deka shakel minneh ribbita!
Amar rav sheshet: shekkibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael. i kibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael – ribbit name la lishkol! amar rav sheshet: shekkibbel alav lazo, velo kibbel alav lazo.
Berakhot 8a:16-28: Amar leh rava lerafram bar pappa: lema lan mar mehane mille mealleyayta deamrat mishshemeh derav chisda bemille deve chenishta.
Amar leh, hachi amar rav chisda: may dichtiv, "ohev Adonai shaare tziyyon mikkol mishkenot yaakov": ohev Adonai shearim hametzuyyaynim bahalacha, yoter mibbatte chenesiyyot umibbatte midrashot.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu beolamo ella arba ammot shel halacha bilvad.

Veamar abbaye: meresh hava garesna bego beta umetzallena beve chenishta. kevan dishmana leha deamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla — miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu beolamo ella arba ammot shel halacha bilvad — la hava metzallena ella hecha degaresna.
Rabbi amme verabbi assi af al gav dahavo lehu telesar be chenishta bitverya la metzallu ella bene ammude, hecha dahavo garsi.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: gadol hannehene migio yoter miyyere shamayim, deillu gabbe yere shamayim ketiv "ashre ish yare et Adonai", veillu gabbe nehena migio ketiv: "yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach". "ashrecha" — baolam hazze, "vetov lach" — laolam habba, ulegabbe yere shamayim, "vetov lach" la ketiv beh.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: leolam yadur adam bimkom rabbo, shekkol zeman sheshshimi ben gera kayyaym, lo nasa shelomo et bat paro.
La kashya, ha dichyif leh, ha dela keyif leh.
Amar rav huna bar yehuda, amar rabbi menachem, amar rabbi amme: may dichtiv, "veozve Adonai yichlu" — ze hammanniach sefer tora veyotze.
Rabbi avahu nafek ben gavra legavra.
Bae rav pappa: ben pesuka lifsuka mahu?
Isaiah 6:1-6: Bishnat-mot hammelech uzziyyahu vaere et-adonay yoshev al-kisse ram venissa veshulav meleim et-hahechol
Serafim omdim ׀ mimmaal lo shesh kenafayim shesh kenafayim leechad bishtayim ׀ yechasse fanav uvishtayim yechasse raglav uvishtayim yeofef

Vayyanuu ammot hassippim mikkol hakkore vehabbayit yimmale ashan
Vaomar oy-li chi-nidmeti ki ish teme-sefatayim anochi uvetoch am-teme sefatayim anochi yoshev ki et-hammelech Adonai tzevaot rau enay
Vayyaof elay echad min-hasserafim uveyado ritzpa bemelkachayim lakach meal hammizbeach
Isaiah 6:11-7:2: Vaomar ad-matay adonay vayyomer ad asher im-shau arim meen yoshev uvattim meen adam vehaadama tishshae shemama
Verichak Adonai et-haadam verabba haazuva bekerev haaretz
Veod bah asiriyya veshava vehayta levaer kaela vechaallon asher beshallechet matztzevet bam zera kodesh matztzavtah {p}
Vayhi bime achaz ben-yotam ben-uzziyyahu melech yehuda ala retzin melech-aram ufekach ben-remalyahu melech-yisrael yerushala͏m lammilchama aleha velo yachol lehillachem aleha
Vayyuggad levet david lemor nacha aram al-efrayim vayyana levavo ulevav ammo kenoa atze-yaar mippene-ruach {s}
Isaiah 6:7-10: Vayyagga al-pi vayyomer hinne naga ze al-sefatecha vesar avonecha vechattatcha techuppar
Vaeshma et-kol adonay omer et-mi eshlach umi yelech-lanu vaomar hinni shelacheni
Vayyomer lech veamarta laam hazze shimu shamoa veal-tavinu ureu rao veal-tedau
Hashemen lev-haam hazze veoznav hachebed veenav hasha pen-yire veenav uveoznav yishma ulevavo yavin vashav verafa lo
Isaiah 7:3-8: Vayyomer Adonai el-yeshayahu tze-na likrat achaz atta ushear yashuv benecha el-ketze tealat habberecha haelyona el-mesillat sede choves
Veamarta elav hishshamer vehasheket al-tira ulevavcha al-yerach mishshene zanvot haudim haashenim haelle bochori-af retzin vaaram uven-remalyahu
Yaan ki-yaatz alecha aram raa efrayim uven-remalyahu lemor
Naale vihuda unekitzenna venavkienna elenu venamlich melech betochah et ben-taval {p}
Ko amar adonay Adonai lo takum velo tihye
Ki rosh aram dammesek verosh dammesek retzin uveod shishshim vechamesh shana yechat efrayim meam
Isaiah 7:9-13: Verosh efrayim shomron verosh shomron ben-remalyahu im lo taaminu ki lo teamenu {p}
Sheal-lecha ot meim Adonai elohecha haemek sheala o hagebeah lemala
Vayyomer shimu-na bet david hameat mikkem haleot anashim ki talu gam et-elohay
Ketubot 5a:11-5b:2: Darash bar kappara: gedolim maase tzaddikim yoter mimmaase shamayim vaaretz, deillu bemaase shamayim vaaretz ketiv: "af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim", veillu bemaase yedehem shel tzaddikim ketiv: "machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai mikkedash adonay konnu yadecha".

Heshiv bavli echad, verabbi chiyyay shemo: "veyabbeshet yadav yatzaru"! "yado" ketiv. vehachtiv "yatzaru"! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: yatzru etzbeotav, kedichtiv: "ki ere shamecha maase etzbeotecha yareach vechochavim asher konanta".
Metivi: "hashshamayim mesapperim kevod el umaase yadav maggid harakia"! hachi kaamar: maase yedehem shel tzaddikim mi maggid — harakia, umay nihu — matar.
Darash bar kappara, may dichtiv: "veyated tihye lecha al azenecha". al tikre "azenecha", ella "al oznecha" — sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun,

Yanniach etzbao beoznav. vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar: mippene ma etzbeotav shel adam domot litedot? may tama? illema mishshum dimchallekan, kol chada vachada lemilletay avida. deamar mar: zo zeret. zo kemitza. zo amma. zo etzba. ze gudal.

Ella: ma taam meshuppot kitedot — sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun, yanniach etzbeotav beoznav. tana deve rabbi yishmael: mippene ma ozen kullah kasha vehaalya rakka? sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun, yachof alya letochah. tanu rabbanan: al yashmia adam leoznav devarim betelim, mippene shehen nichvot techilla leevarim.
Menachot 35b:9-36a:6: Amar rav yehuda: kesher shel tefillin tzarich sheyyehe lemala, kede sheyyehu yisrael lemala velo lematta, vetzarich sheyyehe kelappe panim, kede sheyyehu yisrael lefanim velo leachor.

Amar rav shemuel bar bedare amar rav, veamri la amar rabbi acha aricha amar rav huna, veamri la amar rav menashsheya amar shemuel: tefillin meematay mevarech alehen? mishsheat hannachatan. ini? veha amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hammitzvot kullan mevarech alehen over laasiyyaytan! abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mishsheat hannacha vead sheat keshira.
Amar rav chisda: sach ben tefilla litfilla chozer umevarech.

Sach – in, lo sach – la? veha shelach rav chiyyay bereh derav huna mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: al tefilla shel yad omer "baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehanniach tefillin", al tefillin shel rosh omer "baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat tefillin".
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: lo sach – mevarech achat, sach – mevarech shetayim.
Tana: sach ben tefilla litfilla – avera hi beyado, vechozer aleha meerche hammilchama.

Tana: keshehu manniach – manniach shel yad, veachar kach manniach shel rosh, ucheshehu choletz – choletz shel rosh, veachar kach choletz shel yad. bishlama keshehu manniach – manniach shel yad veachar kach manniach shel rosh, dichtiv: "ukeshartam leot al yadecha", vahadar "vehayu letotafot ben enecha".
Ella keshehu choletz, choletz shel rosh veachar kach choletz shel yad, menalan? amar rabba: rav huna asbera li, amar kera: "vehayu letotafot ben enecha", kol zeman shebben enecha yehu shetayim.
Mishnah Gittin 3:7-4:2:
Hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi veet heani lihyot mafrish alehen mechelkan, mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin, veeno choshesh shemma met hakkohen o hallevi o heeshir heani. metu, tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshin. im hilvan bifne vet din, eno tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshim: 
Hammanniach perot lihyot mafrish alehen teruma umaasrot, maot lihyot mafrish alehen maaser sheni, mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin. im avdu, hare ze choshesh meet leet, divre rabbi elazar ben shammua. rabbi yehuda omer, bishlosha ferakim bodkin et hayyayin, bekadim shel motzae hechag, uvehotzaat semadar, uvishat kenisat mayim babboser: 
Hashsholeach get leishto vehiggia bashshaliach, o sheshshalach acharav shaliach veamar lo, get shennatatti lecha batel hu, hare ze vatel. kadam etzel ishto o sheshshalach etzlah shaliach veamar lah, get sheshshalachti lich batel hu, hare ze vatel. im mishshehiggia get leyadah, shuv eno yachol levattelo: 
Barishona haya ose vet din bemakom acher umevattelo. hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shello yehu osin ken, mippene tikkun haolam. barishona haya meshanne shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah. vehitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyyehe chotev, ish peloni vechol shem sheyyesh lo, ishsha felonit vechol shum sheyyesh lah, mippene tikkun haolam:
Mishnah Gittin 4:3-6:
En almana nifraat minnichse yetomim ella vishvua. nimneu millehashbiah, hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shettehe noderet laytomim kol ma sheyyirtzu, vegova chetubbatah. haedim chotmin al hagget, mippene tikkun haolam. hillel hitkin perozbul mippenne tikkun haolam: 
Eved shennishba ufedauhu, im leshum eved, yishtabed. im leshum ben chorin, lo yishtabed. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ben kach uven kach yishtabed. eved sheasao rabbo appotiki laacherim veshichrero, shurat haddin, en haeved chayyav kelum. ella mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ven chorin, vechotev shetar al damav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, eno chotev ella meshachrer: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ven chorin, oved et rabbo yom echad veet atzmo yom echad, divre vet hillel. amru lahem bet shammay, tikkantem et rabbo, veet atzmo lo tikkantem. lissa shifcha i efshar, shekkevar chetzyo ven chorin. bat chorin i efshar, shekkevar chetzyo aved. yibbatel, vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya velirviyya, shenneemar (yeshaya ma) lo tohu veraah, lashevet yetzarah. ella mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ven chorin, vechotev shetar al chatzi damav. vechazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay: 
Hammocher avdo legoy o lechutza laaretz, yatza ven chorin. en podin et hashshevuyim yoter al kede demehen, mippene tikkun haolam. veen mavrichin et hashshevuyin, mippene tikkun haolam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, mippene takkanat hashshevuyin. veen lokchim sefarim, tefillin umezuzot min haggoyim yoter al kede demehen, mippene tikkun haolam:
Mishnah Gittin 4:7-5:2:
Hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra, lo yachazir. mishshum neder, lo yachazir. rabbi yehuda omer, kol neder sheyyadu vo rabbim, lo yachazir. veshello yadu vo rabbim, yachazir. rabbi meir omer, kol neder shetztzarich chakirat chacham, lo yachazir. vesheeno tzarich chakirat chacham, yachazir. amar rabbi eliezer, lo asru ze ella mippene ze. amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda, maase vetzaydan beechad sheamar leishto, konam im eni megarshech, vegershah. vehittiru lo chachamim sheyyachazirenna, mippene tikkun haolam: 
Hammotzi et ishto mishshum aylonit, rabbi yehuda omer, lo yachazir. vachachamim omrim, yachazir. nisset leacher vehayu lah banim hemennu, vehi tovaat ketubbatah, amar rabbi yehuda, omrim lah, shetikutich yafa lich middibburich: 
Hammocher et atzmo veet banav legoy, en podin oto, aval podin et habbanim leachar mitat avihen. hammocher sadehu legoy vechazar ulekachah mimmennu yisrael, hallokeach mevi mimmennu vikkurim, mippene tikkun haolam: 
Hannizzakin shamin lahem beiddit uvaal chov bevenonit, uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit. rabbi meir omer, af ketubbat ishsha bevenonit: 
En nifrain minnechasim meshubadim bimkom sheyyesh nechasim bene chorin, vaafillu hen zibburit. en nifrain minnichse yetomim, ella min hazzibburit:
Mishnah Gittin 5:3-6:
En motziin laachilat perot uleshevach karkaot velimzon haishsha vehabbanot minnechasim meshubadim, mippene tikkun haolam. vehammotze metzia, lo yishshava, mippene tikkun haolam: 
Yetomim shessamchu etzel baal habbayit o shemminna lahen avihen appotroppos, chayyav leasser perotehen. appotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim, yishshavea. minnahu vet din, lo yishshavea. abba shaul omer, chilluf haddevarim. hametamme vehamedammea vehamenassech beshogeg, patur. bemezid, chayyav. hakkohanim sheppiggelu vammikdash mezidin, chayyavin: 
Heid rabbi yochanan ben gudgeda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha, shehi yotza veget. veal ketanna vat yisrael shennisset lechohen, sheochelet batteruma, veim meta, balah yorshah. veal hammarish haggazul shebbenao vabbira, sheyyittol et damav, mippene takkanat hashshavim. veal chattat haggezula shello noda larabbim, shehi mechapperet, mippene tikkun hammizbeach: 
Lo haya sikarikon bihuda vaharuge milchama. meharuge milchama veelach, yesh bah sikarikon. ketzad. lakach missikarikon vechazar velakach mibbaal habbayit, mikkacho vatel. mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach missikarikon, mikkacho kayyam. lakach min haish vechazar velakach min haishsha, mikkacho vatel. min haishsha vechazar velakach min haish, mikkacho kayyam. zo mishna rishona. bet din shel acharehem amru, hallokeach missikarikon noten labbealim revia. ematay, bizman sheen beyadan likkach. aval yesh beyadan likkach, hen kodmin lechol adam. rabbi hoshiv bet din venimnu, sheim shahata vifne sikarikon shenem asar chodesh, kol hakkodem likkach, zoche, aval noten labbealim revia:
Mishnah Gittin 5:7-6:1:
Cheresh romez venirmaz. uven betera omer, kofetz venikpatz, bemittaltelin. happaotot, mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar, bemittaltelin: 
Veellu devarim amru mippene darche shalom. kohen kore rishon, veacharav levi veacharav yisrael, mippene darche shalom. mearvin bevayit yashan, mippene darche shalom. bor shehu karov laamma, mitmalle rishon, mippene darche shalom. metzudot chayya veofot vedagim yesh bahem mishshum gazel, mippene darche shalom. rabbi yose omer, gazel gamur. metziat cheresh shote vekatan, yesh bahen mishshum gazel, mippene darche shalom. rabbi yose omer, gazel gamur. ani hamenakkef berosh hazzayit, ma shettachtav gazel, mippene darche shalom. rabbi yose omer, gazel gamur. en memachin beyad aniyye goyim beleket shichcha ufea, mippene darche shalom: 
Mashelet ishsha lachavertah hachashuda al hashsheviit, nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur, aval lo tavor velo titchan immah. eshet chaver mashelet leeshet am haaretz, nafa uchevara, uvoreret vetochenet umarkedet immah, aval mishshettattil hammayim, lo tigga immah, lefi sheen machazikin yede ovre avera. vechullan lo amru ella mippene darche shalom. umachazikin yede goyim bashsheviit, aval lo yede yisrael, veshoalin bishloman, mippene darche shalom: 
Haomer hitkabbel get ze leishti o holech get ze leishti, im ratza lachazor, yachazor. haishsha sheamra, hitkabbel li gitti, im ratza lachazor, lo yachazor. lefichach, im amar lo habbaal, i efshi shettekabbel lah ella holech veten lah, im ratza lachazor, yachazor. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af haomeret tol li gitti, im ratza lachazor, lo yachazor:
Mishnah Gittin 6:2-6:
Haishsha sheamra, hitkabbel li gitti, tzericha shete chitte edim, shenayim sheomrim befanenu amra ushenayim sheomrim befanenu kibbel vekara, afillu hen harishonim vehen haacharonim, o echad min harishonim veechad min haacharonim veechad mitztaref immahen. naara hameorasa, hi veaviha mekabbelin et gittah. amar rabbi yehuda, en shete yadayim zochot keachat, ella aviha mekabbel et gittah bilvad. vechol sheenah yechola lishmor et gittah, enah yechola lehitgaresh: 
Ketanna sheamra hitkabbel li gitti, eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. lefichach im ratza habbaal lachazor, yachazor, sheen katan ose shaliach. aval im amar lo aviha, tze vehitkabbel levitti gittah, im ratza lehachazir, lo yachazir. haomer ten get ze leishti vemakom peloni, unetano lah bemakom acher, pasul. hare hi vemakom peloni, unetano lah bemakom acher, kasher. haishsha sheamra hitkabbel li gitti vemakom peloni, vekibbelo lah bemakom acher, pasul. rabbi eliezer machshir. have li gitti mimmakom peloni vehevio lah mimmakom acher, kasher: 
Have li gitti, ochelet batteruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. hitkabbel li gitti, asura leechol batteruma miyyad. hitkabbel li gitti vemakom peloni, ochelet batteruma ad sheyyaggia get leoto makom. rabbi eliezer oser miyyad: 
Haomer, kitvu get utenu leishti, garshuha, kitvu iggeret utenu lah, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. pitruha, parnesuha, asu lah kannimmos, asu lah karauy, lo amar kelum. barishona hayu omrim, hayyotze vekolar veamar, kitvu get leishti, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar, af hamefaresh vehayyotze vishyara. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, af hammesukkan: 
Mi shehaya mushlach levor veamar, kol hashshomea et kolo yichtov get leishto, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. habbari sheamar, kitvu get leishti, ratza lesachek bah. maase bevari echad sheamar, kitvu get leishti, veala lerosh haggag venafal umet. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, amru chachamim, im meatzmo nafal, hare ze get. im haruach dechaattu, eno get:
Mishnah Kelim 3:3-7:
Chavit shennikkeva vaasaah bezefet, venishbera, im yesh bimkom hazzefet machazik reviit, temea, mippene shello vatal shem keli mealeha. cheres shennikkav vaasao vezefet, af al pi machazik reviit, tahor, mippene shebbatal shem keli mealav: 
Chavit shennitroaa utefalah biglalim, af al pi shehu notel et haggelalim vehacharasim noflim, temea, mippene shello vatal shem keli mealeha. nishbera vedibbek mimmenna charsit, o shehevi charsit mimmakom acher utefalan biglalim, af al pi shehu notel haggelalim vehacharasin omdim, tehora, mippene shebbatal shem keli mealeha. haya vah cheres machazik reviit, kullah mittamma vemagga, uchenegdo mittamme vaavir: 
Hattofel keli cheres habbari, rabbi meir verabbi shimon metammeim. vachachamim omrim, hattofel et habbari, tahor. veet haraua, tame. vechen bechidduk hakkeruya: 
Yabbelit shettoflin bah happittasin, hannogea bah, tame. megufat chavit, enah chibbur. hannogea betippulo shel tannur, tame: 
Mecham shettefalo vechomer uvecharsit, hannogea bachomer, tame. uvacharsit, tahor. kumekum shennikkav vaasao vezefet, rabbi yose metaher, sheeno yachol lekabbel et hachammin ketzonen. vechen haya omer bichle zefet. kele nechoshet shezzefatan, tehorin. veim leyayin, temein:
Mishnah Kelim 3:8-4:3:
Chavit shennikkeva vaasaah bezefet yater mitztzarkah, hannogea betzarkah, tame. yater mitztzarkah, tahor. zefet shennatfa al hechavit, hannogea bah, tahor. mashpech shel etz veshel cheres sheppekako vezefet, rabbi elazar ben azarya metamme. rabbi akiva metamme veshel etz, umetaher beshel cheres. rabbi yose metaher bishnehem: 
Hacheres sheeno yachol laamod mippene azno, o shehaya vo chiddud vehachiddud machrio, tahor. nittela haozen, nishbar hachiddud, tahor. rabbi yehuda metamme. chavit shennifchata, vehi mekabbelet al dafnoteha, o shennechleka chemin shete arevot, rabbi yehuda metaher, vachachamim metammein: 
Chavit shennitroaa veenah yechola lehittaltel bachatzi kav gerogarot, tehora. gistera shennitroaa veenah mekabbelet mashkin, af al pi shehi mekabbelet ochalin, tehora sheen sheyarin lishyarin: 
Ezo hi gistera, kol shennittelu azneha. hayu vah chiddudin yotzin, kol hamekabbel immah bezetim, mittamme vemagga uchenegdo mittamme vaavir. vechol sheeno mekabbel immah bezetim, mittamme vemagga veen kenegdo mittamme vaavir. hayta mutta al tziddah kemin kattedra, kol hamekabbel immah bezetim, mittamme vemagga uchenegdo mittamme vaavir. vechol sheeno mekabbel immah bezetim, mittamme vemagga veen kenegdo mittamme vaavir. shule korfiyyot veshule kosim hatztzidoniyyim, af al pi sheenam yecholim leshev shello mesummachin, temein, shellechach naasu mittechillatan:
Mishnah Kelim 4:4-5:3:
Keli cheres sheyyesh lo shalosh sefayot, happenimit odefet, hakkol tahor. hachitzona odefet, hakkol tame. haemtzait odefet, mimmenna velifnim, tame. mimmenna velachutz, tahor. hayu shavot, rabbi yehuda omer, cholkin haemtzait. vachachamim omrim, hakkol tahor. kele cheres, meematay mekabbelin tuma, mishsheyyitztzarfu vakkivshan, vehi gemar melachtan: 
Tannur, techillato arbaa, usheyarav arbaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bamme devarim amurim, begadol. aval bekatan, techillato kol shehu, usheyarav rubbo, mishshettiggamer melachto. ezehu gemar melachto, mishsheyyassikennu kede leefot bo sufganin. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyassik et hechadash, kede leefot bayyashan sufganin: 
Kira, techillatah shalosh, usheyareha shalosh, mishshettiggamer melachtah. ezehu gemar melachtah, mishsheyyassikenna, kede levashshel aleha vetza kalla shebbabbetzim, terufa unetuna veilpas. hakkuppach, asao laafiyya, shiuro kattannur. asao levishshul, shiuro kakkira. haeven hayyotze min hattannur tefach, umin hakkira shalosh etzbaot, chibbur. hayyotze min hakkuppach, asao laafiyya, shiuro kattannur. asao levishshul, shiuro kakkira. amar rabbi yehuda, lo amru tefach, ella ven hattannur velakkotel. hayu shene tannurin semuchim ze laze, noten laze tefach velaze tefach, vehashshear tahor: 
Ateret kira, tehora. tirat hattannur, bizman shehi gevoha arbaa tefachim, mittammea vemagga uvaavir. pechuta mikkan, tehora. im chibberah lo, afillu al shalosh avanim temea. bet happach uvet hattevalin uvet hanner shebbakkira, mittammein bemagga veenan mittammein baavir, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yishmael metaher:
Mishnah Kelim 5:4-7:
Tannur shehussak meachorav, o shehussak shello ledato, o shehussak bevet haumman, tame. maase shennafla deleka vetannure chefar signa, uva maase leyavne, vetimmean rabban gamliel: 
Musaf hattannur shel baale vattim, tahor. veshel nachtomin, tame, mippene shehu somech alav et hashshappud. rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer, mippene shehu ofe vo keshehu nidchak. kayyotze vo, musaf hayyora shel sholke zetim, tame. veshel tzabbaim, tahor: 
Tannur shennatan bo afar ad chetzyo, meafar ulemattan, mittamme vemagga. meafar ulemalan, mittamme vaavir. netano al pi habbor o al pi haddut, venatan sham even, rabbi yehuda omer, im massik millemattan, vehu nissok milmalan, tame. vachachamim omrim, hoil vehussak mikkol makom, tame: 
Tannur shennitma, ketzad metaharin oto. cholko lishlosha, vegorer et hattefela ad sheyyehe vaaretz. rabbi meir omer, eno tzarich ligror et hattefela, velo ad sheyyehe vaaretz, ella memaato mibbifnim arbaa tefachim. rabbi shimon omer, vetzarich lehassio. chilleko lishnayim, echad gadol veechad katan, haggadol tame vehakkatan tahor. chalako lishlosha, echad gadol kishnayim, haggadol tame, ushenayim hakketannim tehorin:
Mishnah Kelim 5:8-6:1:
Chatacho chulyot lerachbo, pachot mearbaa tefachim, tahor. mercho vetit, mekabbel tuma mishsheyyassikennu kede leefot bo sufganin. hirchik mimmennu et hattefela venatan chol o tzeror bentayim, baze amru, hannidda vehattehora ofot bo vehu tahor: 
Tannur shebba mechuttach mibbet haumman, veasa vo limmudin, venotnan alav vehu tahor, nitma. vesillek et limmudav, tahor. hecheziran lo, tahor. mercho vetit, mekabbel tuma, veeno tzarich lehassikennu, shekkevar hussak: 
Chatacho chulyot venatan chol ben chulya lechulya, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein. ze tannuro shel achnay. yorot haarviyyin shehu chofer baaretz vetach betit, im yachol hattiach laamod bifne atzmo, tame. veim lav, tahor. veze tannuro shel ben dinay: 
Tannur shel even veshel mattechet, tahor, vetame mishshum kele mattachot. nikkav, nifgam, nisdak, asa lo tefela, o musaf shel tit, tame. kamma yehe vannekev, kede sheyyetze vo haur. vechen bechira. kira shel even veshel mattechet tehora, utemea mishshum kele mattachot, nikkeva, nifgema, nisdeka, asa lah pitputin, temea. merchah betit ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, tehora. rabbi yehuda omer, mibbifnim temea, umibbachutz tehora: 
Haose shelosha fitputim baaretz vechibberan betit lihyot shofet alehen et hakkedera, temea. kava shelosha masmerin baaretz lihyot shofet alehen hakkedera, af al pi sheasa verosho makom shettehe hakkedera yoshevet, tehora. haose shete avanim kira vechibberam betit, temea. rabbi yehuda metaher, ad sheyyaase shelishit, o ad sheyyismoch lakkotel. achat betit veachat shello vetit, tehora:
Mishnah Kelim 6:2-7:1:
Haeven shehaya shofet aleha veal hattannur, aleha veal hakkira, aleha veal hakkuppach, temea. aleha veal haeven, aleha veal hassela, aleha veal hakkotel, tehora. vezo hayta kirat hannezirim shebbirushalayim, shekkeneged hassala. kirat hattabbachim, bizman shehu noten even betzad even, nitmet achat mehen, lo nitmeu chullan: 
Shalosh avanim sheasaan shete chirayim, nitmet achat min hachitzona, haemtzait hameshammeshet et hattemea, temea. hameshammeshet hattehora, tehora. nittela hattehora, huchleta haemtzait letuma. nittela hattemea, huchleta haemtzait lithora. nitmeu shetayim hachitzonot, im hayta haemtzait gedola, noten lazo chede shefita mikkan velazo chede shefita mikkan, vehashshear tahor. veim hayta ketanna, hakkol tame. nittela haemtzait, im yachol lishpot aleha yora gedola, temea. hechezirah, tehora. merchah betit, mekabbelet tuma mishsheyyassikenna kede levashshel aleha et habbetza: 
Shete avanim sheasaam kira venitmeu, samach lazo even achat mikkan, velazo even achat mikkan, chetzyah shel zo temea vechetzyah tehora, vechetzyah shel zo temea vechetzyah tehora. nittelu tehorot, chazru ellu letumatan: 
Hakkalatut shel baale vatim shennifchata fachot mishshelosha tefachim, temea, shehu massik millemattan ukedera veshela milmalan. yater mikkan, tehora. natan even o tzeror, tehora. merchah betit, mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba. zo hayta teshuvat rabbi yehuda vetannur shennetano al pi habbor o al pi haddut:
Mishnah Terumot 10:12-11:3:
Betza shennitbashshela bitvalin asurin, afillu chelmon shellah asur, mippene shehu volea. me shelakot ume chevashim shel teruma, asurim lezarim: 
En notnin devela ugerogarot letoch hammureyas, mippene shehu meabbedan, aval notnin et hayyayin lammureyas. veen mefattemin et hashshemen, aval osin et hayyayin yenumelin. en mevashshelin yayin shel teruma, mippene shehu mamito. rabbi yehuda mattir, mippene shehu mashbicho: 
Devash temarim, veyen tappuchim, vechometz sitvaniyyot, ushear kol me ferot shel teruma, rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vechomesh, verabbi yehoshua poter. verabbi eliezer metamme mishshum mashke. amar rabbi yehoshua, lo manu chachamim shiva mashkim kemone fetamim, ella amru, shiva mashkin temeim, ushear kol hammashkin tehorin: 
En osin temarim devash, velo tappuchim yayin, velo sitvaniyyot chometz, ushear kol happerot en meshannin otam mibberiyyatan bitruma uvemaaser sheni, ella zetim vaanavim bilvad. en sofgin arbaim mishshum arla, ella al hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim. veen meviin bikkurim mashkin, ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim. veeno mittamme mishshum mashke, ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim. veen makrivin al gabbe hammizbeach, ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim:
Mishnah Terumot 10:3-7:
Harode pat chamma unetanah al pi chavit shel yen teruma, rabbi meir oser, verabbi yehuda mattir. rabbi yose mattir beshel chittim, veoser beshel seorim, mippene shehasseorim shoavot: 
Tannur shehissiko vechammon shel teruma veafa vo, happat mutteret, sheen taam kammon, ella reach kammon: 
Tiltan shennafla letoch habbor shel yayin, bitruma, bemaaser sheni, im yesh bazzera kede litten taam, aval lo vaetz. bishviit uvechile hakkerem vehekdesh, im yesh bazzera uvaetz kede litten taam: 
Mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan bechile hakkerem, yiddaleku. hayu lo chavile tiltan shel tevel, kotesh, umechashshev kamma zera yesh bahem, umafrish et hazzera, veeno tzarich lehaferish et haetz. im hifrish, lo yomar echtosh veettol et haetz veetten et hazzera, ella noten haetz im hazzara: 
Zete chullin shekkevashan im zete teruma, petzue chullin im petzue teruma, petzue chullin im sheleme teruma, o veme teruma, asur. aval sheleme chullin im petzue teruma, muttar:
Mishnah Terumot 10:8-11:
Dag tame shekkevasho im dag tahor, kol garav shehu machazik satayim, im yesh bo mishkal asara zuz bihuda shehen chamesh selaim baggalil dag tame, tziro asur. rabbi yehuda omer, reviit besatayim. verabbi yose omer, echad mishshishsha asar bo: 
Chagavim temeim shennichbeshu im chagavim tehorim, lo faslu et tziram. heid rabbi tzadok al tzir chagavim temeim, shehu tahor: 
Kol hannichbashim ze im ze, muttarim, ella im hachasit. chasit shel chullin im chasit shel teruma, yarak shel chullin im chasit shel teruma, asur. aval chasit shel chullin im yarak shel teruma, muttar: 
Rabbi yose omer, kol hannishlakim im hatteradim, asurim, mippene shehem notnin et hattaam. rabbi shimon omer, keruv shel shikya im keruv shel baal, asur, mippene shehu volea. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hammitbashshelin ze im ze, muttarim, ella im habbasar. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, hakkaved oseret veenah neeseret, mippene shehi foletet veenah bolaat:
Mishnah Terumot 8:10-9:1:
Vechen chavit shel shemen shennishpecha, mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora, yatztzil. veim lav, rabbi eliezer omer, tered vetibbala, veal yevalleenna veyadav: 
Veal zo veal zo amar rabbi yehoshua, lo zo hi teruma sheani muzhar aleha milletammeah, ella milleachlah. uval tetammeah ketzad, haya over mimmakom lemakom vechikkarot shel teruma veyado, amar lo nachri, ten li achat mehen vaatammeah, veim lav, hare ani metamme et kullah, rabbi eliezer omer, yetamme et kullah, veal yitten lo achat mehen vitamme. rabbi yehoshua omer, yanniach lefanav achat mehen al hassala: 
Vechen nashim sheamru lahem nachrim, tenu achat mikkem unetamme, veim lav, hare anu metammeim et kullechem, yetammeu et kullan, veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael: 
Hazzorea teruma, shogeg, yofach. umezid, yekayyem. im hevia shelish, ben shogeg ben mezid, yekayyem. uvefishtan, mezid, yofach:
Mishnah Terumot 9:2-5:
Vechayyevet beleket uveshichcha uvefea. vaaniyye yisrael vaaniyye chohanim, melakketim. vaaniyye yisrael, mochrin et shellahem lakkohanim bidme teruma, vehaddamim shellahem. rabbi tarfon omer, lo yelakketu ella aniyye chohanim, shemma yishkechu veyittenu letoch pihem. amar lo rabbi akiva, im ken, lo yelakketu ella tehorim: 
Vechayyevet bemaasrot uvemaasar ani, vaaniyye yisrael vaaniyye chohanim notlim, vaaniyye yisrael mochrin et shellahem lechohanim bidme teruma, vehaddamim shellahem. hachovet meshubbach. vehaddash ketzad yaase, tole chefifot betzavvere vehema venoten letochan meoto hammin, nimtza lo zomem et habbehema velo maachil et hatteruma: 
Giddule teruma, teruma. vegiddule giddulin, chullin. aval hattevel umaaser rishon usefiche sheviit uterumat chutza laaretz vehamedumma vehabbikkurim, giddulehen, chullin. giddule hekdesh umaaser sheni, chullin, ufode otam bizman zaram: 
Mea ligna shel teruma veachat shel chullin, kullan muttarin bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale, afillu mea shel chullin veachat shel teruma, kullan asurin:
Mishnah Terumot 9:6-10:2:
Hattevel, giddulav muttarin bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale, giddule giddulin, asurin. ezehu davar sheen zaro chale, kegon halluf vehashshum vehabbetzalim. rabbi yehuda omer, hashshum, kasseorim: 
Hamenakkesh im hannachri bachasiyyot, af al pi shepperotav tevel, ochel mehem aray. shetile teruma shenitmeu, shetalan, taharu milletamme, vaasurin milleechol ad sheyyagom et haochel. rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyagom veyishne: 
Batzal shennetano vetoch adashim, im shalem, muttar. veim chittecho, benoten taam. ushear kol hattavshil, ben shalem ben mechuttach, benoten taam. rabbi yehuda mattir betzachana, sheeno ella littol et hazzuhama: 
Tappuach sherisseko unetano letoch issa, vechimmetzah, hare zo asura. seorim shennaflu letoch habbor shel mayim, af al pi shehivishu, memav muttarin:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 1:1-4: Paamayim bechol yom korin keriat shema, baerev uvabboker. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 7)</small> "uveshachbecha uvekumecha" beshaa shedderech bene adam shochvin veze hu layla. uveshaa shedderech bene adam omdin veze hu yom:

Uma hu kore, shelosha parashiyyot. ellu hen <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema" <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "vehaya im shamoa" <small>(Bamidbar 15 37)</small> "vayyomer". umakdimin likrot parashat shema mippene sheyyesh bah yichud hashshem veahavato vetalmudo shehu haikkar haggadol shehakkol taluy bo. veachareha vehaya im shamoa sheyyesh bah tziuuy al (zechirat) shear kol hammitzvot. veachar kach parashat <small>(Bamidbar 15 lach)</small> "tzitzit" sheggam hi yesh bah tziuuy zechirat kol hammitzvot:

Af al pi sheen mitzvat tzitzit noheget ballayla korin otah ballayla mippene sheyyesh bah zichron yetziat mitzrayim umitzva lehazekir yetziat mitzrayim bayyom uvallayla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha". ukeriat shalosh parashiyyot ellu al seder ze hi hannikret keriat shema:

Hakkore keriat shema keshehu gomer pasuk rishon omer belachash baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed vechozer vekore kedarko <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha" ad sofah. velamma korin ken. masoret hi beyadenu shebbeshaa shekkibbetz yaakov avinu et banav bemitzrayim bishat mitato tzivvam vezerzam al yichud hashshem veal derech Adonai shehalach bah avraham veyitzchak aviv veshaal otam veamar lahem banay shemma yesh bachem paslut mi sheeno omed immi beyichud hashshem kainyan sheamar lanu moshe rabbenu <small>(Devarim 29 17)</small> "pen yesh bachem ish o ishsha" vegomer. anu kullam veamru <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". kelomar shema mimmennu avinu yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. patach hazzaken veamar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. lefichach nahagu kol yisrael lomar shevach sheshshibbeach bo yisrael hazzaken achar pasuk ze:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 1:5-7: Hakkore keriat shema mevarech lefaneha uleachareha. bayyom mevarech shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha. uvallayla mevarech shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha:

Beracha rishona shellefaneha bayyom yotzer or uvore choshech vechulei uveracha sheniyya ahavat olam ahavtanu. veshel achareha emet veyatztziv. uveracha rishona shellefaneha ballayla maariv aravim vechulei sheniyya lah ahavat olam bet yisrael ammecha ahavta kulei. uveracha rishona shel achareha emet veemuna. sheniyya lah hashekivenu:

Beracha rishona shellefaneha ben bayyom ben ballayla poteach bah bevaruch vechotem bah bevaruch. ushear birchoteha chotem bechol achat mehen bevaruch veen lahem peticha bevaruch. berachot ellu im shear kol habberachot haaruchot befi kol yisrael ezra hassofer uvet dino tikkenum veen adam rashshay lifchot mehem velo lehosif alehem. makom shehitkinu lachtom bevaruch eno rashshay shello lachtom. umakom shehitkinu shello lachtom eno rashshay lachtom. makom shehitkinu shello liftoach bevaruch eno rashshay liftoach. makom shehitkinu liftoach eno rashshay shello liftoach. kelalo shel davar kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot hare ze toe vechozer umevarech kammatbea. vechol sheeno omer emet veyatztziv beshacharit veemet veemuna bearvit lo yatza yede chovato:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 1:7-8: Beracha rishona shellefaneha ben bayyom ben ballayla poteach bah bevaruch vechotem bah bevaruch. ushear birchoteha chotem bechol achat mehen bevaruch veen lahem peticha bevaruch. berachot ellu im shear kol habberachot haaruchot befi kol yisrael ezra hassofer uvet dino tikkenum veen adam rashshay lifchot mehem velo lehosif alehem. makom shehitkinu lachtom bevaruch eno rashshay shello lachtom. umakom shehitkinu shello lachtom eno rashshay lachtom. makom shehitkinu shello liftoach bevaruch eno rashshay liftoach. makom shehitkinu liftoach eno rashshay shello liftoach. kelalo shel davar kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot hare ze toe vechozer umevarech kammatbea. vechol sheeno omer emet veyatztziv beshacharit veemet veemuna bearvit lo yatza yede chovato:

Hikdim beracha sheniyya livracha rishona ben bayyom ben ballayla ben lefaneha ben leachareha yatza lefi sheen seder babberachot. beshacharit patach yotzer or vesiyyem maariv aravim lo yatza. patach bemaariv aravim vesiyyem beyotzer or yatza. uvaerev patach bemaariv aravim vesiyyem beyotzer or lo yatza. patach beyotzer or vesiyyem bemaariv aravim yatza. shekkol habberachot holchot achar chatimatan:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 1:9-10: Eze hu zeman keriat shema ballayla. mitzvatah mishsheat yetziat hakkochavim ad chatzi hallayla. veim avar veicher vekara ad shello ala ammud hashshachar yatza yede chovato shello amru ad chatzot ella kede leharechik adam min happeshia:

Hakkore keriat shema shel arvit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar kodem hanetz hachamma lo yatza yede chovato ella im ken haya anus kegon shikkor o chole vechayyotze bahen. veanus shekkara beet ze eno omer hashekivenu:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 7:8: Baale teshuva darkan lihyot shefalim vaanavim beyoter. im cherfu otan hakkesilim bemaasehem harishonim veamru lahen emesh hayita ose kach vechach veemesh hayita omer kach vechach. al yargishu lahen ella shomin usemechim veyodin shezzo zechut lahem. shekkol zeman shehem boshim mimmaasehem sheavru venichlamim mehen zechutam merubba umaalatam mitgaddelet. vechet gamur hu lomar levaal teshuva zechor maasecha harishonim o lehazekiran lefanav kede levayyesho. o lehazekir devarim veinyanim haddomin lahem kede lehazekiro me asa. hakkol asur umuzhar alav bichlal honayat devarim shehizhira tora aleha shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 17)</small> "velo tonu ish et amito":
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:4-5: Aval davar sheen bo leharebot ulemaet kegon ner vechevesh hoil veasa bishvil atzmo nehene acharav yisrael beshabbat veaf al pi shehu makkiro. ner haddaluk bimsibba beshabbat. im rov yisrael asur lehishtammesh leorah shehammadlik al daat harov madlik. veim rov nachrim muttar lehishtammesh leorah. mechetza lemechetza asur. nafla deleka beshabbat uva nachri lechabbot en omrin lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alenu. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Met sheasu lo nachrim aron vechafru lo kever beshabbat o heviu lo chalilin lispod bahen. im betzina yamtin bichde sheyyeasu lemotzae shabbat veyikkaver bo. veim haya hakkever bisratya gedola vehaaron al gabbav vechol haovrin vehashshavin omrim shezze shehannachrim osin achshav beshabbat lifloni hu. hare ze lo yikkaver bo oto yisrael olamit. mippene shehu befarhesya. umuttar likbor bo yisrael acher vehu sheyyamtin bichde sheyyease. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Niddah 17a:6-8: Vehashshote mashkin mezugin sheavar alehen hallayla. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vehu shellanu bichle mattachot. amar rav pappa: uchele neter kichle mattachot damu. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shellanu bichle mattachot, uchele neter kichle mattachot damu.
Vehallan bevet hakkevarot — kede shettishre alav ruach tumea, zimnin dimsakkenin leh.

Vehannotel tzippornav vezorkan lirshut harabbim — mippene sheishsha meubberet overet alehen umappelet. vela amaran ella deshakel bignusetre, vela amaran ella deshakel dideh udechareh, vela amaran ella dela gaz midde batrayyhu, aval gaz midde batrayyhu — let lan ba. vela hi, lechulla milleta chayyshinan.
Proverbs 15:10-15: Musar ra leozev orach sone tochachat yamut
Sheol vaavaddon neged Adonai af ki-libbot bene-adam
Lo yeehav-letz hocheach lo el-chachamim lo yelech
Lev sameach yetiv panim uveatztzevat-lev ruach nechea
Lev navon yevakkesh-daat (ufene) [ufi] chesilim yire ivvelet
Kol-yeme ani raim vetov-lev mishte tamid
Proverbs 15:16-19: Tov-meat beyirat Adonai meotzar rav umehuma vo
Tov aruchat yarak veahava-sham mishshor avus vesina-vo
Ish chema yegare madon veerech appayim yashkit riv
Derech atzel kimsuchat chadek veorach yesharim selula
Proverbs 15:20-24: Ben chacham yesammach-av uchesil adam boze immo
Ivvelet simcha lachasar-lev veish tevuna yeyashsher-lachet
Hafer machashavot been sod uverov yoatzim takum
Simcha laish bemaane-fiv vedavar beitto ma-tov
Orach chayyim lemala lemaskil lemaan sur mishsheol matta
Proverbs 15:25-30: Toavat Adonai machshevot ra utehorim imre-noam
Ocher beto botzea batza vesone mattanot yichye
Lev tzaddik yehge laanot ufi reshaim yabbia raot
Rachok Adonai mershaim utefillat tzaddikim yishma
Proverbs 15:31-16:2: Ozen shomaat tochachat chayyim bekerev chachamim talin
Porea musar moes nafsho veshomea tochachat kone lev
Yirat Adonai musar chochma velifne chavod anava
Kol-darche-ish zach beenav vetochen ruchot Adonai
Shabbat 119b:3-5: Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: kol hammitpallel beerev shabbat veomer "vaychullu", shene malache hashsharet hamelavvin lo laadam mannichin yedehen al rosho veomrim lo "vesar avonecha vechattatcha techuppar". tanya, rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: shene malache hashsharet melavvin lo leadam beerev shabbat mibbet hakkeneset leveto, echad tov veechad ra. ucheshebba leveto umotze ner daluk veshulchan aruch umittato mutztzaat, malach tov omer: "yehi ratzon shettehe leshabbat acheret kach", umalach ra one "amen" beal korcho. veim lav, malach ra omer: "yehi ratzon shettehe leshabbat acheret kach", umalach tov one "amen" beal korcho.

Amar rabbi elazar: leolam yesadder adam shulchano beerev shabbat, af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit. veamar rabbi chanina: leolam yesadder adam shulchano bemotzae shabbat, af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit. chammin bemotzae shabbat — melugema, pat chamma bemotzae shabbat — melugema. rabbi avahu hava avdin leh beappoke shabbeta igla tilta, hava achel minneh kuleyyta. ki gedal avimi bereh, amar leh: lema lach leafsode kulle hay, nishbok kuleyyta mimmaale shabbeta. shavku vaata arya achleh.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol haone "amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach" bechol kocho, korin lo gezar dino, shenneemar: "bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnaddev am barchu Adonai". may tama "bifroa peraot" — mishshum devarchu Adonai". rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: afillu yesh bo shemetz shel avoda zara — mochalin lo. ketiv hacha: "bifroa peraot", uchetiv hatam: "ki farua hu". amar resh lakish: kol haone "amen" bechol kocho potchin lo shaare gan eden, shenneemar: "pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik shomer emunim", al tikre "shomer emunim" ella: "sheomrim amen". may "amen"? amar rabbi chanina: "el melech neeman".
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.
Zohar, Yitro 28: (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha. rabbi chiyyay patach, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden vegomer. venahar, da neviu demabbua, denafik tadir vela pasak. uminnahara demabbua da, itshakya kol ginta deeden. vehahu nahara demabbua kaddisha, ikre av. may taama. mishshum deihu nevia leittezana leginta.

Rabbi abba amar, eden mammash ikre av. mishshum dehay eden, mishtechach mehahu atar, deikre ayin. uvegini kach, ikre av. veha ukimna, meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla, ikre atta, veikre av. kema (ayyen sof hassefer 13 mispar livnat hassappir) deat amar, (Yeshayahu 63:16) ki atta avinu.

Rabbi elazar amar, kabbed et avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veet immecha, da keneset yisrael. et avicha, et dayyka, leachlela shechinta (davar achar ilaa). rabbi yehuda amar, kabbed et avicha, setam. veet immecha, setam. deha kolla hava beminyayna. et, lerabbot kol ma dilella vetatta.

Rabbi yosi amar, hay deamar rabbi abba, meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla, ikre atta, shappir. deha olifna, hahu detamir vela it beh sheruta, karenan hu. meatar (Vayikra 2, amud alef 78, 290 amud alef) desheruta ishtechach, karenan atta. veikre av. vecholla chad. berich shemeh lealam ulealme almayya amen.

Rabbi chizkiyya amar, vadday kolla chad. kabbed et avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veet immecha, da keneset yisrael. deha tenan, amar rabbi shimon, ketiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, hahu atar deikre banim. uvegine kach setima demilla, kabbed et avicha veet immecha, leachlela kolla, dilella vetatta. Rabbi yitzchak amar, leachlela beh rabbeh, dehu ail leh lealma deate. amar rabbi yehuda, bichlala dekudesha berich hu have.

Tana, behane chamesh amiran, kalil kolla. behane chamesh amiran, itgelifu chamesh acharanin, vadday chamesh go chamesh. ha ketzad. anochi Adonai elohecha, (84 amud bet) lokovel lo tirtzach. detanenan, (amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yehuda) teren illen, bichlala chada itteklilan, deman dekatil, azir demuta vetzalma demareh. dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:6) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uchetiv (yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam.

Amar Rabbi chiyyay, ketiv (bareasheytet) sofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech vegomer, (shofech dam haadam) man deshafich dama, keillu azir demuta vetzalma dilella, kelomar, la azar demuta da, ella demuta achara, mashma dichtiv shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech. baadam illaa, mate hay pegimuta, mehahu dama deoshid. may taama. mishshum ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uvegin kach, ha beha talya.

Lo yihye lecha, lokovel lo tinaf da meshakker bishma dekudesha berich hu, deitreshim beh bevar nash. uveda, kamma vechamma chovin vegazrin veonashin, talyayn. uman dimshakker behay, meshakker beh bemalka, dichtiv, (Hoshea Adonai:7) baAdonai bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu. uchetiv lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem, veha beha talya.
Lo tissa lokovel lo tignov. uchetiv (Mishlei 29:24) cholak im gannav sone nafsho alla yishma velo yaggid. vadday ha beha talya, deha gannava leda izdaman, leumaa beshikra. man deavid da, avid da.

Zachor et yom hashshabbat, lokovel lo taan vereacha ed shaker. deamar Rabbi yosi, shabbat sahaduta ikre. uvae bar nash lesahada al ha dichtiv ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai vegomer. veshabbat kelala (nusach acher sahaduta) decholla. veamar Rabbi yosi, may dichtiv, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov, kema deat amar (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, uman deashid shikra, meshakker beshabbat, dehi sahaduta dikshot, uman dimshakker beshabbat, meshakker beorayyta kulla. ubbegin kach, ha beha talya.

Kabbed et avicha, lokovel lo tachmod eshet reecha. veamar Rabbi yitzchak, kabbed et avicha, avicha mammash. deha man dechamid itteta, veolid bar, hahu bar okir leachara, dela avuy. uchetiv kabbed et avicha vegomer, lo tachmod bet reecha, sadehu. uchetiv hacha, al haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lach. hahu deyahav lach, yehe dilach, velo tachmod achara. vadday ha beha talya.

Veillen chamesh kadmae, kelilan chamesh acharanin. uvegine kach, (Devarim log) mimino esh dat lamo. decholla itavid yemina. veal da, bachamishsha kalin orayyta ityeyhivat. amar Rabbi yehuda, kullehu havo chamesh go chamesh. lokovlehon chamishsha chumeshe tora.

Tane Rabbi elazar, beillen eser amiran, itgelifu kol pikkude orayyta, gezirin veonashin. dachya umesaava. anfin vesharashin. ilanin unetiin. shemayya veara. yamma utehome. deha orayyta shema dekudesha berich hu havi, ma shema dekudesha berich hu itgelif beeser amiran, uf orayyta itgelifa beeser amiran. illen eser amiran innun shema dekudesha berich hu. veorayyta kolla shema chad have, shema kaddisha dekudesha berich hu mammash.

Zakkaa chulakeh, deman dezache bah. man dezache beorayyta, zache bishma kaddisha. (dekudesha berich hu mammash) Rabbi yosi amar, bekudesha berich hu mammash zache, (sefer acher ucheneset yisrael) deha hu ushemeh chad hu, berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin amen.

rashi: Bihyot habboker. melammed shehikdim al yadam, ma sheen derech basar vadam laasot ken – sheyyehe harav mamtin lattalmid; vechen matzinu "kum tze el habbika, vaakum vaetze el habbika vehinne sham kevod Adonai omed" (Yechezkel 3):

ohc: Shem haechad gershom vegomer. hutzrach lichtov taam hashshem paam sheniyya achar shekketavo befarashat shemot (Shemot 2:22), kede shetteda ki hu ze haamur befarashat shemot velo acher shennikra al shemo.

Od ulay ki chash hakkatuv sheyyomar haomer ki taam shekkara lo shem gershom hu letzad sheggersho yitro meal shulchano o mibbeto, vahagam sheamar hattaam "ger hayiti" vegomer, ulay ki letzad shello yargish yitro amar ken, laze chazar hakkatuv vehitzdik haddevarim afillu bizman shello yachush leharegashat yitro ki taam shem vegomer ki amar vegomer. uferush mashmaut "ki amar ger" vegomer perashtiv befarashat shemot (Shemot 2:22).

rashi: Veatta techeze. beruach hakkodesh shealecha:
Anshe chayil. ashirim, sheen tzerichin lehachanif ulehakkir panim (sham):
Anshe emet. ellu baale havetacha, shehem keday lismoch al divrehem, sheal yede chen yihyu divrehem nishmain:
Sone vatza. shessonin et mamonam baddin, kehahi deamrinan: kol dayyana demappekin mamona minneh bedina lav dayyana hu (bava batra 58):
Sare alafim. hem hayu shesh meot sarim leshesh meot elef:
Sare meot. shesh alafim hayu:
Sare chamishshim. 12 elef:
Sare asarot. shishshim elef:
ohc: Veatta techeze. perush, lo shehaam yemannu alehem ella hu yecheze. od ramaz, ki letzad ze yechashev keillu hu hashshofet kevan shehem sheluchav veyittol chelek bammitzva.

Mikkol haam. perush, hagam sheyyimtza bene adam sheyyerae beenav ki hem reuyim laddavar, af al pi chen lo yihye mitratztze bahem ad sheyyevakkesh kol haam veyikkach haggadol shebbechullam bechol bechina mibbechinot hattovot hammenuyot bidvarav.

Anshe chayil vegomer. amar arba haderagot keneged arbaa minnuyim hammuzkarot bidvarav, keneged sare alafim amar anshe chayil, tevat chayil taggid otzem hashelamat haosher vehammiddot vehaggevura uchelalut hashshelemut, ki chen tzarich lihyot sar haelef. ucheneged sare hammeot amar yire elohim, ki letzad perat ze lo yitztarech kol kach ella kesheyyihye yere elohim rauy lehitmannot sar lemea, vedikdek lomar yire elohim shetztzerichin lihyot yereim yirat haonesh, ki yesh lecha ladaat ki hayyare bivchinat shem havaya letzad sheyyihye bedato ki Adonai rachum vechannun lifamim yecheta veyismoch al rachamav ki yaarich appo vechaddome, aval yirat haonesh tarid hammaskil, uchemo shettimtza shekkol gedole olam yereim middikduke hammishpat hagam ki yodim shemmaasehem yesharim unechonim. vetze ulemad mimmaamar chachamenu zichronam livracha (chagiga 4,2) sheamru bemaase baalat ov kesheala shemuel vehevi immo moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom, yeuyyan sham divrehem, vaasher al ken amar "yire elohim", ki tzerichin lihyot begeder yira middikduke hammishpat been rachamim, uvechina zo yeshnah gam ken besare haalafim ella shennosaf bahem peratim acherim sheen tzorech lahem besar hammea. ucheneged sare chamishshim amar anshe emet, sheyyaspik legeder ze hagam shello hissigu livchina zo shel yirat otzem haddin ella sheyyihyu anshe emet sheyyishtaddelu al haamadat haemet leval tihye nederet. ucheneged sare asarot amar sone vatza, day lahem geder ze uvaze yihyu reuyim lihyot sare asarot. vedikdek lomar sone, perush, ki yihye lahem haddavar sanu lo sheyyitztarchu leharechik taavatam, ki leelle yesh chashad sheyyenutztzechu meharesha hamefatte. vechol middot hashshelosha yeshnam beanshe chayil, vechol middot hashshenayim yeshnam beyire elohim, umiddat sone vatza yeshnah beanshe emet vehem zo lemala mizzo, velaze lo amar veyire vegomer veanshe emet vesone vatza im kullam yitkabbetzu yachad beadam echad haya tzarich lomar vav bechol achat o lefachot bachalukka haacharona, ella vadday kemo shekkatavti sheen tzorech laze bechol happeratim.

Vehinne peshita sheim yimtza mimmin hammeshubbach shebbechullan lechol hammenuyim ma tov uma naim, velaze keshebbikkesh moshe beyisrael matza mimmin hameshubbach "anshe chayil" shiur sheyyaspik lechullam, keamro "vayyivchar moshe anshe chayil mikkol yisrael", velo hutzrach lefaret shear happeratim ki yeshnam bivchinat anshe chayil. veze yatzdik lecha gam ken perushenu bedivre yitro, sheim kavvanato lomar zot veod, im ken haya lo lemoshe livchor gam ken kol harmuzim bedivre yitro. veen lomar chas veshalom ki lo matza beyisrael yire elohim anshe emet vegomer, ella vadday kidvarenu, shello hizkir yitro shear happeratim ella letzad shechash yitro shello yimtza shiur hammaspik mibbechina haggedola vehaya mistappek bemadrega ketanna kannizkar.

Veraiti latet lev ech zacha yitro shettikkatev al yado parasha zo, vehen emet ki hu kibbed moshe eved Adonai, vehinne secharo shekkibbedo Adonai, ella haya Adonai yachol asot lo derech kavod acher, lo bederech ze sheyyerae chas veshalom kefichut yedia beam Adonai ad shebba kohen midyan vehiskilam.

Venire ki taam haddavar hu lehareot Adonai et bene yisrael haddor hahu vechol dor vador, ki yesh baummot gedolim bahavana uvehaskala. vetze ulemad mehasekalat yitro baatzato veofen seder bene adam asher bachar, ki yesh baummot makkirim devarim hameushsharim. vehakkavvana baze ki lo baa habbechira beyisrael letzad sheyyesh bahem hasekala vehakkara yoter mikkol haummot, veze lecha haot hasekalat yitro. ha lamadta ki lo merov chachmat yisrael vehasekalatam bachar Adonai bahem, ella lechesed elyon uleahavat haavot. veyoter yeerav lachech taam ze leman deamar (zevachim 116,1) yitro kodem mattan tora ba, ki nitchakkem Adonai al ze kodem mattan tora lomar shehagam sheyyesh baummot yoter chachamim miyyisrael, af al pi chen otanu hevi Adonai elav uvachar banu. veal ze bifrat alenu leshabbeach laasher bachar banu mitztzad chasadav. gam leman deamar achar mattan tora, yesh taam bema shessidder biato kodem lehareot hakkavvana hannizkeret, shezzulat ze en hakkavvana hannizkeret niglet, vehaven:

rashi: Lo anasse. en retzoni sheyyitkaddesh shemo al yadi (tanchuma Buber, vayyetze yad):
targum: Vaamar achaz la eshal vela anase kodam Adonai:

rashi: Leadam maarche lev. hu soder atzato udevarav belibbo:
Ume maane lashon. keshebba lehashiv, hakkadosh baruch hu maskilo bidvarav, o im zacha mezammen lo maane tov:
targum: Min bar nash tarita delibba umin Adonai mamlala delishana:

rashi: Ki yihye lahem davar ba. mi shehaya lo haddavar – ba elay:
Veattem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim. sarim, kema deat amar "uvene david kohanim" (Shmuel 2 8):
Elle haddevarim. lo pachot velo yoter (mechilta):
ohc: Veattem tihyu li vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "veattem", kevan shead atta lahem haya medabber. veulay ki al moshe veaharon chozrim haddevarim, veleheyot shead atta haya medabber al kol yisrael vaasaam segulla, im ken yomar moshe ki en hefresh od benam leven yisrael, laze amar veattem, perush atta veachicha tihyu li mamlechet kohanim keneged aharon, vegoy kadosh keneged moshe umishpachto, al derech amro (Bamidbar 8:17-18) "hikdashti otam li vaekkach et haleviyyim" vegomer.

O yirtze lomar lahem ki meatta yihyu hem bivchinat pamalya shel mala, ki lemala yesh lehaadon meshartav umeshammeshim lefanav bammarom velahem yikkare kohanim, gam yesh lefanav tzava rav hannikra kadosh dichtiv (Daniel 8:13) "echad kadosh", veamar Adonai ki otam yaase Adonai bimkom kohanim ukedoshim haelyonim, vechen haya shetztzivva laasot lo bayit lishkon betochenu uvachar mimmennu kohanim vetzivva lanu (Vayikra 11:44) "vihyitem kedoshim". uchefi ze amro veattem chozer haddavar lichlalut yisrael, vehutzrach lomar tevat veattem, leval yachshevu ki devarav lahem al heatid lavo baalot hannefesh achar happereda mehagguf yassig haruchaniyyut maalot hassedurot, aval bachayyim chayyuto tarchik haddaat hassaga zo, laze amar veattem perush, attem beatzmechem baale geviyya tassigu maala zo. umatzinu shehatztzaddikim hissigu maala zo shennikraim malachim ukedoshim, ki beemtzaut hattora tigdal vetaale maalat haadam ad en ketz lemala mehammalachim (sanhedrin 93,1), veze lecha haot ki Adonai bachar leyoter maala likdushshat mekom kevodo im yisrael, ha lamadta ki hem lemala mehem ki maalin bakkodesh vechulei.

Od yirmoz lefi ma shepperashti befasuk "vihyitem li segulla", sheyyirmoz leverure nitzotzot hakkedushsha. amro veattem vegomer, lehagedil maalat hammevarer mehammitbarer, ki hammevarer yihye mamlechet shel kohanim veshel goy kadosh, shehem shete haderagot hakkedushsha hammitbarrim kannizkar. vechillekam lishne chalakim, ki yesh bannivrarim haderagot elyonim vehaderagot ketannim kefi bechinat hakkedushsha, vehakkavvana baze ki bechinat malchut yesh lahem al hammitbarrim. vetze ulemad mimmoshe, ki letzad shehotzi yisrael mimmitzrayim kana malchut alehem.

Elle haddevarim vegomer. kavvanat hakkatuv lefi ma shepperashnu besamuch befasuk "veattem tihyu li" al yisrael, yeduyyak hakkatuv al ze hadderech: shello tachshov ki amirati "veattem tihyu li" vegomer chozeret alechem moshe veaharon, lo chen hu, ella "elle haddevarim asher tedabber el bene yisrael" ki hammaalot lahem henna. ulefi ma shepperashti shechozer al moshe, yechavven beamro elle haddevarim vegomer shello yosif alehem. veim tomar peshita shello yosif alehem, veim yesh lechashdo chas veshalom lamma lo tzivva lo bishar hammitzvot sheshshelacho ad atta?

Achen hakkavvana hi shetztzivva lo shello yefaresh divre Adonai leyisrael, ella yomar haddevarim kemot shehem. vetaam habbore, leheyot sheddikdek bidvarav inyan hayyira veinyan haahava, uchemo shepperashnum befasuk (Shemot 19:3) "ko tomar", vechash habbore lemoshe sheachar sheyyedabber divre Adonai lahem yavo levaer haddevarim lehosif zeruz meatzmo lehachenis morao belev yisrael o lehafelig beahavat habbore, laze amar elav al tedabber od baddavar hazze zulat elle haddevarim, ki im yomar moshe divre yira yavou laasot mitztzad hayyira, vaAdonai lo chen yaatz velo hizkir hayyira ella kemi shemmosif tavlin betavshil lehosif bo taam arev, uchemo shekkatavti sham shehu leval yezalzel adam beeze zeman beeze perat beamro ki lo yakpid haohev, aval kol ikkar haavoda tzericha beahava, venimtza divre moshe mafsid chas veshalom hakkavvana.

Od nire ki ratza Adonai lenassotam, veshier devarim hammaspikim lahem mehammusar umehaahava letzorech kabbalat hattora, veim lo tadutz nafsham beshamam devarim ellu – ze yaggid ki rechokim hem mittohar lev. laze im yosif moshe ledabber devarim rabbim, ben bivchinat hayyira ben bivchinat haahava, hagam sheyyomar beferush shehem divre atzmo – hare hu mafsid kavvanat habbore benisyono, hagam sheyyekabbelu, yesh makom lomar ki ritztzuyo shel moshe hu hassovev. gam yesh baze pechitut chibbat hattora veshevach bet aviha hael haggadol, asher al ken tzivva Adonai leval yosif ledabber afillu mippi atzmo davar, vehaven:

rashi: Likrat haelohim. maggid shehashshechina yatza likratam kechatan hayyotze likrat kalla, vezehu sheamar Adonai missinay ba (Devarim 33), velo neemar lesinay ba (mechilta):
Betachtit hahar. lefi feshuto beragle hahar; umidrasho shennitlash hahar mimmekomo venichpa alehem kegigit (shabbat 88):
ohc: Vayyotze moshe vegomer. ulay shelletzad cherdatam pachadu min hahar, vehotziam moshe veheemidam betachtit hahar lekabbel hattora meomed.

rashi: Vayyomer alehem. hateraa zo:
Vayyishma yitro. ma shemua shama uva? keriat yam suf umilchemet amalek:

Yitro. sheva shemot nikreu lo: reuel, yeter, yitro, chovav, chever, keni, putiel; yeter, al shem sheyyitter parasha achat battora "veatta techeze"; yitro, lichshennitgayyer vekiyyem hammitzvot, hosifo lo ot echad al shemo; chovav, shechibbev et hattora; chovav hu yitro shenneemar "mibbene chovav choten moshe" (Shoftim 4), veyesh omrim reuel aviv shel yitro, umahu omer "vattavona el reuel avihen"? shehattinokot korin laavi avihen abba. besifre:
Choten moshe. kan haya yitro mitkabbed bemoshe – ani choten hammelech, ulesheavar haya moshe tole haggedulla bechamiv, shenneemar "vayyashav el yeter chotno" (Shemot 4):
Lemoshe uleyisrael. shakul moshe keneged kol yisrael (mechilta):
Et kol asher asa. lahem biridat hamman uvabbeer uvaamalek:
Ki hotzi Adonai vegomer. zo gedola al kullam (sham):
ohc: Vayyishma vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan yichaso beyichus "chohen midyan", sheen zo maala ella yerida, umin harauy rishonot lo tizzacharna.

Veulay ki yechavven shevach haish beamro chohen midyan, lomar shehagam shehayu lo shete bechinot harmuzot bechohen midyan, shehem heyoto rosh lemidyan veaduk laavoda zara, af al pi chen asa shene devarim negdiyyim vehafekiyyim lishne happeratim. keneged heyoto gadol amar choten moshe, shennitchatten leadam shello noda lo gedulla adayin, vedavar ze yakpidu alav nohage serara, veen tzarich lomar echad hameyuchad leummato sheyyakpid latet bitto leadam belo shem. ucheneged heyoto aduk laavoda zara kammashmaut hammuvan mittevat kohen, amar hakkatuv (Shemot 18:11) ma sheamar besof hainyan: "atta yadati ki gadol Adonai mikkol haelohim". vedavar ze en bo chiddush umaala gedola beemor ken goy echad lekavo battora, ella beemtzaut ma shekkadam leyachaso beshem "kohen midyan", davar gadol hu shekkohen umma achat mehem uvahem yaid al ki hevel yiftze pihem.

Od taam amro chohen midyan, lomar beemtzaut ken hissig ladaat kol asher asa Adonai, ki laanashim haggedolim yitgalle veyivvada hakkol betzedek belo tosefet vegeraon, ma sheen ken lesheenam rashut, hagam sheyyivvada lahem hachadashot lo yedu kol haddevarim hannaasim:

Et kol asher vegomer – gam ze yaggid shevach haish shehishtaddel ladaat kol perate hammaasim, veze yaggid ki ahav et yaakov, shehalo tire ish sone lereehu yakutz behaggadat shevachav vetuvo veyechdal middaat matztzavo hattov, asher lo chen ahuv laahuvo, verasham Adonai bedato ki ze haish ahav et yisrael. od yirtze bedikduk od lamma hotzi hakkatuv perat ze shel hotzaat yisrael mimmitzrayim mikkelal kol asher asa. veod ki hu ikkar kol asher asa velo haya tzarich lefarshah.

Achen letzad ki yitro min hassetam yada tokef sheviyyat mitzrayim, kaamur bedivrehem (mechilta) ki asire mitzrayim lo puttechu meolam, uma gam ledivrehem (sanhedrin kav,1; Shemot Rabba 1,1) sheamru ki yitro haya miyyoatze paro uvaki bemitzrayim vaasireha. velaze hagam sheyyishma ki hotzi vegomer lo yatzdik hayyetzia belibbo, laze hikdim hakkatuv davar shemmimmennu hitzdik "ki hotzi", veamar vayyishma yitro et kol asher asa, perush kol hanniflaot vehannoraot asher asa Adonai behatzedakat navi, vehu amro asher asa lemoshe vehanniflaot sheasa lehatztzalat yisrael, ben birdiyyat machazik bam ben behafelaatam mehammakkot ben benes hayyam vechulei, uvaze yada ki hotzi vegomer, velaze lo amar "vechi hotzi", vezulat shemiat kol hannaase mehappelaim lo haya matzdik hagam sheyyishma sheshshillecham, ki lo yaamin, veim yaamin lo yivtach ki yomar shuv yirdefu acharehem, veim radfu velo yachlu yachinu od machane veyirdefu.

Achen bema sheshshama kol asher vegomer hitzdik "ki hotzi". vetimtza ki rabbotenu zichronam livracha nechleku (zevachim 116,1) beeze mehashshemuot nirgash, mehem amru keriat yam suf umehem amru milchemet amalek, veze matim lidvarenu. uledivre haomer milchemet amalek mimma shessamach lo "vayyishma", ze yaggid ki lo hispik lo kol ma sheshshama mehanniflaot, ki yitle shehassovev hu pachazuto shel paro shehitris keneged shelucho shel makom, lo letzorech hatztzalat yisrael, ki lo haya Adonai toreach kol kach bishvilam. uchefi ze en bittachon leyisrael meammim asher yakumu alehem, laze amar hakkatuv sheshshama milchemet amalek, uchevar hifliu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta) lomar ma atzma hammilchama haarura. venire lefaresh lederech ze amro "ki hotzi", perush, letzad sheshshama kol asher asa uvichlal ze milchemet amalek, baze hitzdik ki chol hammoftim lo hayu ella lemaala ulechibbat yisrael lehotziam, uvishvilam asa kol asher asa, ushemiat amalek yaggid.

Od yirtze beamro ki hotzi lismoch achareha haggadat kichat yitro et tzippora vegomer, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 4,4) ki amar yitro lemoshe: lamma atta molich ishtecha vechulei? amar lo: atidin yisrael lekabbel hattora al har sinay velo yihyu banay bakkelal. amar lo: lech leshalom vechulei, ad kan, velaze amar hakkatuv ki hotzi vayyikkach vegomer lekayyem devaro.

rashi: Ad matay yachbidu et libbam velo yishmeu?
Vayyomer. yadati ki lo yashivu ad tavo puranut alehem, veyelchu baggola, veshau arehem meen yoshev.
Shau… tishshae leshon galmud meen yoshev.
targum: Vaamarit ad ematay Adonai vaamar ad deyitzdun kirvaya mibbeli yatev uvattaya mibbeli enasha veara techeruv vetitzde:
