rashi: Shimu shamoa. ani omer lachem shimu shamoa, veattem en attem notnim lev lehavin, ureu nissim sheasiti lachem, veenchem notnim lev ladaat oti:
targum: Vaamar ezel vetemar leama haden deshamin mishma vela mistakkelin vachazo mechza vela yadin:

rashi: Simcha laish bemaane fiv. kemashmao: al yede maane rach vedibbur nachat, habberiyyot ohavim oto. verabbotenu derashuhu al baale girsa (sanhedrin ka.): im motzim befihem maane, az titkayyem bam veyismechu:
Vedavar beitto ma tov. shoalim behilchot happesach uvehilchot hechag bizmanno (fesachim 6.):
targum: Chedvata legavra bemilta defumeh umilta veidana segu tava:

rashi: Veatta. im atta tekabbelu alechem, yeerav lachem mikkan vaelach, shekkol hatechalot kashot (mechilta):
Ushemartem et beriti. sheechrot immachem al shemirat hattora:

Segulla. otzar chaviv, kemo "usegullat melachim" (Kohelet 2) – kele yekar vaavanim tovot shehammelachim gonzim otam, kach attem tihyu li segulla mishshear ummot; velo tomru attem levaddechem shelli veen li acherim immachem uma yesh li od shettehe chibbatchem nikkeret:
Ki li kol haaretz vehem beenay ulefanay lichlum:
ohc: Veatta im vegomer. amro veatta, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 101) en veatta ella teshuva, ki letzad shehayu yisrael meluchlachim becherme haavonot asher kadmu lahem vegam hachadashim mikkarov bau behameraatam, kakkatuv battora kamma perate chataim bamman basselav bashshabbat bammayim, vechaasher ratza el elyon latet hattora zakka uvara yesod hakkedushsha vehattohora veruchaniyyut haruchaniyyut, tzivva lahem sheyyachzeru bitshuva afillu mechet kal. uchevar kadam lanu maamaram zichronam livracha (kiddushin mat,2) bedin hamekaddesh et haishsha al menat shehu tzaddik gamur venimtza rasha shekkiddushav kiddushin, ki chayshinan shemma asa teshuva uveemtzaut teshuvato yikkare tzaddik. od yitbaer besamuch:

Im shamoa tishmeu vegomer. tzarich ledakdek taam kefel shamoa tishmeu, veulay yechavven Adonai letzauotam al kabbalat shete torot: achat asher yashmiem beoto matztzav, veachat hi tora shebbeal pe vedikduke sofrim usefarim vegidre chachamim vetakkanotam ugezeratam asher yoru, karamuz bemitzvat (Devarim 17:11) "lo tasur mikkol haddavar asher yaggidu lecha yamin usemol". velaze amar keneged ma shemmashmiam mehammitzvot az amar shamoa, ucheneged torot haatidim mippi chachme yisrael amar tishmeu leatid. ulederech ze yeduyyak al nachon amro veatta im shamoa, ki leheyot shemmetzavve beamro tishmeu al heatid, laze samach veatta im shamoa lomar, im shamoa atta vetishmeu leatid kannizkar.

Vedikdek lomar bekoli, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 14) shomea mippi chacham vechulei keshomea mippi haggevura, vehu amro ki mitzva zo sheani omer lachem shettekabbelu takkanat chacham tzarich shettihye lachem shave keillu ani hishmatiha vehiggadtiha lachem.

Veulay ki baze yityashshev maamaram zichrono livracha (shabbat pach,1) sheddarshu bappasuk (Shemot 19,17) "vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar" shekkafa alehem hahar kegigit veamar lahem: im attem mekabbelim vechulei veim lav sham tehe kevuratchem. vekashe, vahalo hem amru (Shemot 24,7) "kol asher dibber Adonai naase venishma", uma makom lichfiyya zo? vehattosafot tertzu sham shemma hayu chozrim kesheyyiru haesh haggedola sheyyatzta nishmatan, ad kan. veen divrehem nirim, ki adrabba yosifu pachad vafachat veyiru yirat harommut. ulefi ma shepperashti ki Adonai amar lahem shete torot, achat mippiv az veachat leatid mippi chachamim kannizkar, nuchal lefaresh teshuvatam sheamru "kol asher dibber Adonai naase venishma" shekkavvanatam hi al ze haofen: kol asher dibber Adonai chelek mimmennu shehu ma sheamar veatta im shamoa shehu inyan hanneemar mippi haggevura az, naase – anu mekabbelin alenu laasot meatta kodem shennishmaehu. vechelek mimmennu shehu ma sheamar tishmeu leatid shehu torat chacham – venishma, perush, lo kibbelu velo meanu ella talu haddavar ad sheyyishmeu ladaat ma yaase yisrael, ki hem devarim sheen lahem shiur veen gevul lekabbala zo, ki bechol dor vador yechaddeshu dinim ugedarim useyagim vetakkanot, umi yechalkel tora sheen lah shiur kazo? laze talu sheyyihye haddavar birshutam ad sheyyishmeu veyivchanu bechol davar im yuchelu kabbel. umeatta lo kibbelu alehem ella tora shebbichtav, aval tora shebbeal pe haddavar taluy veomed. veal ze kafa Adonai alehem hahar kegigit ad shekkibbelu alehem torat chacham, uveones haya ad yeme mardechay sherau peullat chacham lechayyim asher asu lahem mardechay veester, chazru lekabbel beratzon lekayyem kol davar asher yechaddeshu vitakkenu alehem chachmehem, achar asher rau ma gadlu maase hatztzaddikim shezzulatam lo haya nishar roshem missonehem shel yisrael. vahagam sherabbotenu zichrono livracha (shabbat pach,1) darshu amram "naase venishma" beofen acher leshevach, sheddamu lemalachim shekkadmu lomar hammaase kodem hashshemia kammalachim shemmakdimin (tehillim 103,20) "ose devaro" kodem "lishmoa bekol devaro", ze derech derash. vegam ledarkenu hare amru "naase" kodem sheyyishmeu velo hikdimu hashshemia ella betorat chacham. o efshar shehakkatuv nitkavven lishne happerushim, echad batztzaddikim veechad bishar haam, ki peshita shemmin hassetam lo yishvu haderagot yisrael yachad betzidkut.

Od yirmoz bechefel shamoa tishmeu ma shehaya achar haemet bekabbalat hattora al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (horayot 8,1) ki shete dibberot shemaum mippi haggevura ushemone mippi hammalach shennivra middibburo yitbarach, laze amar im shamoa tishmeu – shete haderagot hashshemia, vedikdek lomar keneged shemia sheyyishmeu mammash mehaggevura tishmeu bekoli velo amar lekoli, vehaven:

Od yirtze lomar, ki im yatchil lishmoa hattora, mishsham vaelach hu yitavve lishmoa od, vehu amro im shamoa – atta ani mavtichachem ki tishmeu meatzmechem keshettitamu tamah, keamro (tehillim 34:9) "taamu ureu ki tov Adonai".

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota ka:) tora ben vechulei maggena umatztzela, vehu amro im shamoa perush, im tihye hashshemia ze yihye lachem lishte toaliyyot: haachat sheattem shomim kolo yitbarach divre elohim sheyyesh bahem hachayyim vetichyu, keamro (yeshaya 55:3) "shimu utechi nafshechem", vehashsheniyya ushemartem et beriti perush sheyyagen alechem miyyetzer hara. ulederech ze hirvachnu gezerat haddibbur shemmekomo hu tishmeu vegomer, sheikkar hammitzva hu shemiat hattora umimmenna nimshachim kol hattoaliyyot: ha shehem nehenim mikkol elohim chayyim, 2 yihyu shomrim hammitzvot velo yishlot bahem yetzer hara, 3 "vihyitem li segulla" vegomer. ulefi ma shepperashti lemala ki amro "tishmeu" hu letora shebbeal pe, tihye gezerat hakkatuv ushemartem vegomer ki beemtzaut hattora tatztzilehu miyyetzer hara hammachtio, veamro betosefet vav, lomar millevad shettihye lachem yedia mimmenna lehavechin ben tov lera, od lachem shettassigu hashshemira velo yishlot bachem hassatan.

Od yechavven hakkatuv al ze hadderech: veatta im shamoa, perush tachinu atzmechem lishmoa ani ashmiachem et koli, perush shello adabber immachem al yede shaliach. gam ramaz ki beemtzaut sheyyishmeu haddevarim mimmennu yitbarach mishshemia achat yishmeu od shemiot rabbot, al derech amro (tehillim 68:12) "Adonai yitten omer hamevasserot tzava rav", vetidle nafsham mayim chayyim chachma utevuna. veze shiur hakkatuv im shamoa, perush, shemia shemmimmenna tishmeu od shemiot rabbot hi shemia bekoli, vehu amro tishmeu bekoli. od yesh lachem toelet baze ushemartem et beriti, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:2 befasuk yashkeni) ki hashshomea tora mippi adam hi omedet lishkoach mimmennu, ma sheen ken hashshomea mippi elyon shemura laad uleolamim, vehu amro "ushemartem et beriti".

Gam yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat kamu.) yisrael sheamdu al har sinay paska zuhamatan, vehakkavvana hi ki beemtzaut dibbur Adonai lahem bechoach bigde malchut shennatan lahem shehi nefesh adam, uveemtzaut ken titratztze hannefesh limos begiule goyim hammitavvim hara, vehu amro ushemartem et beriti:

Vihyitem li vegomer. hakkavvana baze hi, ki keshem shehassegulla hu davar sheeno kefi hatteva, ki halo timtza ki yesh esev shettivo kar usegullato lerappeot choli hakkerirut, vechen yesh esev cham vechulei, veze eno kefi hatteva ella devar segulla, uchemo chen mavticham Adonai sheyyihyu segulla gam shello kefi hameshoar.

Veyesh harebe anafim behavetacha zo. rishona al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat 63,1) chashav adam miyyisrael laasot mitzva veneenas velo asaah notnim lo sachar keillu asaah, velo chen baavera, uvaummot eno chen ella lehefech. veen ze mehannishar kefi hassechel, mimma nafshach im hammachshava taase davar im ken taase bechoshev ra, veim lo taase ella bivchinat hattov velo bivchinat hara im ken baummot lamma behefech? od timtza (sanhedrin 59,1) kuti sheosek battora o sheshshavat chayyav mita, vaafillu shear mitzvot en lo laasot, velamma im happeulla mitztzad atzmah peulla tova, kol haose hare ze ose davar tov? laze amar hakkatuv vihyitem li segulla mikkol haammim, ki en peulla tova yotza ella miyyedchem sheen segullat hattora vehammitzvot ella mikkem. veamro ki li kol haaretz, perush ki yomar haomer ki havetacha zo sheyyihyu segulla lo tutzdak ella kesheyyihyu haummot chafetzim lilmod velaasot vegomer, baze yutzdak lomar sheasanu segulla. aval roani (sifre beracha) ki adrabba meanu haammim lekabbel tora umitzvot kesheddibber Adonai lefaran veseir, umeatta bamme yukkar toviyyut havetachat hammaala? laze amar ki li kol haaretz, kan hodia Adonai ki en lecha umma veumma sheen bah makkire elohuto yitbarach, vechen hu omer (Malachi 1:11) "muktar muggash lishmi" vegomer, hare ki chol haggoyim lo yichreu veaf al pi chen lo yittelu sachar al haddavar velo yaase maasehem roshem, vezo hi segullatam shel yisrael.

Od yirtze sheyyihyu segulla, vehassegulla hi sheyyihyu meyuchadim lo beyichud laavod elohe olam mikkol haammim, ki gam kol haammim li hem, perush, avodatam li hu, ki enam ovdim ella limshartav. ha ketzad? ovdim lashshemesh velayyareach velitzva hashshamayim, halo kullam meshammeshav yitbarach, venimtzaim ovdim laavadav, keamro (Devarim 4:19) "asher chalak Adonai vegomer lechol haammim".

Uma shemmatzinu shemmarad paro vesancheriv vechulei, hu bederech taut veshiggayon. ha lema haddavar dome? lemelech shennechba veyatza lifne sheenam makkirim oto, hare hu kehedyot, velifamim avadav atzmam yezalzelu bo kifchut happechutim. kemo chen paro lo yada ki hu ze haadon hashshallit al mi shechoshev shehu eloho. nimtzeta omer ki chol haaretz limsharte malchuto yishtachavu, uvachar lo leyisrael sheyyaavduhu lo beyichud vaasaam segulla.

Vehitztzatzti behasekalat davar ze sheamru zichronam livracha besifre befarashat vezot habberacha, veze leshonam: keshennigla Adonai al yisrael latet hattora, halach etzel bene esav, amar lahem: "mekabbelim attem hattora?" amru lo: "ma katuv bah?" veamar lahem: "lo tirtzach". amru lefanav: "ribbono shel olam, kol atzmo shel oto avihem rotzeach haya, veal kach hivticho aviv 'veal charbecha tichye". halach etzel ammon umoav vechulei, amru lo: "ma katuv bah?" "lo tinaf" vegomer, amru lo: "kol atzmah shel erva lahem hi". halach umatza bene yishmael, amar lahem vechulei: "lo tignov" vechulei, "ribbono shel olam, kol atzmo shel avihem listim haya" vechulei ad kan. hinne maamar ze tamuah hu, ki ma yitzdak enosh im el, uma taana pechuta zo, vechi bishvil sheavihem rasha hi taana hannishmaat? veod, mi sheachal shum verecho vechulei, vetigdal hakkushya ech kibbel Adonai et taanatam kenishma sheyyesh bah mammash.

Achen askilcha ki kol asher enecha techezena betoratenu, ben bemitzvot ase ben bemitzvot lo taase, taam haddevarim hu ki Adonai bachan bema shebbara vehikkir bechinat hara vehivdilanu mimmennu, uvachan bechinat hattov vekiddeshanu bo. vehu maamar hazzohar (Tikkunei Zohar tikun ka) befasuk "vaase li matammim kaasher ahavti" – mimmitzvot ase, velo kaasher saneti – mimmitzvot lo taase. vechen hu maamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha besifra (mechilta pasuk "ki ani Adonai ravepaach"): amar Adonai lemoshe, emor lahem leyisrael divre tora sheani noten lachem refua hem lachem, chayyim hem lachem, ad kan. kafal lomar "refua" vechayyim" keneged mitzvot lo taase umitzvot ase: refua – leval techelu beachlechem o baasotchem mehammaasim haraim, vechayyim – hem baasotchem maasim asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem. vetimtza ki beet tzauot Adonai al devarim haasurim yomar (Vayikra 11:43): "al teshakketzu et nafshotechem", "al tittammeu" vegomer (Vayikra 18:24), gam yazkir haarayot beshem toeva vechaddome laze, lehaggid ba haelohim ki chol machshevotav hem lishmor otanu lihyot bivchinat hakkedushsha vetzivvanu lihyot kedoshim.

Veyesh lecha ladaat ki chol bechinat maase hara yesh lah shoresh bivchinat ruach hattuma, vechol bechinat maase hattov hi bechinat shoresh hakkedushsha vehattohora. vehinne kol mitzva shetztzivvanu Adonai aleha leval asotah shemah hu shem bechinat hara shemmimmennu hu, kemo shettomar shikkutz hanniuf shoresh bechinat hara kach shemo, haggezel kemo chen kach shem shoresh bechinat hara, uveet asot haadam mifal hara hinne hu machazik sharsho hara, uveet sheyyihye nizhar measoto hinne hu bittulo, uchemo sheppershu bemaamaram zichronam livracha (midrash tehillim tzav) befasuk "hinne oyvecha Adonai" vegomer.

Veda ki maase haadam yaggid al shoresh nafsho, im shoresh rosh velaana shehu bechinat hara, o im shoresh hammatok vehearev shehu bechinat hakkedushsha, uchevar katavti anaf mizze befarashat vaychi befasuk "reuven bechori" vegomer (Bereshit 49:3). uvaze matzanu meor habbarayta shebbanu aleha, ki taana nitztzachat taanu shelosh hakkittot: esav, yishmael, ammon umoav, kol echad lema shennaga lo. esav amar ki shoresh nafshotam hu mibbechinat hara hahu sheshshemo retzicha, mimmennu hu kemaasehu, uveet kabbalatam haddavar ze hu shelilat havayatam, uchemo chen ammon umoav veyishmael. veze hu sheddikdek kol echad veamar "kol atzmo shel avihem" vechulei, perush kol havayato hu banuy mibbechinat hara sheshshemah rotzeach, uchemo chen amru moav vechulei atzmah shel erva, perush sheatta metzavve aleha lahem hi, perush hem bechinatah veech yekabbelu hahafkiyyut, im ken ze hu bittulam. vechen yishmael amar "kol atzmo shel avihem listim haya", perush bechinat hara hannikret listim, umaasehem haya maggid al bechinat nafsham meeze makom baa. vehinne ammon umoav hochichu betaanatam meikkar havayatam shehayta mibbechinat hanniuf, aval edom veyishmael lo hukkar haddavar meikkar habbinyan, ella yishmael al pi malach sheamar (Bereshit 16:12) "vehu yihye pere adam yado vakkol", hare ki maggid lah sharsho ki hu ze, veesav al pi yitzchak keamro (Bereshit 27:40) "veal charbecha", perush, sheatta meotah bechina.

Vaessa enay vaere chibbat hakkodesh hu adon yisrael asher hitnaheg im haammim beseder ze, lehakedim lechol echad mehem mitzva sheyyesh lahem taana kenegdah, ki ulay sheyyada sheyyekabbelu kevan sheen lahem taana kenegdah, venitchakkem baruch hu kede shello yitlu sachar al kabbalat mitzva rishona sheen lahem aleha maane, ufatach devarav lahem rommot el lehashemidam minnachalat shadday uvachar lo yah leammo segulla. vehinne derech ze amro vihyitem li segulla hu gezerat happasuk, uchefi ze taam amro betosefet vav, letosefet sachar millevad shear perate hammussag mehammaalot od lachem shettihyu segulla kannizkar, velo hutzrach lehazekiram ki muvanim mimmashmaut tosefet vav shel "vihyitem" vegomer. od yirtze betosefet vav lirmoz inyan acher, vehu ki lo yite levavam lachshov ki hu haadon baruch hu chas veshalom tzarich lahem leshum davar, lo chen hu ella segulla kammelachim shechafetzim bidvar segulla shehu keli yakar hagam sheen lahem tzorech bo, gam attem tihyu li even yekara beerech kol haammim, velo shehaddavar hu etzli letzorech, ki li kol haaretz perush, umeatta lo yutzdak lomar sheyyesh li tzorech baddavar, ucheamro (Iyov la,7) "im tzadakta ma titten lo", ki hakkol shello yitbarach.
Od yirmoz lema sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat kamu,1) yisrael sheamdu al har sinay paska zuhamatan, vezo hi segullatan mikkol haammim shello paska zuhamatan.

Od yirmoz seter elyon lefi ma shekkadam lanu, ki anfe hakkedushsha nitpazzeru baolam, veen metziut lahem lehitbarer zulat beemtzaut yisrael, uveyoter beemtzaut esek hattora shehi keeven hashshoevet nitzotzeha bemakom shehem, veotam nitzotze hakkedushsha gam lahem yikkare segulla. vehu amro vihyitem, karinan beh "vehuyyitem", perush beHei melafum, ki hem yihyu havayat segulla mikkol haammim asher nafotzu sham beemtzaut hattora, kemaamaram zichronam livracha uchemo shekkatavnu kamma peamim haddevarim bemaase mitzrayim. veamro ki li kol haaretz, kan ramaz sheyyesh lo segulla mefuzzeret bechol haaretz, veze taam pizzur yisrael bearba ruchot haolam, lechazzer achar hassegulla shehi avedatam. vehinne zulat avonam shel yisrael hayu yecholim hassagat haddavar belo pizzur baolam, ella bechoach otzem toratam hayu molchim bechol haolam veshoavim kol bechinot hakkedoshot mikkol makom shehem, uveemtzaut hachet tash kocham utzerichin laredet shamma levarer hattov hahu.

rashi: Lo takum. atzatam zot, shettehe yehuda kevusha tachtehem:
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai elohim la tekum vela teheve:

rashi: Heyu nechonim lishloshet yamim. lesof 3 yamim, hu yom revii, shehosif moshe yom echad middato kedivre rabbi yose, uledivre haomer beshishsha vachodesh nittenu aseret haddibberot, lo hosif moshe chelum, velishloshet yamim kemo layyom hashshelishi:

El tiggeshu el ishsha. kol 3 yamim hallalu, kede sheyyihyu hannashim tovlot layyom hashshelishi vetihyena tehorot lekabbel tora, sheim yeshammeshu toch 3 yamim shemma tiflot haishsha shichvat zera leachar tevilatah vetachazor vetittamme, aval mishsheshshahata 3 yamim, kevar hazzera masriach veeno rauy lehazeria, vetahor milletamme et happoletet (shabbat 86):
Vayyanuu ammot hassippim. "elvat sippe" (targum yonatan), hem mezuzot happetach, shennimdadin bemiddot ammot legova ulerochav, vehen mezuzot hahechol:

Mikkol hakkore. mikkol hammalachim hakkorim, vehu haya yom haraash shenneemar bo "venastem kaasher nastem mippene haraash bime uzziyya" (Zecharya 14:5). bo bayyom amad uzziyya lehaketir bahechol, raashu shamayim lesarfo lomar: dino bisrefa, kemo shenneemar "vattochal et hachamishshim umatayim ish" (Bamidbar 16:35), vezehu shekkeraam serafim shebbau lesarfo. raasha haaretz levalo, kisvura: dino libbala kekorach sheirer al hakkehunna. yatzta bat kol veamra: "zikkaron livne yisrael vegomer" (Bamidbar 17:5), velo yihye od adam hameorer al hakkehunna kekorach bivlia vechaadato bisrefa, ella kaasher dibber Adonai beyad moshe bassene "have na yadcha bechekecha" (Shemot 4:6), vehotziah metzoraat kashsheleg; af kan tzaraat parcha bemitzcho:
Vehabbayit yimmale ashan. haya nimla ashan:
targum: Vezau elvat sippe hechla mikal milula uvet makdesha itmele amitta:

rashi: Asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim. keday hi hahotzaa shettihyu meshubadim li; davar acher, lefi shennigla vayyam kegibbor milchama venigla kan kezaken male rachamim, – shenneemar vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir (Shemot 24), zo hayta lefanav bishat hashshibud, ucheetzem hashshamayim, mishshennigalu – hoil vaani mishtanne vemarot, al tomru shete rashuyot hen, anochi hu asher hotzeticha mimmitzrayim veal hayyam. davar acher lefi shehayu shomin kolot harebe, shenneemar et hakkolot – kolot bain mearba ruchot umin hashshamayim umin haaretz – al tomru rashuyot harebe hen; velama amar leshon yachid elohecha? litten pitchon pe lemoshe lelammed sanegorya bemaase haegel, veze sheamar lama Adonai yechere appecha beammecha – lo lahem tzivvita lo yihye lachem elohim acherim ella li levaddi (Shemot Rabba):

Mibbet avadim. mibbet paro sheheyitem avadim lo, o eno omer ella mibbet avadim shehayu avadim laavadim? talo vayyifdecha mibbet avadim miyyad paro melech mitzrayim (Devarim 7), emor meatta avadim lammelech hayu velo avadim laavadim (mechilta):
ohc: Anochi Adonai elohecha vegomer. taam kefel asher hotzeticha meeretz vegomer mibbet avadim, peshat haddevarim hu shekkavvanato lehagedil otzem sheviyyatam shehayu beeretz mitzrayim, makom sheasirav lo fatach (Yeshayahu 14:17) vegomer, nosaf al hafelagat tumatah, veod shehayu sham begeder avadim vehotzianu Adonai.

Od yechavven Adonai lomar al ze hadderech: anochi Adonai elohecha – hinne hizkir bitchillat divre Adonai shene inyanim: haechad heyoto Adonai baruch hu shem havaya, ze yaggid haemuna ki mimmennu yitbarach uvemaamaro haya kol hove vechol ma shehaya uma sheyyihye, gam yaggid al havayato yitbarach haya vehove veyihye. vehashsheni amar "elohecha", perush shealehem lekabbel maamaro ugezerotav, vechol hammamre et piv yakkennu eloah. ucheneged shete bechinot ellu ba haelokim lehacheriach kol achat mehem behochacha sheen aleha taana. keneged amro anochi Adonai, ze lecha haot asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim. da ki beemtzaut yetziat mitzrayim huchchashu kol haddovrim sheker sheyyesh chas veshalom emuna zulato, ki huchchashu hammeorot ki lo elohim hemma behacheshich Adonai meoram, huchchashu hayyammim ki Adonai asa bahem otot vahafacham ledam, huchchasha haaretz behakkotah Adonai vattishrotz sheratzim raim, huchchashu baale chayyim sheen bahem uvemazzalam chozek, huchchashu kol elohot baasot Adonai bahem shefatim, hare ki Adonai hu adon kol hove vesholet al hove umachchido vegozer al ayin veyihye kaasher ene chol yisrael root. ucheneged ma sheamar elohecha shetztzerichin lekabbelo alehem leeloah lekayyem kol devarav, amar taam haddavar mibbet avadim, perush, ki letzad shehayita eved lazzulat vaani hotzeticha meavdutam, shurat haddin notenet ki tekabbel elohuti alecha lekayyem kol davar.

Od yirtze bechefel meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim lehodia sod kamus kayyadua leyode chen, ki nishmot yisrael sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim hen henna shehayu tevuim betumat mitzrayim, uveemtzaut yaakov avinu uvanav asher yardu mitzrayim hotziu otam, keamro (Bereshit 46:3) "ki legoy gadol asimcha sham". veayyen ma shepperashti sham, veamru yode nistarot laAdonai ki hu atzmo sheamar hakkatuv alav (Devarim 4:7) "ki mi goy gadol" vegomer sheamdu behar sinay. uchefi ze yitbaer hakkatuv al nachon amro asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim hu hotzaat hanneshamot mishshivyatam betumat mitzrayim, perush shebberram beemtzaut moatzotav yitbarach, aval odam bemitzrayim bevet avdut, veamar mibbet avadim keneged ma shehotzi haam hamevorar leval yishtabedu bahem sonehem.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (yerushalmi socha 5,4) beferush "yoshev tehillot yisrael" ki lo nitratztza hakkadosh baruch hu bithillat mehallelav kesheamru elohe olam velo elohe hammalachim, ella kesheamru "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael", vehu amro anochi Adonai elohecha, perush shello nitratztzeti beshum kinnuy hammaalot ella bikriato elohecha, uvaze pirsem maalot yisrael baelyonim. ucheneged pirsum battachtonim amar asher hotzeticha vegomer, perush makom sheen metziut latzet mishsham, vehayta hotzaatcha pirsum gadol lechavod uletifaret. vetze ulemad middivre yitro shehu echad hameyuchad mehaummot. veamro mibbet avadim, perush lo hotzeticha bederech sheyyishshaer alecha shem avdut. hammashal, im haya Adonai motziam bederech bericha vechaddome, hagam shehayta hahatztzala nechona, af al pi chen shem avdut lo yeaker mehem ki elle avde faro. umimma shehotziam bechamma noraot ad sheamar paro "hare attem leatzmechem, hare attem bene chorin" vechulei (yalkut Rosh Chodesh), veod lo kesheradaf sheasa Adonai happele haggadol behatebaato bayyam, baze paka shem avdut mehem.

Od yirtze ledabber im hannefesh veim hagguf. keneged hanneshama asher takkir bechinat haruchaniyyut amar anochi Adonai elohecha, ki hanneshama takkir bechinat haelohut. veulay beoto rega atzmo hayta yetziat hannefesh vehikkira eloah shellah kesheamar lah "anochi", velaze amar leshon yachid elohecha, ki bechinat hanneshamot hakkedoshot mitachedet hi veen bahem perud beolam happerud shehu olam hazze. vetimtza sheamar david bedivre hayyamim (1 17,21): "umi cheammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz", perush afillu baaretz bimkom happerud hem goy echad, ki nitkaddeshu venaasu baaretz kemalachim, vehu hashshevach shemmeshabbecham bo david alav hashshalom. ucheneged bechinat hagguf vechayyuto shehu bechinat haddome lechayyut habbahami, amar hakkarat chesed olam hazze ki lo tuchal bechon becheshek ruchaniyyut hannaor.

Od yirtze anochi Adonai elohecha, perush, kodem biatcha laolam hazze, ki atta or meor hakkadosh chelek Adonai, keamro (Devarim 32,9) "chelek Adonai ammo". uvechina zo taggidenna tevat "elohecha", ki lo yityaches davar ze ella livchinat hakkedushsha shehu meoro yitbarach, kayyadua leyode chen vechannirmaz berubbe maamre razal. veamro asher vegomer, perush, asher al ken hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim, uvaze higgid taam asher hirim vehirish Adonai tevel veyoshveha shamayim utzevaeha bishvil yisrael lehotziam, ki mehannimna sheyyatztzil chelke hakkedushsha ulekarvam elav.
Od yirtze al ze hadderech, anochi Adonai, perush, ben bizman sheani mitchassed immecha ehye lecha leribbon, ben bizman sheani meyasserecha umochichacha ehye elohecha.

Od yirtze al derech amro (Tehillim 116:4) "kos yeshuot vegomer uveshem Adonai ekra tzara veyagon vegomer uveshem" vegomer, vedarshu zichronam livracha (berachot 60,1) mevarchin al haraa besimcha keshem vechulei, vehattaam ki bechinat hammusar meAdonai eno ella letzad hattov vehachesed, vehu amro anochi Adonai perush middat hachesed veharachamim afillu kizman elohecha, perush sheani meyasserecha.

Od yirtze beamro meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim al ze hadderech: ani asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim, ani atid lehotziacha mibbet avadim, veze yirmoz al galut haacharon asher shibedu beyisrael kol umma velashon kammishpat haragil beeved, veramaz Adonai ki yotzienu mibbayit ze.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim, veim tomar velamma hotzetanu mishsham velo higdalta chasdecha immanu shehaya Adonai mamshil yisrael sham beeretz oyvehem veyaavidu beovdehem veyishletu bahem veyikchu et artzam miyyadam veyeshvu vah leenehem, veyesh baze yoter nachat ruach leyisrael vehaggadat otzem hayyecholet ki yesh elohim shoftim baaretz vesholtim bah. laze amar Adonai ki taam haddavar hu letzad shehaaretz hi bet avadim, perush al derech amro (Devarim 32:8) "behanechel elyon vegomer yatztzev gevulot ammim", veamru zichronam livracha (zohar 9 108:) ki Adonai chillek mekomot haolam lesare mala zulat eretz kenaan asher bachar lo lishmo kivyachol, vehu amro mibbet avadim, perush, makom shehu shel avadim shel Adonai, perush shemmemshalto memshelet sar echad meavde Adonai, velo ratza Adonai sheyyihyu yisrael tachat memshelet hassarim ella tachat memshalto yitbarach bakkol, vehotziam meeretz mitzrayim letzad shehi bet avadim latet lahem eretz asher hi bet elohim.

rashi: Serafim omdim mimmaal. bashshamayim:
Lo. leshammesho, ken tirgem yonatan: "shammeshin kaddishin beroma kodamohi":
Bishtayim yechasse fanav. shello yabbit letzad hashshechina:

Uvishtayim yechasse raglav. litzniut, shello yerae kol gufo lifne boro. uvetanchuma (tanchuma, emor 8) raiti: kissuy haraglayim lefi shehem "kechaf regel egel" (Yechezkel 1:7), shello lehazekir leyisrael avon haegel:
Uvishtayim yeofef. uvitren meshammesh:
targum: Shamashin kadishin beruma kodamohi shitta gappin lechad shitta gappin lechad bitrin mechase appohi dela chaze uvitren mechase geviyateh dela mitchaze uvitren meshamesh:

rashi: Vayhi bime achaz. ma raa hakkatuv leyachaso? ella mippene shessofo shel hakkatuv lomar velo yachol lehillachem aleha, ulelammedcha shezzechut avot amda lo. amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: "vavy, mi hu ze shemmalach rasha ze?" amar lahem: "ben yotam hu, ben uzziyyahu hu, avotav hayu tzaddikim, lefichach i efshi lifshot yadi bo". hada hu velo yachol lehillachem aleha mippene zechut avotav (Bereshit Rabba 63, 1):
targum: Vahava beyome achaz bar yotam bar uziya melach shivta devet yehuda selik retzin malka daaram ufekach bar remalyahu deyisrael lirushelem leagacha kerava alah vela yachil leagacha alah:

rashi: Navol tibbol. ketargumo, uleshono leshon kemisha, paleyyshateraa belaaz, kemo "veheale navel" (Yirmeyahu 8), "kinvol ale miggefen" (Yeshayahu 34), shehu chamush al yede chamma veal yede kerach vechocho tash venile:
Gam atta. lerabbot aharon vechur veshivim zekenim:
Ki chaved mimmecha. kavdo rav yoter mikkochacha:
ohc: Navol tibbol. kafal lomar navol vegomer, lihyot ki yesh shene gedarim bemashmaut tibbol, haechad kol sheyyiggara kol shehu mikkocho harishon yikkare alav halleut laerech hakkodem, aval al kol panim yachol asot ma shehaya ose kodem bimat yegia. vehashsheni hu halleut hannirgash lechol shehu geder hammonea haadam measot cheftzo letzad ki lo yishshaer bo koach, laze amar elav ki ma sheyyaggia elav mehalleut koach lo shiur muat ella shiur shekkefi haemet yikkare lo tibbol, vehu ma sheggamar omer lo tuchal asohu levaddech. o ulay shekkafal keneged ma sheamar "gam atta gam" vegomer.

Gam atta gam haam hazze. taam amro gam bachalukka rishona usheniyya, yirtze lo mibbaya zulatcha bematztzav ze ella gam atta ki rav chelcha, veamro gam haam hazze perush yisrael letzad shetztzerichin lehametin ze laze baddin kammaase haamur bainyan "vayyaamod" vegomer, veamro tevat gam letzad shettarcham eno mekubbatz beyachid.

Verabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta) amru "gam" – ze aharon, "haam" – ellu hashshivim zekenim. vetzarich ladaat taam rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheppershu chen, veim letzad "gam" haya lahem lefaresh kemo shepperashnu. achen letzad sherau ki baatzato amar sheyyemanne sach gadol miyyisrael sare alafim vegomer sheole bahem leminyan shemone revavot, gilla dato ki lo yaspiku shivim zekenim. uledivrehem zichronam livracha yitparesh amro gam millevad hazzekenim, vegam shenit perush millevad moshe, veyesh revuta bechol echad, moshe letzad maalato, vehazzekenim letzad heyotam rabbim. o efshar shennitkavven beamro gam atta lerabbot haam sheyyaggia lahem halleut anashim kesheyyihyu mamtinim ze laze baddin, veamro gam sheni lerabbot haggam sheyyitztaref hu im hazzekenim.

Dabber vegomer. perush, veim letzad ki kesheyyedabber Adonai immanu nekabbel gezerotav, meatta hare anu mekabbelin mimmecha, veim ken en tzorech baddavar, velamma nistakken? vehu amro pen namut. od yirtze al ze hadderech dabber atta immanu venishmaa, perush, yihye koach banu lishmoa, aval im yedabber Adonai immanu – pen namut velo nishma:

rashi: Vechol haam roim. melammed shello haya vahem echad suma, uminnayin shello haya vahem illem? talo vayyaanu chol haam, uminnayin shello haya vahem cheresh? talo naase venishma (mechilta):
Roim et hakkolot. roin et hannishma, shei efshar lirot bemakom acher:
Et hakkolot. hayyotzin mippi haggevura:
Vayyanuu. en nua ella zia:

Vayyaamdu merachok. hayu nirtain laachorehem shenem asar mil, keorech machanehem, umalache hashsharet bain umesayyein otan lehachaziram, shenneemar (Tehillim 68) malache tzevaot yiddodun yiddodun (shabbat 88):

Vayyered Adonai al har sinay. yachol yarad alav mammash, talo ki min hashshamayim dibbarti immachem (Shemot 20), melammed shehirkin shamayim haelyonim vehattachtonim vehitztzian al gabbe hahar kematztza al hammitta veyarad kisse hakkavod alehem (mechilta):
ohc: Vayyered Adonai al har sinay. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (socha 5.), lemala measara. vetzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar el rosh hahar, kevan shehaggavoah hu asara mehahar, peshita sheafillu lerosho lo higgia. veulay ki va lishlol shello yarda shechina letziddede hahar vaafillu lemala measara, hagam shemmatzinu lo sheafillu bammekomot hannemuchim yarda shechina kol sheyyesh mimmenna laaretz asara tefachim, vetze ulemad mehammishkan bechol makom asher yachanu bene yisrael yishkon sham kevod Adonai, kan bahar lo yarad ella al rosh hahar, velaze matza moshe alot el rosh hahar, ucheamro besamuch: "vayyikra Adonai lemoshe el rosh hahar".

Vetzarich leyashshev adayin lamma lo amar hakkatuv "vayyered Adonai al rosh har sinay". veulay shechash letaut bechavvanat devarav, ki leolam yarad al kelalut har sinay rosho utzedadav, veamro "al rosh" letzad shello hishra shechinato mammash al hahar bivchinat kol chelek vechelek mehahar, yikkare mekom shechinat Adonai shamma rosh, leheyoto elyon mimmennu, vehaven. laze amar beseder ze vayyered Adonai al har sinay lemala measara, veachar kach chazar lehodia makom sheyyarad shamma shehu el rosh hahar, vehaven:

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (mechilta 89): katuv echad omer "min hashshamayim" vegomer, melammed shehirkin hashshem shamayim haelyonim vechulei vehitztzian al gabbe hahar vedibber immahem, ad kan. veze hu shiur hakkatuv vayyered Adonai al vegomer, perush, lo yarad mammash ella lemala, karamuz betevat "al", veshamav mekom matztzavo hayu nogim el rosh hahar.

Od yirtze lehodia ki kesheyyarad Adonai, perush, keshehitchil lehorid shechinato, raash hahar veala likrato keeved ratz lifne rabbo, veze hu shiur hakkatuv vayyered Adonai, vaadayin lo gilla hakkatuv leeze makom yarad, vehodia peullat hahar hagam heyoto domem shennaasa baal chay veala kodem sheyyaggia adav, veachar kach hodia hakkatuv leeze makom yarad, veamar el rosh hahar, ha lamadta sheala hahar kodem haggaat shechinat Adonai el rosho.

rashi: Verabba haazuva. shehaaretz teazev mehem" (Vayikra 26:43), vechach hallashon: yirbu mekomot azuvim bekerev haaretz.
targum: Veyarchak Adonai yat bene enasha vetisge tzadyuta begavah deara:

rashi: Veim mizbach avanim. rabbi yishmael omer kol im veim shebbattora reshut chutz mig, veim mizbach avanim taase li, hare im ze meshammesh bilshon kaasher – vechaasher taase li mizbach avanim lo tivne ethen gazit, shehare chova alecha livnot mizbach avanim, shenneemar avanim shelemot tivne (Devarim 27) – vechen im kesef talve (Shemot 22), chova hu, shenneemar vehaavet taavitennu (Devarim 15) – veaf ze meshammesh bilshon kaasher – vechen veim takriv minchat bikkurim (Vayikra 2), zo minchat haomer shehi chova, veal karchacha en im hallalu teluyin ella vaddain, uvilshon kaasher hem meshammeshim:
Gazit. leshon geziza, shepposlan umechattetan bevarzel:
Ki charbecha henafta aleha. hare ki ze meshammesh bilshon pen, shehu dilma – pen tanif charbecha aleha:

Vattechalleha. ha lamadta sheim henafta aleha barzel chillalta, shehammizbeach nivra lehaarich yamav shel adam vehabbarzel nivra lekatztzer yamav shel adam, en ze baddin sheyyunaf hamekatztzer al hammaarich (mechilta). veod shehammizbeach metil shalom ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim, lefichach lo yavo alav koret umechabbel; vahare devarim kal vachomer, uma avanim sheenan root velo shomot velo medabberot, al yede shemmetilot shalom amra tora velo tanif alehem barzel, hammetil shalom ben ish leishto, ben mishpacha lemishpacha, ben adam lachavero, al achat kamma vechamma shello tevoehu puranut (sham):
Lashshav. chinnam, lahevel, veezehu shevuat shav? nishba leshannot et hayyadua – al ammud shel even shehu shel zahav (shavuot 29):
ohc: Lo tissa vegomer. perush, letzad ki hashshevua taggid gedolot unesiut laAdonai, yachshov adam ki yishshava bishmo yitbarach lechavod uletifaret, ki hu ze ribbono veshallito, hagam sheyyihye lashshav ma bechach im hannishba lo lo yakkir beshikro, ki im yeda shehu adono shel ze vehu beofen shello yitgalle hahefech. laze amar lo tissa afilu yesh nesiut lashshem sheatta nishba bo, ki lo yenakke Adonai hagam shettihye kavvanato laset et shemo, kevan shehu lashshav.

Od yirtze, ki beemtzaut shevuat shav hu nose mealav shem Adonai hannikra alav, umitlabbesh bivchinat hara hammityacheset beshem shav, ki shem Adonai emet vehammazkiro besheker poreach mimmennu bechinat hashshem lesibbat bochoro bashshav, veze hu shiur hakkatuv lo tissa mealecha shem Adonai elohecha lesibbat shav, veamar ki lo yenakke Adonai leose chen.

Od yirmoz shello yihye nose alav shem Adonai shehu eloho, veomer lakkol shehu ish yehudi veoved Adonai, vehu amro shem Adonai shehu elohecha ulevavo lo chen yachshov, vehu amro lashshav, veazhara zo shello yeramme 7 lomar ki hu meavadav velo chen hu. uvichlal azhara zo shello yare al atzmo shehu tzaddik yoter mimma shehu.

rashi: El hammidbar. af anu yodim shebbammidbar hayu ella beshivcho shel yitro dibber hakkatuv, shehaya yoshev bichvodo shel olam unedavo libbo latzet el hammidbar, mekom tohu lishmoa divre tora (sham):
ohc: El hammidbar vegomer. perush, veim tomar minnayin yadu mekom chanoto bammidbar haggadol? laze amar asher hu chone sham vegomer, perush, uchevar hodio moshe makom asher dibber itto sham haelohim, veamar elav (Shemot 3:12) "taavdun et haelohim al hahar hazze", vehodio hahar shealav yekabbelu hattora. vehu amro "asher hu chone sham har" vegomer hayyadua etzlo. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 84) sheamar moshe leyitro inyan kabbalat hattora, uchetavtiv bitchillat happarasha, vetihye hodaat har haelohim mikkelal ma shehodio.

rashi: Tov meat beyirat Adonai meotzar rav umehuma vo. kol bene adam tzoakim, shennaasa haotzar miggezel vechamas. kemo "ureu mehumot rabbot betochah vaashukim bekirbah" (Amos 3:9):
targum: Tav kalil bidchalteh deelaha min simata ravrevata veaata vahen:

rashi: Sheol vaavaddon neged Adonai. galuy lefanav kol asher betochah:
Af ki. kal vachomer hu:
targum: Sheyol veuvedana kodam elaha af libbi var nasha:

rashi: Vayyetze moshe. kavod gadol nitkabbed yitro beotah shaa, kevan sheyyatza moshe, yatza aharon nadav vaavihu, umi hu sheraa et ellu yotzin velo yetze? (tanchuma):
Vayyishtachu vayyishshak lo. eni yodea mi hishtachava lemi, keshehu omer ish lereehu, mi hakkaruy "ish" – moshe, shenneemar "vehaish moshe" (Bamidbar 12):
ohc: Vayyetze vegomer likrat chotno. perush, letzad sheamar lo yitro im en atta yotze begini vechulei, laze amar hakkatuv vayyetze moshe likrat chotno, ki kevodo shel chotno hispik lo latzet likrato. veulay sheasa hekker laddavar sheyyatza beyichud likrato velo pana bitziato limkom ohel haishsha viladeha, o shehaya omer beferush sheyyetziato hu likrat chotno. gam ledivrehem zichronam livracha (mechilta) shemmoshe hu shehishtachava leyitro, ze lecha haot ki lichvodo yatza, velaze amru zichronam livracha (sham): kavod gadol nitkabbed yitro vechulei, vezulat devarenu minnayin lo kavod miyyetzia zo, dilma lichvod banav veishto yatza moshe?

Vayyishtachu vegomer. rabbotenu zichrono livracha (mechilta yitro 1) amru: eni yodea mi hishtachava lemi, keshehu omer "ish" – mi hu shekkaruy ish? ze moshe, ad kan. hinne taam shello amru ki shenehem hishtachavu ze laze, letzad sheamar leshon yachid "vayyishtachu vayyishshak lo", ze yaggid ki echad levad hishtachava. veim tomar ledivrehem zichrono livracha vahalo matzinu sheggam yitro nikra ish, dichtiv (Shemot 2:21) "vayyoel moshe lashevet et haish", yesh lechallek ben keriat ish shel yitro likriat ish shel moshe. vekodem aira shachar ma maala yesh beshem ze shel ish, vahalo kol adam yikkare ish unekevato ishsha, vegam babbehemot matzinu sheamar hakkatuv befarashat noach (Bereshit 7:2) "shiva ish veishto". ella sheyyishtanne shem ish kesheyyihye bimkom zichron haadam veyusaf lo liuuy keriat ish, ze yaggid shehu leshon maala. uvimkom sheyyomar ish belo zichron shemo, ze yimmatze bimkom hashshem velo yaggid maala, kemo shettomar (Bereshit 24:21) "vehaish mishtae lah", "vayyimtzaehu ish" (Bereshit 37:15). vegam zichron anashim sheamru zichrono livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 16) shehu leshon chashivut, davka betzeruf zichron shemam, dichtiv (Bamidbar 13:3) "kullam anashim", sheachar shezzachar shemam chazar lomar "kullam anashim", ze yaggid leshon chashivut. ma sheen ken kesheyyihye bimkom hazekarat shemam kinnuy ze, en zo maala, keamro (Bamidbar 22:9) "mi haanashim haelle immach". vehinne matzinu sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 11:3) "gam haish moshe", "ki ze moshe haish" (Shemot 32:23), hare hizkir shemo vehosif lomar "haish", ze yaggid ki lemaala veadnut yechavven. veze hu amram: mi hu shekkaruy ish? ze moshe, perush ish, leshon serarut umeshilut. aval yitro, hagam shemmatzinu lo shennikra ish, lo matzinu oto beliuuy ella bimkom zichron shemo amar "haish", vehu shem hatztzodek al kol nivra zachar.

Umeatta kesheamar hakkatuv kan ish, haddavar shakul im hu kinnuy haragil bivchinat hazzecharim, o perusho hu ish harashum lemaala vachashivut. veteva zo munachat ben yitro uven moshe, im nomar shepperusho hu kinnuy lezachar yikkanes bammashmaut gam yitro ushenehem shekulim bammashmaut, veen ani yachol laasot shenehem shehare hakkatuv lo amar ella echad kemo sheddiyyaknu meamro "vayyishtachu", veechad ze en ani yodea mi hu, velo ba hakkatuv listom ella lefaresh. uvehechreach lomar ki perush ish haamur kan hu leshon chashivut, uveamro chen nitchayyev lomar ki ze hu moshe haish sheelav nityached chashivut ze velo leyitro, uvaze lo satam hakkatuv kavvanato vahare peresh sheal moshe hu omer.

rashi: Im lo taaminu. linvuati, attem achaz veammo, asher yadati ki reshaim attem:
Lo teamenu. lo emun bachem:
targum: Veresh efrayim shomron veresh shomron bar remalya im la tehemnun bemile neviya are la titkaymun:

rashi: Vayyuggad levet david. lefi sherasha haya, lo hizkir shemo:
Nacha aram al efrayim. nitchabber melech aram al melech yisrael lavo alecha. 'nacha leshon nekeva, al shehammalchut nacha. 596 109, leshon "vayyanach bechol gevul mitzrayim" (Shemot 10:14):

Vayyana levavo. lefi shekkevar nilcham bo kol echad mehem bifne atzmo, veyachlu lo, shenneemar "vayyittenehu Adonai beyad melech aram vegomer" (divrei hayamim 2 28:5), omer "vayyaharog pekach ben remalya mea veesrim elef ish", shenehem bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 2 28:6):
Kenoa atze yaar. kol ilane serak yishshama yoter mikkol ilane pere, kidita bivreshit rabba (Bereshit Rabba 16:):
targum: Veitchava levet david lememar itchabbar malka daaram im malka deyisrael lemete alohi veza libbeh velibba deameh keishtedayut ilane churesha min kodam rucha:

rashi: Vetzivvecha elohim veyacholta amod. himmalech baggevura, im metzavve otcha laasot ken, tuchal amod, veim yeakkev al yadcha lo tuchal laamod (mechilta):
Vegam kol haam hazze. aharon nadav vaavihu veshivim zekenim hannilvim atta immecha (sham):
ohc: Im et haddavar vegomer vetzivvecha vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro vetzivvecha, im lehimmalech baggevura hu omer, kevar amar lo ken paam achat, dichtiv (Shemot 18:19) "iatzcha vihi elohim immach", uma tzorech bechefel haddevarim. veulay shennitkavven lomar lo teshuva al ma sheyyiton ki sof kol sof hu monea meatzmo hammitzvot, veen mimmiddat hatztzaddikim lehakel mealehem hammitzvot, hagam ki yiaf vechi yiga, ki adam leamal yullad (Iyov 5:7) baamalah shel mitzva. laze amar elav vetzivvecha elohim vegomer, perush ki hinne yadua hu otzem hakkoach asher yitztarech leish navi, vetze ulemad mimmaamre daniyyel (Daniel 10:7) bedabber elav malach, umizze taskil ledibberot el. velaze timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (nedarim lach,1) en nevua shora ella al gibbor. vehen emet ki moshe zikkech gufo velo yeera lo hattashshut koach, aval al kol panim lo yachol lehitazzer kol kach kesheyyihye challash betivo. velaze amar elav ki yoter bemitzva zo sheyyechola lehitkayyem al yede acherim kede sheyyekayyem mitzvat hannevua sheenah yechola lehitkayyem al yede zulato. vehu amro im et vegomer vetzivvecha elohim, perush kaasher yetzavvecha elohim hammitzvot asher hu metzavvecha behodaat hattora vehammitzva tuchal amod bahem, perush yihye becha koach laamod bahem. veulay ki dikdek lomar leshon amida lomar ki yihye bo koach lekabbel hannevua meummad, keamram zichronam livracha (zohar 9 171,1) ki shear hanneviim hayu noflim al penehem ma sheen ken moshe dichtiv "venitztzavta sham" vegomer (Shemot 34:2), "po amod immadi" (Devarim 5:28). velaze im lo yakel mealav ze yihye lo sibba sheyyigra mitztzaddik eno chas veshalom velo yuchal amod.

rashi: Veasita kol melachtecha. keshettavo shabbat yehe veenecha keillu kol melachtecha asuya, shello teharher achar melacha (sham):
ohc: Sheshet yamim taavod vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan yetzav Adonai laavod besheshet yamim. gam ma hi kavvanato beamro veasita vegomer. venire ki yechavven al derech maamar hakkatuv befarashat behar sinay (Vayikra 25:20) "vechi tomru ma nochal bashshana hashsheviit vegomer vetzivviti" vegomer, vehem haddevarim hanneemarim kan lefi ma shekkadam lomar "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho" sheen bo divre chol, im ken haose veochel devar yom beyomo, ma yochal bayyom hammekuddash, laze amar sheshet yamim levad taavod uvahem taase chol melachtecha, perush, hatztzericha lecha leshishshi velishvii, al derech amro (sham) "veasat et hattevua lishlosh" vegomer, ki mavtiach Adonai leshomre mitzvotav.

Od yirtze letzauot leval yachshov bimlechet chol beshabbat, vehu amro sheshet yamim vegomer, veyihye beenecha keillu asita kevar kol melachtecha sheyyesh lecha laasot, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (mechilta): shevot keillu melachtecha asuya, shezzulat ze yachshov machashavot lechonen melachto vaasher yechsar mehammelacha laasotah bachol, vetze ulemad mimmaase hechasid (shabbat 150:) shekkanas atzmo al asher chashav ligdor gader nifratz beshabbat leval yivnehu od vechulei:

rashi: Lo yihye lecha. lamma neemar? lefi shenne lo taase lecha, en li ella shello yaase, heasuy kevar minnayin shello yekayyem? talo lo yihye lecha (sham):

Elohim acherim. sheenan elohut ella acherim asaum elohim alehem, velo yittachen lefaresh elohim acherim zulati, sheggenay kelappe mala likrovtam elohut etzlo. davar acher elohim acherim, shehem acherim leovdehem – tzoakim alehem veenan onin otam, vedome keillu hu acher sheeno makkiro meolam:
Al panay. kol zeman sheani kayyam, shello tomar lo nitztauu al aza ella oto haddor (mechilta):
ohc: Lo yihye lecha vegomer. perush, letzad shekkadam letzauot al emunato yitbarach, vehu davar sheikkaro ballev, laze amar ki kemo chen yitztarech leharechik millibbo elohut hazzulat, hagam shello yotziennu bisfatav, vehu sheddikdek lomar betevat lecha, perush, afillu bemachashavtecha. uchefi ze matzinu azhara lemachshevet avoda zara sheamru zichronam livracha (kiddushin lat:) befasuk (Yechezkel 14:5) "lemaan tefos" vegomer she maanish al machshevet avoda zara, veamru zichronam livracha (zevachim kav:) en onesh belo azhara, hare lecha azharato.

Od yirtze lomar, ki chol avoda zara shebbaolam en peullat haoved poelet haderaga banneevad laasoto elohim, kaasher taasena peullat ish yisrael, ki noten koach gadol bivchinat hara vechofe chas veshalom bechina hameulla lifne bechinat hara rachamana litzlan, vehu amro lo yihye lecha elohim, perush havaya shellecha taasennu elohim.
Od yirtze, ki beemtzaut haoved hu mamtzi havaya achat shehi elohim, ma shello haya ken kodem.
Od yirtze lomar, ki el zar asher yaase haadam zulato yitbarach, hu hashshofet nekama meovdehu, al derech amro (yirmeya 2,19) "teyasserech raatech".

Od yirtze, ki baasoto el zulato yitbarach, mehannimna sheyyihye lo echad, vahagam shehu lo yirtze laavod ella leechad, yitchayyev laasot rabbim ki en echad, vehu amro lo yihye leshon yachid vegamar omer elohim acherim. o yirtze lomar ki kesheyyatchil laavod echad, lesof yaavod rabbim. vetze ulemad middivre nevie yisrael (sanhedrin kav:) ribbuy haelohot shehayu yisrael ovdim baaretz baavonot.

Veamro al panay yitbaer al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 9 mehilchot yesode hattora, ki yeamen navi bidvarav im yomar laavor al mitzva achat mimmitzvot hattora lefi shaa al pi Adonai, vedavka bishar mitzvot chutz meavoda zara sheafillu lefi shaa hare ze nevi sheker uven mavet hu, veze hu amro al panay perush bechol perate hazzemannim, ki kevar hikdim hodaato yitbarach behazekarat shemo ki hu haya vehove veyihye been hefsek, umeatta hare ze hichnis bichlal haissur kol hayyamim vehashshaot vehargaim, shekkullam bichlal issur lo yihye.

Od yirtze beamro al panay – ramaz lishlol taanat kat hattoim sheosim avoda zara leemtzai, letaanat shelilut himmatzo chas veshalom. laze amar "al panay", perush, kol hahove baolam hu al panay, ki ene Adonai meshottim bechol haaretz.

Od yirtze latet taam leazharato, ki kefi sechel enoshi yarchik haddavar mittaam ki kol oved eno oved ella leechad mimmeshammeshav yitbarach, veadrabba miggedullat haeved gedullat haadon nodaat, veim ken haoved lashshemesh velayyareach hare ze oved avadav umeshammeshav yitbarach, velamma yakpid Adonai al haddavar? laze amar al panay, perush, lesibba sheani mitkaes al haddavar shemmesimim el lelo el. vetevat "panay" leshon kaas, al derech amro (Shemot 33:14) "panay yelechu" vegomer, uchemo sheamar levassof "ki anochi vegomer el kanna".

Od yirtze al panay – al sibbat panay, leval tihyu nimnaim mehabbit el haelohim, ki en lecha oneg baolam kirot pene Adonai beolam hanneshamot, ki hu ze tachlit hamekuvve, vehizhiram Adonai leval yesabbevu meniat atzmam mehassaga zo.

Od yirtze al derech amro (Devarim 28:10) "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha", umeatta kesheoved elohim acherim hinne hu mashre bechinat hara al happanim asher sham kanta hakkedushsha mekomah.

rashi: Lo taasun itti. lo taasun demut shammashay hameshammeshim lefanay bammarom (mechilta):
Elohe chesef. ba lehazehir al hakkeruvim sheatta ose laamod itti, shello yihyu shel kesef, sheim shinnitem laasotam shel kesef hare hen lefanay keelohut:
Velohe zahav. ba lehazehir shello yosif al shenayim, sheim asita arbaa hare hen lefanay kelohe zahav (mechilta):
Lo taasu lachem. lo tomar hareni ose cheruvim bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot kederech sheani ose bevet olamim, lechach neemar lo taasu lachem (sham):
ohc: Lo taasun itti vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro tevat itti. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta) darshu shello yaasu hakkeruvim arbaa, vehu amro elohe zahav shemmaale alehem keillu asu elohe zahav, velo yaasu hashshenayim shel kesef veim asu maale alehem vechulei, gam shello yaasu tzura ledimyon Adonai lehishtachavot lah (rosh hashshana kad,1) vechavvanatam laAdonai velo tzurat shammashim shel Adonai. venire lefaresh hakkatuv bedikduk od lamma chazar lomar paam sheniyya lo taasu lachem velo hispik bema shekkadam lomar lo taasun itti vegomer. od lamma dikdek lomar tevat lachem?

Achen yechavven Adonai letzauot al shene mine avodot el acher: haechad hu haoved beemunat libbo ki maamin bah vechosef leavdah, uchenegdah amar lo taasun itti elohe chesef, perush elohe bechosef, veze yore al haoved meemunat libbo. vedikdek lomar itti ki haoved avoda zara birtzon nafsho hu mamshich beshoresh nafsho bechinat hara shebbeshoresh heavon hahu, vehu sod (Eicha Rabba 1,lo) nachash hamekannen bemigdal, ki kevar hodianu hakkatuv ki nafshot yisrael chelek eloah mimmaal, dichtiv (Devarim 32:9) "chelek Adonai ammo", uveavdo laavoda zara beemunat nafsho noten makom lesm likkanes bimkom shoresh hannefesh hahi shehu mekom hakkedushsha, vehu sheamar shelomo (Mishlei 30:22) "tachat eved ki yimloch", vehu amro lo taasun itti, veamar elohe chesef perush leshon kosef shehu ovdo mikkasfo bo, rachamana litzlan.

Vehashsheni, hayyodea belibbo emuna shelema ki hakkol hu tzoa beli makom, aval ovdah lesibbat hanaa lahanaat hammoil, kemo shettomar sheyyittenu lo mamon al menat leavdah, veyomar haadam belibbo "rachamana libba bae" uvelibbi ani mecharef umegaddef baavoda zara zo veen maasay ella letachlit harevach, ucheneged ze amar velohe zahav lo taasu lachem, perush, hagam sheen libbo venafsho maaminim bah davar ella letzad shezze ahav hazzahav uvishvil hanaat zehavo hu mishtachave, af al pi chen lo taasu.

Vegilla shechet ze hu davka bivchinat haadam shehu pogem atzmo umemaet deyokano, vehu amro lachem letzad shello chata ella bemaase vehammachshava menaggedet kaggaluy lifne yodea taalumot, laze lo yaase hachet sibba shettachnia bechinat hara et bechinat hattov kemaase harishon.
Chassalat parashat yitro

rashi: Ko tomar. ballashon hazze:
Attem reitem. yesh hefresh ben ma sheadam roe lema sheacherim mesichin lo, shemma sheacherim mesichin lo peamim shellibbo chaluk millehaamin (mechilta):

Ki min hashshamayim dibbarti. vechatuv echad omer vayyered Adonai al har sinay (Shemot 19), ba hakkatuv hashshelishi vehichria benehem – min hashshamayim hishmiacha et kolo leyasserekka veal haaretz heracha et ishsho haggedola (Devarim 4), kevodo bashshamayim veishsho ugevurato al haaretz; davar acher: hirkin shamayim usheme hashshamayim vehitztzian al hahar, vechen hu omer vayyet shamayim vayyerad (Tehillim 18):
Ocher beto. shehu botzea batza:
Vesone mattanot yichye. meachar shehu sone mattanot, kol shekken shessone et haggazel:
targum: Movid beteh mechanesh mamon dishkar udesane mohaviyata demagen yeche:

rashi: Yaro yiyyare. mikkan lanniskalin shehem nidchin lematta mibbet hassekila shehaya gavoah shete komot (sanhedrin 45):
Yiyyare. yushlach lematta laaretz, kemo "yara vayyam":
Bimshoch hayyovel. kesheyyimshoch hayyovel kol aroch, hu siman silluk shechina vehafesakat hakkol, vechevan sheestallek, hem rashshain laalot:
Hayyovel. hu shofar shel ayil, shekken baaravya korin ledichra yuvela, veshofar shel ayil shel yitzchak haya (pirki derabbi eliezer 31):
Hishshamer. shev beshalom keyayin al shemarav:
Zanvot haudim haashenim. yihyu veenecha kiznavot udim shekkavta shalhevet shellahem. udim – 465 109:
targum: Vetemar leh istamar venuach la tidchal velibbach la yazua min kodam teren ravrevaya deinun keudaya matnenaya hailen bitkof regaz retzin vaaram uvar remalyahu:

rashi: Ben chacham yesammach av uchesil adam boze immo. gorem leimmo shemmevazzim otah:
targum: Bera chakkima yachade laavuy uvera sachla meshit imeh:

rashi: Niggash el haarafel. lifnim mishshalosh mechitztzot: choshech, anan, vaarafel; shenneemar vehahar boer baesh ad lev hashshamayim choshech anan vaarafel (Devarim 4); arafel hu av heanan sheamar lo hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan (Shemot 19):
Fesel. al shem shennifsal:
Vechol temuna. temunat davar asher bashshamayim:
ohc: Lo taase lecha fesel vegomer. tzarich ladaat, achar amro "lo yihye lecha" vegomer vaafillu bemachshava, ma tzorech od letzauot al maase happesilim? veim letzauot al asiyyatam afillu lezulat, im ken lo haya lo lomar tevat "lecha". od, lo haya lo ligmor omer lo tishtachave im lo baa haazhara ella al maase umman. od, lamma kara latztzelamim beshem pesel? od tzarich ladaat, lamma hutzrach lomar paam acheret Adonai elohecha, shehaya maspik lomar "ki anochi el kanna" vechozrim haddevarim lehammedabber battechilla "anochi Adonai elohecha". od tzarich ladaat, lamma hutzrach latet taam ki vegomer el kanna, halo belo taam ze yitchayyevu lekabbel gezerat malko shel olam baruch hu?

Venire sheyyechavven lomar issur min avoda zara chutz mehammuzkar bappasuk "lo yihye lecha", vehu ki yomar adam, haemet ki Adonai hu haelohim vechol zulato ayin, aval letzad otzem gedullato titmaet techunat haadam vehassagato ledabber lefanav velishol perate sheelotav, ki eno mimmusar geder hakkavod shettavo beriyya shefela afela kamoni vetishal sheelot millifne hammelech haggadol vehannora, velifamim yarbe bifrate tzerachav dakkim verabbim, veech yihye lo kol kach azzut panim leharebot lishol dikduke hashsheelot. asher al ken yityaetz bedaat yitzro sheyyivchar ledabber devarav lifne echad mimmeshammeshe elyon hameshammeshim lefanav bammarom, vehu yaazor lo gam yihye emtzai ledabber devarav lifne hammelech haggadol baddavar haggadol im yitztarech, uveemtzaut ken kabbed yechabbed et hashshemesh hahu vivarchehu veyishtachave lefanav bederech kol hakkavod vehammaala, shebbaze yitratztze laset massao alav laasot lo tzerachav. veda ki taut ze bah tau rov haovdim avoda zara, ki yodim hem sheovdim lelo eloah ella kede sheyyihye lahem leemtzai vechulei kannizkar. uvechina zo lo yikkare lah shem eloah ella pesel, ki hu yodea ki lo eloah hu veze hu pesiluto sheen bo koach elohi ufesolet hu lifne haikkar shehu habbore olam. o kerao pesel ki hu omed lehitpassel kesheyyaavirennu Adonai mimmemshalto al yede sibba o al yede sibbat ze hammishtachave lo sheyyehe gorem lehitpassel, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Eicha rabbati 82) bemaase dor hammabbul sheamru "anu mashbiim lassarim hamemunnim" vechulei, vaAdonai heevir memshelet hassarim, keamro (Yeshayahu 43:28) "vaachallel sare kodesh". vetzivva Adonai gam al bechina zo veamar lo taase lecha fesel, perush, hagam ki lecha beatzmecha bedatecha shehu pesel, af al pi chen lo taasehu lecha.

Vechazar uferash ma hu hammaase, veamar lo tishtachave lahem vegomer, veamar hattaam lehaissur ki anochi Adonai el kanna, perush, mitkanne ani al haddavar hagam sheyyihye bederech ze. ulehavin tochen hakkavvana, hinne matzinu laAdonai shehizkir perat ze shel hakkina befarashat naso (Bamidbar 5:14), dichtiv "veavar alav ruach kina vekinne et ishto" vegomer, hinne lifamim yitkanne adam beishto al beno veal avdo. uchevar yadata ki yisrael bivchinat kalla hem, karamuz beorech besefer kodesh kadashim shir hashshirim. umeatta kesheyyisrael osim lahem bealim, hagam shello yimredu velo yachchidu babbore ki hu adon haadonim, hassechel yechayyev ki yitkanne habbaal. vehammashal baze eshet melech ki tohav eved melech o beno lehachin dikduke peratim hatztzericha lahem utechabbekehu utenashshekehu, haim lo yitkanne hammelech ledakrah bacherev? kemo chen haddavar hazze. vehammavchin ofen devekut nefesh im bene yisrael im habbore bachafitza bachashika bidvika beahava rabba yassig hitbonnut hammuskol. vehu ma sheamar ki anochi Adonai elohecha, dikdek lomar "elohecha" lirmoz haamur, vehu sod hasheraat shechinato yitbarach al yisrael veyichud shemo, vehammaskil yavin. velaze timtza ki amar hakkatuv (Devarim 4:19) "asher chalak Adonai" vegomer lechol haammim, ki haammim sarehem sare mala vehem hammoshlim bahem, lo chen bene yisrael, hu malkenu hu sarenu hu elohenu, baruch hu.

Uvederech remez yirmoz amro lo taase lecha fesel, perush, shello yifsol et atzmo, ki bachato haadam baavon avoda zara shehi keneged kol hattora kullah mittivo nifsal veyusar tzelem elohi, dichtiv (tehillim 39:7) "ach betzelem yithallech ish", velo yerau fanav lemala, venichnas begeder issur livne el chay leval yistakkelu befanav, kemaamar hannavi lemelech yisrael (Melachim 2 3:14) "lule pene yehoshafat" vegomer.

rashi: Lo tinaf. en niuf ella veeshet ish, shenneemar mot yumat hannoef vehannoafet (Vayikra 20), veomer haishsha hamenaefet tachat ishah tikkach et zarim (Yechezkel 16):

Lo tignov. begonev nefashot hakkatuv medabber, lo tignovu (Vayikra 19), begonev mamon; o eno ella ze vegonev mamon ulehallan begonev nefashot? amarta davar lamed meinyano – ma lo tirtzach, lo tinaf, medabber bedavar shechayyavin alav mitat bet din, af lo tignov davar shechayyav alav mitat bet din (sanhedrin 86):
Mizbach adama. mechubbar baadama, shello yivnennu al gabbe ammudim o al gabbe basis; davar acher shehaya memalle et chalal mizbach hannechoshet adama bishat chaniyyatan (sham):
Taase li. shettehe techillat asiyyato lishmi:
Vezavachta alav. etzlo, kemo vealav matte menashshe (Bamidbar 2), o eno ella alav mammash? talo habbasar vehaddam al mizbach Adonai elohecha (Devarim 12), veen shechita berosh hammizbeach:
Et olotecha veet shelamecha. asher mitztzoncha umibbekarecha: (et tzoncha veet bekarecha. perush leet olotecha veet shelamecha:)

Bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi. asher etten lecha reshut lehazekir shem hameforash shelli, sham avo elecha uverachticha – ashre shechinati alecha; mikkan atta lamed shello nittan reshut lehazekir shem hameforash ella bemakom shehashshechina vaa sham, vezehu vet habbechira, sham natan reshut lakkohanim lehazekir shem hameforash binsiat kappayim levarech et haam (sota 38):
Vayyelech lo el artzo. legayyer bene mishpachto (mechilta):
Lemaan yaarichun yamecha. im techabbed yaarichun veim lav yiktzerun, sheddivre tora notarikon hem nidrashim – mikkelal hen lav umikkelal lav hen (mechilta):
ohc: Lemaan yaarichun. amar yaarichun shemmashma meatzmam, velo amar "aarich yamecha". ulay sheyyirtze lomar ki mitzva zo segullatah hi arichut yamim millevad secharah meAdonai, ki yesh mitzvot sheyyesh bahem segullot niflaot millevad sachar asher kava lahem Adonai, vezo gilla otah Adonai.

rashi: Musar ra leozev orach. yissurim kashim muchanim leover orach shel hakkadosh baruch hu:
targum: Marduta devisha mataya orcheh uman desane machsenuta yemut:

rashi: Hafer machashavot been sod. belo etza lo takum machashava:
targum: Bitula demachshevata hech delet raza uvesugea deilen demitmalchin etzata tekum:

rashi: Veshaftu. vidunun, leshon tziuuy:
Vehakel mealecha. davar ze lehakel mealecha: vehakel. kemo "vehachebed et libbo" (Shemot 8), "vehakkot et moav" (Melachim 2 3), leshon hove:
ohc: Bechol et. ramaz afillu bizman shehu moshe asuk bekabbalat chukke Adonai vetorotav vechaddome, ellu hem penuyim yishpetu bechol et, ma sheen ken yachol asot moshe.
Vehakel mealecha venasu. perush, ki ma sheani omer lecha lehakel mealecha, lo shello tishpot ella haddavar haggadol, ella venasu ittach, perush, atta vehem tihyu bimlacha zo.

rashi: Lev sameach yetiv panim. im tesammach libbo shel hakkadosh baruch hu belechtecha bidrachav, veyetiv lecha panav laasot kol retzoncha. veim teatztzevehu, yare lecha ruach nechea, kema deat amar (Bereshit 6:6-7) "vayyitatztzev el libbo vayyomer Adonai emche et haadam vegomer". ruach nechea 98, ruach shel zaaf:
targum: Libba chadya mashpir appe uvecheva delibba rucha memachta:

rashi: Unekitzenna. neorrah bemilchama:
Venavkienna elenu. neshavve otah immanu kevika zo shehi shava; vechen tirgem yonatan: "uneshavvinun immana", sheyyihyu shavin im aseret hashshevatim bemelech echad:
Et ben taval. ben hattov elenu, ken tirgem yonatan. veyesh lefaresh "tov el" asher lo tov beene hammakom, uvegimatriyya shel otiyyot 73: taval hu ramla, 209 42 31, ben taval ben ramla:
targum: Nisak beara devet yehuda unechabberinun uneshavinun imana venamlich malka begavah yat man dechashar lana:

rashi: Sheal lecha ot laddavar hazze, ki yedaticha sheen atta maamin ledivre hakkadosh baruch hu:
Haemek sheala. haamek usheal sheala, kemo "shemaa selacha" (Daniel 9:19). sheal ot beimke tehom lehachayot lecha met, o hagebeah lemala lishol ot bashshamayim:
targum: Sheal lach ata min kodam Adonai elahach sheal di yitaved lach nes al ara o titchaze lach at bishmaya:

rashi: Ish chema yegare madon. adam sheen maatzor lerucho lehaarich chamato, yegare madon:
Veerech appayim. sheeno memaher lehinnakem velariv:
Yashkit riv. shehu kale veshakat mealav (0 meelav):
targum: Gavra chemtana megara tigra unegid rucha madech charta:

rashi: Lev tzaddik yehge laanot. yachshov veyavin ma yaane, kodem sheyyashiv davar:
targum: Libba detzadika ranen behemanuta ufumehon derashie mabbia bishta:

rashi: Beav heanan. bemaave heanan vezehu arafel:
Vegam becha. gam banneviim habbaim acharecha (mechilta):
Vayyagged moshe et divre vegomer. beyom hammochorat, shehu revii lachodesh:
Et divre haam vegomer. teshuva al davar ze; shamati mehem shertzonam lishmoa mimmecha, eno dome hashshomea mippi shaliach lashshomea mippi hammelech, retzonenu lirot et malkenu (mechilta):
ohc: Hinne anochi ba elecha vegomer. ulay sheyyechavven lomar lo ki letzad shehaya Adonai ragil ledabber immo panim befanim, laze amar elav sheyyedabber immo beofen acher, dehaynu beav heanan, velo yihye haddibbur kol kach ruchani kargilut hakkodem. venatan hattaam baavur yishma haam kesheyyedabber im moshe, veim yedabber kasseder harishon beaspaklarya hammeira en koach beyisrael lishmoa haddevarim leotzem ruchaniyyutam, vaAdonai chafetz sheyyashmia hammaamarim leyisrael. veamar lo shemmillevad tachlit ze sheyyishma haam hammitzva mippi habbore veyesh baze chizzuk haemuna belibbam, od yesh toelet sheyyaaminu bemoshe leolam bishar mitzvot kesheyyetzavve otam al pi Adonai. venitkavven Adonai baze gam ken leratztzot moshe shello yakpid al hameatat kevodo meofen haddibbur haragil.

Yaaminu leolam. perush "leolam" – laddorot habbaim yaaminu beemtzautecha bechol hanneviim, al derech shekkatav rambam beferek 8 mehilchot yesode hattora, veze leshono: kol navi sheyyaamod achar moshe rabbenu en anu maaminim bo mippene haot vechulei ella mippene hammitzva shetztzivva moshe battora veamar im natan ot elav tishmaun, ad kan. vechatav od sham ki emunat moshe lo hayta letzad hammoftim vechulei ella letzad sheshshamu bedabber Adonai immo vehem edim baamittut nevuato. veal pi haddevarim yacholnu lefaresh vegam becha yaaminu leolam – taam amro "leolam" ramaz gam al shear neviim habbaim acharav leolam, kesheyyavo gam ken navi lahem shaluach mimmenni yatzdiku nevuato, ki haotot sheyyaasu lo yeammetu hannevua ella bemitzvat Adonai al emunatam, vezulat havechana zo gam hametzuvve bemitzva zo yesh bo pikpuk keshettihye emunato al pi haotot zulat kesheyyishma haam bedabbero immo.

Ella sheyyesh latet lev bedivre harambam, ech yitzdak lomar shello heeminu bemoshe, vahalo kevar neemar (Shemot 14, 31) "vayyaaminu baAdonai uvemoshe" vegomer, ki moftav veototav muflaim hem, uma gam maase keriat yam suf hu davar mavhil uvo yatzdiku veyachrichu haemuna. hen emet ki bishar neviim, letzad sheen tzerichin laasot otot chazakim ugedolim keotot moshe, laze tzerichin anu lechazzek emunat nevuatam al pi maamar Adonai asher tzivva lishmoa lo, ma sheen ken moshe. uma shekkatav rambam sham ki otot sheasa moshe lo hayu kede sheyyaaminu bo ella letzarche yisrael vechulei kaamur sham, sof kol sof yishtammea haemet meatzmo ki moshe emet.

Venire lomar ki haemuna sheheeminu yisrael bemoshe hayta shehu eved Adonai vaAdonai chafetz bo veose tefillato uretzono, ach lo heeminu shehaya Adonai medabber immo, ki yesh sevara mechachme ummot shemmochichim beharebe hochachot kefi filosofiyyotam ki min hai efshariyyut sheyyedabber Adonai im adam vachay, veelle yatzdiku ki Adonai yishma veyaane veyohav lachavivav veyaase retzonam. uletzad sheyyesh sevara zo baolam nuchal lomar ki hagam sheheeminu yisrael bemoshe avdo, perush shehu eved Adonai veyishma Adonai tefillato veyaase cheftzo uretzono, aval lo mippene ze yatzdiku ki yedabber Adonai, veyeshnah adayin lachashashat filosofe haummot. laze amar Adonai elav baavur yishma haam bedabberi immach, uvaze yatzdiku ki yedabber Adonai im haadam vachay.

Veamro vegam becha yaaminu, perush, beemtzautecha yaaminu bannavi asher akim lahem tachtecha bechol dor vador leolam, ki tifka mehem taanat sevara zo. o yirtze amro becha beemtzaut nevuatcha, kesheyyatzdikuha keshettetzavve lahem sheyyishmeun lannavi al pi ot, yaaminu leolam lechol navi venavi, aval zulat hatzedakat nevuatcha lo yoil haot lehaamin bannavi kemo shekkatav harambam. achar shekkatavti ze matzati berayta bammechilta veze leshonam: "gam becha" – gam banneviim sheacharecha, ad kan. vehem devarenu atzmam, uvema shepperashti tavin kavvanat divrehem.

Vehinne bishmoa haam divre Adonai, hitzdiku kullam yachad ki yedabber Adonai im haadam vachay, uchemo shehiggidu befihem veamru (Devarim 5:21): "hayyom hazze rainu ki yedabber Adonai im haadam vachay", vehem ede Adonai baddavar venichzeva daat hafilosofim biraya berura. vegam hikkiru maalat hannavi moshe bemoshe shennisseo Adonai binvuato, dichtiv (Shemot 19:19): "moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol", uchemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha bakkatuv (mechilta yitro), yeuyyan sham divrehem.

Vayyagged moshe vegomer. ulay shehiggid shehiskimu lishmoa divre Adonai mippiv kemaamar Adonai "baavur yishma haam" vegomer, o sheen tzarich od ot lehaamin bemoshe shekkevar heeminu bemoshe ki hu navi. umechuvvan hahaggada hi limmud zechut al yisrael levad, uledivrehem zichronam livracha (mechilta) sheamru shehahaggada hi sheamru yisrael retzonenu lishmoa mippi Adonai, uleman deamar lirot et malkenu yeduyyak leshon haggada shehem devarim kashim sheyyevakkesh eved lishmoa kol elohav o lirot kevodo yitbarach. vahagam ki matzinu sheamar Adonai "baavur yishma haam" lo amar sheyyedabber immahem ella bedabbero im moshe yishmeu hem, uvakkashatam hayta sheyyedabber Adonai immahem. vetaam hahaggada, hagam shello yikkached mimmennu davar, hu lahashivo al sheelatam. umatzinu lo sheheshiv techef umiyyad "lech el haam vekiddashtam" vegomer:

rashi: Vayyomer el moshe. ay shaliach (sham):
Ani chotencha yitro vegomer. im en atta yotze vegini, tze vegin ishtecha, veim en atta yotze vegin ishtecha, tze vegin shene vaneha (sham):
ohc: Ani chotencha vegomer veishtecha vegomer. taam sheshshinna hakkatuv sidram kan misseder shekkatav befasuk shellifne ze shehikdim habbanim laishsha, yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (mechilta; Shemot Rabba 27,2) sheamru im en atta yotze begini vechulei, im ken mimmatta lemala sidderam hakkatuv, laze hikdim haishsha labbanim, sheim lo yaase bishvilah yaase bishvil habbanim, ma sheen ken keshehodia hakkatuv biatam lammidbar vesidderam seder hechashuv chashuv kodem hikdim habbanim. vahagam shehikdim sham yitro labbanim vechan siddero kodem laishsha sheyyore shehu lematta mimmenna, hu yitro dibber baanava veshiflut aval hakkatuv kibbedo vehikdimo letzad heyoto chotno shel moshe vetzarich lechabbedo afillu moshe, dichtiv (Shmuel 1 24:11) "veavi ree gam ree".
Ushene vaneha immah. taam amro immah, nitkavven lomar chalukka reviit, sheim en atta ose beginah levad velo begin baneha levad, tzaref kevod shenehem vetze.

rashi: Vegam hakkohanim. af habbechorot shehaavoda vahem (zevachim 115):
Hanniggashim el Adonai. lehakeriv karbanot, af hem lo yismechu al chashivutam laalot:
Yitkaddashu. yihyu mezummanim lehityatztzev al amdan:
Pen yifrotz. leshon pirtza; yaharog bahem veyaase vahem pirtza:
ohc: Vegam hakkohanim. perush, hagam sheyyesh lahem maalat keriva el makom hammekuddash laavod bevet Adonai kaasher haya mekubbal beyadam, o habbechorot o mizzera aharon, yitkaddashu perush, lo tihye kedushshatam maggaat ad gader ze utzerichin hem lachshov atzmam beerech makom ze keillu en lahem kedushsha kol ikkar. veshiur tevat "yitkaddashu" keshiur tevat "vedishshenu" (Bamidbar 4:13). o yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (mechilta) ki higbil hahar: ad kan moshe, ad kan gevul aharon, ad kan gevul hakkohanim. kefi ze amro hanniggashim el Adonai perush, sheggevulam bahar niggashim ma sheen ken yisrael, yitkaddashu, perush, yaamdu bikdushshatam velo yosifu laalot od pen vegomer.

rashi: Velo taale vemaalot. kesheatta vone chevesh lammizbeach lo taasehu maalot maalot, ashekalevanesh belaaz, ella chalak yehe umeshuppa:

Asher lo tiggale ervatcha. sheal yede hammaalot atta tzarich leharechiv pesiotecha; veaappi sheeno gilluy erva mammash, shehare chetiv vaase lahem michnese vad, mikkol makom harechavat happesiot karov legilluy erva hu, veatta noheg bam minhag bizzayon; vahare devarim kava, uma avanim hallalu sheen bahem daat lehakepid al bizyonan, amra tora hoil veyesh bahem tzorech lo tinhag bahem minhag bizzayon, chavercha shehu vidmut yotzercha, umakpid al bizyono, al achat kamma vechamma:

Ritzpa. gachelet, vechen "ugat retzafim" (Melachim 1 19:6) kemo 'uggat reshafim. veneemar bishayahu uveeliyyahu betzadi 'ritzpa, mippene sheamru dilatorya al yisrael: ze keraam "am teme sefatayim", veze amar "ki azvu veritecha" (Melachim 1 19:10). amar hakkadosh baruch hu lammalach: retzotz pe sheamar dilatorya al banay (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:9):
Bemelkachayim. bitzvat:
Lakach meal hammizbeach. shebbaazara:
targum: Veishtedi levati chad min shamashaya uvefumeh mamlel dekabbel min kodam dishchinteh al kurese yekara bishme meroma el min madbecha:

rashi: Ivvelet. simcha hi lachasar lev:
targum: Shatyuta chedvata hi lachasir libba vegavra demitbayen teritzut mehalech:

rashi: Vaysapper moshe lechotno. limshoch et libbo lekarvo lattora (mechilta):
Et kol hattelaa. sheal hayyam veshel amalek:
Hattelaa. lamed alef min hayesod shel teva, vehattav hu tikkun visod hannofel mimmennu lifrakim; vechen teruma, tenufa, tekuma, tenua:
ohc: Vaysapper moshe. hagam sheamar hakkatuv "vayyishma vegomer et kol asher" vegomer, ulay shehayu peratim shello shematan azno. o efshar shello hitzdik happelaot letzad hagezamat hainyanim, o shehagam shekkadam lo mehayyediot adayin haya mistappek shello nirtak chevel mitzri sheal tzavvarehem, vesipper lo moshe inyan shello haya yachol ladaat mizzulato, vehu harigat sar mitzrayim sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (zohar 10 52:) sherauhu yisrael met, uvaze hechlit yitro ki paka niram mealehem.

Veulay ki ze hu sheramaz hakkatuv beamro et kol hattelaa asher metzaatam badderech vayyatztzilem vegomer, shehodio merdifat hassar, ki yitro kohen midyan haya, umin hassetam hem yavchinu veyedu ki yesh sare mala al kol umma, vesipper lo ki radaf otam hu beatzmo, dichtiv (Shemot 14:10) "vehinne mitzrayim nosea acharehem", umizze raashu ufachadu yisrael, uchemo shepperashnu sham. uchesheshshama yitro ken amar baruch vegomer mittachat yad mitzrayim, shehu hassar shemmitzrayim shemo, venachon.

rashi: Attem reitem. lo massoret hi veyedchem, lo vidvarim ani meshagger lachem, lo veedim ani meid alechem, ella attem reitem asher asiti lemitzrayim, al kamma averot hayu chayyavin li kodem shennizdavvegu lachem velo nifrati mehem ella al yedchem (mechilta):

Vaessa etchem. ze hayyom shebbau yisrael lerameses, shehayu yisrael mefuzzarin bechol eretz goshen, uleshaa kalla keshebbau lissa velatzet, nikbetzu kullam lerameses, veunkelos tirgem vaessa kemo vaassia etchem – "veattelit yatchon", tikken et haddavar derech kavod lemala:

Al kanfe nesharim. kannesher hannose gozalav al kenafav, shekkol shear haofot notnim et benehem ben raglehem, lefi shemmityarin meof acher shepporeach al gabbehem, aval hannesher hazze eno mityare ella min haadam shemma yizrok bo chetz, lefi sheen of poreach al gabbav, lechach notno al kenafav, omer mutav yikkanes hachetz bi velo bivni, af ani asiti chen: "vayyissa malach haelohim vegomer, vayyavo ben machane mitzrayim vegomer" (Shemot 14), vehayu mitzrayim zorkim chitztzim veavne balisteraot veheanan mekabbelam:
Vaavi etchem elay. ketargumo:
ohc: Attem reitem vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat el elyon bema sheddikdek lomar asher asiti lemitzrayim, sheyyoter haya lo lomar "asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim", shehu ikkar haddavar lehitchayyev lehishtabed ulechabbek amarav al kol asher gemalam Adonai. veim lehazekir nifleotav, hare hem reshumim beamro "asher hotzeti meeretz mitzrayim", veyadua hu ki lo hotziam ella beemtzaut hammassot haggedolot.

Vehinne lefi ma shepperashnu ki yechavven Adonai lishne devarim, shehem bechinat haahava uvechinat hayyira, laze rasham Adonai shenehem bemaamar ze. hayyira beamro asher asiti lemitzrayim, perush, asher yissarti yissure nekama lammemaen asot maamari, kamma makkot raot been mispar al asher meen asot mitzvati leshalleach etchem, vehaya haddavar hazze lachem leot laover al mitzvati ki etnakkem mimmennu beyissure nekama vetzarot rabbot kaasher reitem ukechu musar. venitkavven Adonai lirmoz lahem shehem begeder ze atzmo shel hammitzrim im yemaanu lishmoa el hattora veel hammitzvot, vezo bechinat hayyira yirat haonesh. gam yesh benishma maamar asher asiti yirat harommut bechol hanniflaot vehaotot vehammoftim asher asa lemitzrayim. gam baze hera bechinat haahava vehachibba shekkol ze asa bishvilenu, hirish kol habberia veibbed umma achat bishvilenu, uletzad ze yitlahev adam bechibbat habbore asher hifli chasdo lahem, vehinne hi bechinat haahava laAdonai elohenu. vehem shene devarim harmuzim beamro tomar levet yaakov shello taspik hayyira vetzarich gam haahava, vetagged livne yisrael shello taspik bechinat haahava vetzarich gam hayyira, vehattaam kemo shekkatavnu.

Vaessa etchem. hinne heerich haadon bivchinat haahava, ki hu haikkar bammitzva lehareviach kefel hassachar, vetzarich hitatztzemut gadol lehassigah. laze amar: reu chibbati bachem kerachem av al banim chavivin, sheafillu midderech kaf raglechem chasti alav venasati etchem al kanfe nesharim, perush, anne chavod hayu memutztzaim tachtam. vechen hu omer (Devarim 8:4): "veraglecha lo vatzeka". veod yesh leeloah millin leorer haahava, ma sheen ken hayyira shebbenakel tikkanes belev haadam, laze hispik lo birmizato bemaamar "asher asiti lemitzrayim" kemo shepperashti.

Vaavi etchem elay. yirtze ki lo kadam hakeravatam el Adonai kemishpat kol hakkarev hakkarev lemishkan Adonai, sheyyakdim hu leorer chibbato, kayyadua sheen elohe olam makdim lekarev ad sheyyeorer hammitkarev et haahava, vechen hu mehammusar ki hahedyotot vehakkallim hem hammishtaddelim lehitkarev ligdolim venichbadim mehem, umikkol shekken im eved moshlim, veaf al pi chen amar Adonai ki lo chen asa, ella hagam shehayu goy mikkerev goy erom veerya belo shum hitorrut, af al pi chen ani heveti etchem elay velo attem hitkaravtem elay.

Od yirtze lomar, sheachar shehotziam mimmitzrayim hayu chozrim meachare hashshechina, kemo shemmatzinu lahem shehimru imre el beyam suf, bamman uvasselav vechaddome, af al pi chen haya Adonai moshcham elav bechol et shehayu chozrim laachorehem, umevian umekarvan elav yitbarach.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (haggada shel pesach) illu lo hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu et avotenu mimmitzrayim miyyad kulei, vehattaam kede shello yishtakkeu bivchinat hara betumat mitzrayim velo tihye chas veshalom od tekuma lesonehem shel yisrael, laze miher lehotziam kede sheyyaamdu bemakom kadosh, vehu amro vaavi etchem elay, diyyek tevat elay lishlol hishtakkeut bachelek hara rachmana litzlan, vehaven:

Od yirtze lishlol taanat hattoen, ki halo matzinu lo (sifre beracha) shehalach leseir ufaran leyishmael veesav vehizminam lekabbel tora velo kibbelu letaam sheamru, veim ken ma maala zo shemmeromem leam yisrael? laze amar vaavi vegomer, perush, al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut haruveni 280 balak) befasuk (Bamidbar 23:4) "vayyikkar elohim el bilam" vegomer, mashal lemelech shebba ohavo ledabber immo vechulei ad kan. perush, ki attem heveti etchem elay, ma sheen ken hem sheshshalachti lahem limkomam leseir ulefaran, veen ze ella lidchotam leatid lavo ulechayyevam baddin, ma sheen ken attem ki dati uretzoni lekarevchem elay, veen ledammot maase yisrael lemaase edom veyishmael.

Veose chesed laalafim vegomer. perush, sheggam ose chesed en hakkadosh baruch hu meshallem lo kol chasdo techef umiyyad, ella bocher lo ofen peraon hannaot lo ledorot, veholech uforea bechol dor asher yitztarech elav, veyesh bo davar hammaamid hagana vehatztzala ad alafim, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 44,3) sheim haya hakkadosh baruch hu porea laavot secharam baolam hazze, bema hayu mitparnesim benehem bechol dor vador uvaggaluyyot.

Veamro uleshomre mitzvotay, pershu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sota lo,1) sheenah nimshechet im "laalafim", ki ellu shehem ovdim miyyira im yitztarchu haddorot lizchuto lo yaarich ella ad elef, kemo shemmeforash befasuk acher, dichtiv (Devarim 7:9) "leelef dor" vegomer.

rashi: Vayyashev moshe et divre haam vegomer. beyom hammochorat, shehu shelishi, shehare behashekama ala; vechi tzarich haya moshe lehashiv? ella ba hakkatuv lelammedcha derech eretz mimmoshe, shello amar hoil veyodea mi sheshshelachani eni tzarich lehashiv (shabbat 87):
ohc: Vayyashev moshe. perush leshon chazara, ki millevad ma shekkadma hayyedia labbore mitteshuvat yisrael, ki hu yodea nistarot bechilyot haadam umikkol shekken hanniglot, od hechzir haddevarim paam sheniyya, vehattaam hu lishvach hatteshuva kaasher avaer besamuch. o yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (mechilta) sheamar Adonai lemoshe "hachezer li teshuva", laze amar vayyashev perush ki letzad hatteshuva sheamar lo Adonai "hashiveni" vechulei hu sheasa, ki zulat ze mi yaggid lifne yodea kol baruch hu.

Et divre haam vegomer. en hakkavvana sheheshiv shekkibbelu laasot, ella heshiv laAdonai ofen seder hatteshuva sheanu kullam yachdav, al derech shepperashti, velo lehodaa ella nitkavven baze lefaer leromem am bene yisrael al kamma bechinot tovot asher taggid ofen hatteshuva, velaze hechzir moshe haddevarim lifne Adonai, al derech amro (divre hayamim 1 17:21) "umi cheammecha yisrael goy echad".

rashi: Vaydabber elohim. en elohim ella dayyan; lefi sheyyesh parashiyyot battora sheim asaan adam mekabbel sachar, veim lav eno mekabbel alehem puranut, yachol af aseret haddibberot ken, talo vaydabber elohim – dayyan lippara (mechilta):

Et kol haddevarim haelle. melammed sheamar hakkabba aseret haddibberot bedibbur echad, ma shei efshar leadam lomar ken, im ken ma talo od anochi velo yihye lecha? shechazar uferesh al kol dibbur vedibbur bifne atzmo (sham):
Lemor. melammed shehayu onin al hen hen veal lav lav (sham):
