ohc: Vaydabber vegomer et kol haddevarim vegomer. taam zichron shem elohim bintinat tora, lomar ki hattora nittena mimmiddat haddin umimmiddat harachamim, middat haddin vaydabber elohim, middat rachamim anochi Adonai, od hodia sod amro (Melachim 1 18:39) "Adonai hu haelohim", ki dibber elohim anochi Adonai, vehu ma sheanu meyachadim paamayim beahava befasuk "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad":

Od yitbaer al derech sheamar rav ketina (menachot ma,1) "anshitu aase" vechulei, ad kan, hare sheal ase lo yaanish hakkatuv. laze amar Adonai ki yavi Adonai bemishpat onesh al kol haddevarim gam laasin harshumim baaseret haddibberot: emunato yitbarach shehu ikkar hakkol harshumim bitchillat devar Adonai "anochi" vegomer, shabbat, kibbud av vaem. al ellu, hagam shehem ase, yesh elohim shoftim baaretz, vehu amro vaydabber elohim shehu bechinat haddin "et kol haddevarim", ben ase ben lo taase.
Od yirtze beamro et kol haddevarim, lomar ki en chefetz bimkabbel tora ella im yekabbel kol hattora, vechol hamekabbel alav tora chutz mimmitzva achat en lo tora (bechorot 30:).

Od yirtze al pi ma shehikdamti befarashat bereshit, ki kesheyyedabber Adonai betigboret hamechunnet leshem elohim, yedabber devarim muflaim asher en happe yachol ledabber, vehu sheyyomar haddevarim shelemim vechen rabbim bedibbur echad kaasher asa bivriat olam, kemo chen beyom mattan tora dibber betigboret et kol haddevarim bedibbur echad.

Veamro tevat lemor yitbaer behair ma sheyyesh lehair benosach aseret haddibberot, maddua shinna hakkatuv nosach dibbur middibbur, ki bitchilla hitchil ledabber beseder ze: anochi Adonai elohecha, hotzeticha, al panay, ki Adonai hu hamedabber al atzmo yitbarach shemo, veachar kach yatza ledabber bederech acher: et shem Adonai elohecha, lo yenakke Adonai, shabbat laAdonai elohecha, ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai, shehaya lo lesayyem kederech shehitchil al ze hadderech: "lo tissa et shemi, ki lo anakke, ki sheshet yamim asiti" vegomer.

Achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (makkot kad,1) "anochi" velo yihye lecha" mippi haggevura shemanum, perush, betigboret haddibbur yuvan ki kaasher dibber Adonai aseret haddevarim bedibbur echad kemo shekkatavnu besamuch, en haozen yechola lishmoa kol haggevurot. ucheshehishmiam leyisrael, hissigu hem shemoa shete dibberot mehem, shehem dibbur "anochi" vegomer vedibbur "lo yihye lecha", veyatzta nishmatam, keamro (Shir HaShirim 5:6) "nafshi yatza vedabbero", velo yachlu havin od. ushear haddibberot nechtzevu lahavot esh mikkolo yitbarach veamdu sedurim al har sinay, ad shechazra nishmat yisrael betal chayyim. bau haddibberot shehem kolot haaddir baruch hu vehayu medabberot lechol echad miyyisrael. velaze timtza sheanochi" velo yihye lecha" nechkeku battora keseder sheamaram Adonai: "anochi Adonai elohecha asher hotzeticha", ki haeloah bichvodo medabber nocheach leyisrael bead atzmo baruch hu, uchemo chen bemitzvat "lo yihye lecha" gam ken yedabber keseder ze. aval mishsham veelach yedabber kolo yitbarach bead malacho, keamro "shabbat laAdonai elohecha", "ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai", "al ken berach Adonai" vegomer, vechen kullam, ki eno yachol hakkol lomar "shabbat li" vegomer, "asiti et hashshamayim" vegomer "venatatti" vegomer, ki eno ella malacho yitbarach, vehaven veyeerav lechikkecha.

Vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (makkot 23:) ki moshe amaram leyisrael, efshar ki moshe haya bo koach veshama kullam, ucheshebbau hakkolot ledabber leyisrael haya kolo shel moshe gam ken medabber. veulay ki laze ramaz hakkatuv beamro (Shemot 19:19) "moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol". vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:2) shekkol dibbur vedibbur haya omed al kol echad veechad miyyisrael veomer lo "tekabbeleni alecha" vehu omer lo "hen" umechabbeko umenashsheko veole umitatter al rosho. ulefi ze yityashshev amro lemor al ze hadderech vaydabber elohim et kol vegomer, perush betigboret haelohim vedibber kullam bedibbur echad, gam asa koach baddibberot shehem beatzmam yeamru leyisrael kesheyyitztarchu, kemo shekken haya, ki keshello yachlu yisrael lishmoa kullam mehaggevura dibberu hem alehem kemo shekkatavnu.

Od yechavven beamro lemor, ki yesh beseder ze shennidberu bo haddevarim maala verommut leyisrael, al derech amro (Devarim 26:18) "vaAdonai heemircha" vegomer, ki harebe toaliyyot nimshechu mizze sheppaska zuhamatan, veze yesod keniyyat hakkedushsha bahem leolam.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma toldot) sheen hakkadosh baruch hu meyached shemo al hannivraim bachayyim chayyutam, mishshum (Iyov 15:15) "hen bikdoshav lo yaamin", velaze lo yiched shemo al avraham lomar alav "elohecha" ella achar moto. vehu amro vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle, perush betigboret haddibbur kemo shepperesh devarim sheen haozen yechola lishmoa, vehattaam hu lemor lahem "anochi Adonai elohecha", perush leyached shemo al kol echad veechad mehem lomar lo "elohecha", asher al ken hishmiam et kolo leyasseram lehaferid mehem hazzuhama, uvaze yihyu reuyim lomar lahem ken.

Uledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (shabbat pach:) sheamru shepparcha nishmatam, nimtzeta omer ki kesheyyiched shemo alehem haya zeman yetziat neshama, az amar lechol echad mehem "elohecha", vahagam shehayu bachayyim veshamu gam ken "lo yihye lecha" vegomer, lo yityaches lah ichur, ki hakkol amar Adonai bedibbur echad velo kadma afillu ot lachavertah.

Od amro lemor yechavven amram zichrono livracha (zohar 10 93:) shekkol hattora kullah remuza baaseret haddibberot, vehu amro lemor perush devarim ellu yesh bahem amarot acherot kelulot uremuzot. veraiti latet taam tov behashemaat Adonai leyisrael shete dibberot "anochi" velo yihye lecha", ki hem shene sharashim lishne kelalot hammitzvot: mitzvot ase umitzvot lo taase. anochi hi ikkar veshoresh kol mitzvot ase, lo yihye lecha vegomer hi ikkar veshoresh kol mitzvot lo taase, laze nata Adonai bahem mippi el elyon sharshe shene ikkere hammitzvot shebbaze lo timmot tora mizzarenu leolam vaed.

rashi: Ki nidmeti. hareni met, shello hayiti keday sheere pene hashshechina. vedugmato matzinu bemanoach "mot namut ki elohim rainu" (Shoftim 13:22):
Nidmeti. kemo "ki nidma kol am kenaan" (Tzefanya 1:11):
Teme sefatayim. "dimgaal bechovin" (targum yonatan):
targum: Vaamaret vay li are chavet are gevar chayav leochacha ana uvego ama demigal bechovin ana yativ are yat yekar shechinat melach almaya Adonai tzevaot chazaa enay:

rashi: Vayyisu merfidim. ma talo lachazor ulefaresh mehechan nasu, vahalo chevar katav shebbirfidim hayu chonim, beyadua shemmishsham nasu? ella lehakkish nesiatan merfidim leviatan lemidbar sinay, ma biatan lemidbar sinay bitshuva, af nesiatan merfidim bitshuva (mechilta):
Vayyichan sham yisrael. keish echad belev echad, aval shear kol hachaniyyot betaromot uvemachaloket:
Neged hahar. lemizracho, vechol makom sheatta motze neged, panim lammizrach (sham):
ohc: Vayyisu merfidim. kashe lamma icher hammukdam, ki pasuk ze haya lo lehakedim kodem pasuk shellefanav sheamar "bau midbar sinay"? veulay shehu al derech amram (sanhedrin 105:) ahava mekalkelet hashshura lehakedim hammeuchar, shelleheyot ki hu ze yom hamekuvve labbore lattora laolam, laelyonim velattachtonim, umiyyom habberia vehem yoshvim umetzappim matay yavou bene yisrael midbar sinay, laze keshehiggiu shamma lo atzru koach lesapper seder haddavar vetechef kadma hahodaa beamro bayyom hazze bau vegomer, higgia chashuk venechshak lechoshek vechashuk, vesamchu shamayim vaaretz ki ze hu tachlit habberia vetikvatah, veachar kach chazar hakkatuv lehodia peratan shel devarim.

Od yirtze behair od amro vayyavou midbar sinay, vahalo kevar amar bakkatuv shellefanav "bau midbar sinay". od tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "vayyachanu bammidbar", halo muvan hu haddavar ki bimkom biatam chanu.
Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu lehakedim shelosha inyanim hem ikkere hahachana lekabbalat hattora, shebbeemtzautam nitratztza Adonai lehanechilam nachalat shadday hi toratenu hanneima.

Haechad hu hitgabberut vehitatztzemut beesek hattora, ki haatzlut hu esev hammafsid hassagatah. velaze timtza ki chol makom sheyyazkirenna Adonai lattora yedakdek lomar leshon chozek veometz, ad geder sheyyamit atzmo aleha, dichtiv (bammidbar 19,14) "zot hattora adam ki yamut" vegomer vedarshu zichrono livracha (shabbat fag,2) vechulei. kemo chen rabbotenu zichrono livracha yedakdeku behazekaratah lomar "esek hattora", "hishtaddelut hattora", verabbim kamohu. veayyen ma shepperashti besifri "chefetz Adonai" shechibbarti al ketzat mimmassechtot hashshas bekatnuti bemaamar rabbotenu zichrono livracha (shabbat pach,2) lammayminim bah vechulei, vetire ki lo tussag hahassaga ella behitatztzemut gadol. ucheneged zo amar hakkatuv vayyisu merfidim, lo ba lehodia makom shemmimmennu nasu, sheim ken haya lo lehakedimo kodem tachanotam, ella nitkavven lomar shennasu mibbechinat rifyon yadayim, kemo shemmatzinu sheddarshu ken rabbotenu zichrono livracha (sanhedrin kav,1) befasuk (Shemot 17,8) "vayyillachem im yisrael birfidim" – berifyon yadayim, ad kan. vehen atta nasu mibbechina zo vehechinu atzmam laavod avodat massa benoam Adonai, vehu amro vayyavou midbar sinay.

Veinyan sheni hu hashshiflut vehaanava, ki en divre tora mitkayyemin ella bemi shemmashpil atzmo umesim atzmo kemidbar, ucheneged ze amar vayyachanu bammidbar, perush leshon shiflut vaanava kammidbar shehakkol dorchim alav.

Veinyan shelishi hu bechinat yiud chachamim behitchabberut belev shalem vetamim, lo sheyyihyu bad bevad shealehem amar hakkatuv (yirmeya 50:36) "cherev el habbaddim" (berachot 63,1), ella yitvaadu yachad vichaddedu ze laze veyasbiru panim ze laze, ucheneged ze amar vayyichan sham yisrael leshon yachid shennaasu kullan yachad keish echad, vehen atta hem reuyim lekabbalat hattora.

rashi: Derech atzel kimsuchat chadek. dome beenav keillu hadderachim gedurim lefanav begeder chadakim:
Mesuchat. gader, kemo "haser mesuchato" (yeshaya 5:5). chadek – kotzim:

Veorach yesharim selula. kevusha umufena. umidrash aggada (tanchuma, ki tissa 1): darko shel esav kekotz ze hannisbach begizzat tzemer, im tittelehu mikkan, hu mitare bechan; kach en adam yachol latzet yede alilotav belo mamon:
targum: Orchehon deatle kartzuve vechuve veorcha ditetze shafya:

rashi: Iatzcha vihi elohim immach. baetza; amar lo tze himmalech baggevura (mechilta):
Heye atta laam mul haelohim. shaliach umelitz benotam lammakom veshoel mishpatim meitto:
Et haddevarim. divre rivotam:
Vehigbalta. keva lahem techumin lesiman, shello yikrevu min haggevul vahala:
Lemor. haggevul omer lahem hishshamru mealot mikkan ulehala, veatta hazehirem al kach:
Unegoa bekatzehu. afillu vekatzehu:
ohc: Vehigbalta vegomer. nire sheen mitzvat hagebala zo ella layyom hashshelishi, veaf al pi chen hikdimah meatta kede sheyyinhagu bo kavod meachshav, gam yargilu atzmam lehitrachek mimmennu bishloshet yamim, veen lomar sheyyinhog chiyyuv hannegia bahar miyyom tzauoto, ze eno, ki hu davar rachok sheyyitkaddesh hahar veyitchayyevu alav kodem redet shechinato yitbarach. vechen mashma mimmatnita besifre (mechilta kad) ki lo hitchil hachiyyuv ella miyyom shelishi.

rashi: Holech vechazek meod. minhag hedyot kol zeman shehu maarich litkoa kolo machalish vechohe, aval kan holech vechazek meod, velamma kach mittechilla? lesabber aznehem ma sheyyecholin lishmoa:

Moshe yedabber. keshehaya moshe medabber umashmia haddibberot leyisrael – shehare lo shamu mippi haggevura ella anochi velo yihye lecha – vehakkabba mesayyeo latet bo choach lihyot kolo magbir venishma (sham):
Yaanennu vekol. yaanennu al devar hakkol, kemo asher yaane vaesh (Melachim 1 18) – al devar haesh, lehorido:
ohc: Moshe yedabber vehaelohim vegomer. ulay shehaya moshe medabber lifne Adonai divre shir veshevach kimkabbel pene melech haggadol baruch hu, vehaelohim yaanennu vekol perush bakkol haamur besamuch shehu kol hashshofar kemi shemmitratztze bidvarav. o yomar yaanennu lema shehaya medabber lo, veamro vekol perush bekol gadol, baavur yishma haam bedabbero immo kemo shekkatavnu lemala shebbaze yatzdiku nevuato. veroani ki yesh baze tosefet haderaga, ki haya Adonai one ledivre moshe, veze yoter maala mimma shehaya Adonai medabber techilla veyaanehu moshe. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (mechilta) sheyyechavven al haddibberot sheshshamu mippi moshe shehaya Adonai magbiah kolo shel moshe vechulei, veze derech derash uchefattish vegomer.

rashi: Haleot anashim. nevie Adonai:
Ki talu vegomer. lefi shehu yodea sheattem en maaminim bo, vehogatem lefanav berishachem:
targum: Vaamar shemau chean bet david hazeer lechon deattun mehalan yat neviya are tehalun af yat pitgame elahay:

rashi: Meor enayim. battora:

Yesammach lev. sheshshoalin mimmennu davar veyodea ma lehashiv. ulefi peshuto kemashmao: davar shehu taava lemarot enayim, yesammach hallev umetzachtzeach tugat hallev, kegon gan yarak uneharot hammoshchim:
targum: Nehora deayne machare libba shumeata tava medahana garma:

ohc: Vayyikra lezikne haam. hinne nitchakkem moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom bishlichuto laasotah behitbonnut, ki yare ufachad levavo dilma teera takkala baddavar shehu tachlit hakkol veikkar haolam, uchevar achazu chavalim laaretz shemma chas veshalom lo yekabbelu yisrael et hattora, venitchakkem alav hashshalom velo dibber lichlalut haam ad shekkara lazzekenim vehoshivam lefanav vechol yisrael yachad shomim divre moshe, ella shehikbil haddevarim lifne hazzekenim, vehoil baze kede shello yatchilu lehashiv lemoshe ella hazzekenim velo kelalut haam, ki chash dilma chas veshalom yaanu mehaam teshuva shello kahogen, ma sheen ken hazzekenim muvtach hu bahem shetteshuvatam tihye kahogen, veachar sheyyashivu hazzekenim kahogen haam yittu acharehem, velu yihye ki yikhu shinnehem chas veshalom, kol zaken vezaken yedabber livne mishpachto. veulay ki bene el chay noda lahem hitchakkemut moshe ki chash lemeun chas veshalom vehotziu atzmam mehachashad velo hinnichu lazzekenim lehashiv techilla, veanu kol haam yachdav, kol asher dibber Adonai naase middatenu hashshelema uvirtzonenu happashut, velo kadma teshuvat hazzekenim litshuvat kol am Adonai. vehinne heru bene yisrael otzem achdutam vehashevaat retzonam belohenu, ki shishshim ribbo amru behashevaa dibbur echad keamro "yachdav", velo nitacher echad mehem velo kadam echad lachavero velo shinna echad mehem lehashiv benosach acher, ashre olam sheumma zo betocho. uvaze yeduyyak maamar hannavi (yirmeya 2:2) "ko amar Adonai zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich", perush amro "kelulotayich" hu teshuvatam sheanu kol haam yachdav sheasu shete kelaliyyot baahava: ha teshuva kahogen mikkullam veen gam echad shello nitratztza baddavar, 2 shehushvu yachad bekol hatteshuva uvilshon hatteshuva al derech shekkatavnu.
Et kol vegomer. nitkavven beamro et kol shello shinna mehodaat kol belo migraat, veamro haelle shello hosif ledabber davar kemaamar Adonai elav (Shemot 19:6) ella haddevarim.

rashi: Vekiddashtam. vezimmantam, sheyyachinu atzmam hayyom umachar:
Vetochen ruchot Adonai. umone hallevavot, mi hattov umi hara:
targum: Kulhon archateh degavra dachyan inun beaynoy velaha matken archateh:

rashi: Veod bah asiriyya. gam otah hashsheerit ashiv yadi aleha betzeruf achar tzeruf, vehayta levaer ad shello yishshaaru ella tzaddikim gemurim sheyyashuvu elay bechol libbam:

Kaela vechaallon. asher beet zeman shallechet shellahen, mashlichin alin shellahen bime hassetav shilluch achar shilluch, ad sheen notar bah zulati hammatztzevet. af hem, zera hakkodesh hannimtzain bah, omdim bikdushato, hem yihyu lah lematztzevet. davar acher: matztzavtah – netiatah, lechach eni mechalle otam, netatim zera kodesh. veyesh potrim: shaar shallechet hayta birushalayim, kemo sheamar beezra (divrei hayamim 1 26:16), vehayu sham ela veallon netuim:
targum: Veyishtaarun bah chad min asra tzadikaya vituvun vihon litzrava kevutema vechivlota divmitar tarpohi damin leyavshin vead kean inun rativan lekayama minhon zara ken galuta deyisrael yitkanshun vituvun learahon are zara dekudesha nitzvathon:

rashi: Et mi eshlach. lehochiach et yisrael? shalachti et amos vehayu korin oto pesilus, lefi shehaya kevad lashon, vehu nitnabbe "shenatayim lifne haraash" (Amos 1:1), vehayu yisrael omrim: hinniach hakkadosh baruch hu et haolam vehishra shechinato al hadden ketia lishna vechulei, kidita bappesikta (Pesikta derav kahana 16, 4):
targum: Ushemait yat kal memra dayya daamar yat man ashalach leitnabbaa uman yezel lealafa vaamarit ha ana shelach yati:

rashi: Lo yuchal haam. eni tzarich lehaid bahem, shehare mutrim veomdin hem hayyom sheloshet yamim, velo yuchelu laalot sheen lahem reshut:
ohc: Vayyomer moshe vegomer lo yuchal vegomer. tzarich ladaat tochen mashmaut inyan hahefresh ben moshe uven Adonai, ki Adonai amar lo "red haed" vegomer velo hispik ma shekkevar tzivva kodem, umoshe makshe veomer ki eno tzarich veday bema shekkadam mehatztziuuy vehahatraa.

Venire ki mittechilla tzivva Adonai al yisrael leval yaalu uleval yiggeu bahar bederech kelal, ucheshechazar Adonai lomar lemoshe sheyyitkaddeshu hakkohanim veramaz lo sheyyesh lahem makom bahar laamod bo, uchemo sheddiyyaknu meamro "hanniggashim el Adonai yitkaddashu", chash sheyyisrael yadunu bedin ze din davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal shellelammed al hakkelal yatza, vehakkohanim vehaam veaharon hakkol bichlal negiat vaaliyyat har hayu, uchesheyyatzu kohanim lehattir chelek bahar lelammed al hakkelal yatza veyutteru kol yisrael bachelek shehutteru bo hakkohanim, ulefachot bachelek shellematta mimmennu behaderaga. vahagam sheadayin lo nittena tora ladaat mishpat ze, efshar sheyyimmatze betoch shishshim ribbo yisrael chacham sheyyadin bechachmato kaze. o lu yihye shello yadun adam din ze middato, im kol ze Adonai ohev mishpat tzedek velo yachol lechayyevo mita lannogea bahar bimkom amidat hakkohanim achar shekkefi mishpat hattora patur hu kannizkar. laze chazar Adonai lomar lo "red haed baam", uvaze satar sheen ladun bedin ze davar shehaya bakkelal, shehare gilla haddavar beferush leesor chelek hahar sheyyaalu bo hakkohanim. umoshe lo hevin divre Adonai vechavvanato kemo shepperashnuha, ki adayin lo gilla lo Adonai middot shehattora nidreshet bahem, vesavar ki davka aharon vehakkohanim shehittiram Adonai, aval yisrael beissuram omdim, velaze tzaak libbo ki azhara zo enah tzericha ki "lo yuchal" vegomer shekkevar haedota banu. veheshivo Adonai "lech red vealita atta" vegomer, veal perate hammekomot sheani mattir lecha uleaharon velakkohanim ani mazhircha shettaed behagebalatam, hare ze more beetzba ki letzad ma sheggilla bahem hahetter hu shehutzerach lachzor leasram.

Ulefi ma shepperashnu beamro "hanniggashim" vegomer, shehakkavvana hu hanniggashim laavodat hammishkan, gam ken yihye taam chazarat haazhara kemo shepperashnu, letzad davar shehaya bakkelal, ella ki adayin lo gilla Adonai hetter aliyyat aharon vehakkohanim, shemmitztziddah hutzrach lachazor paam sheniyya haazhara. vetechef kadam moshe, kodem sheyyigmor haddibbur shel hetter aliyyat hakkohanim, veamar lo yuchal vegomer. vechazar Adonai vehodio hitbonnut haddevarim veamar lo lech red vealita atta vegomer vehakkohanim – hare hittir chelek mealiyyat hahar, vetechef samuch mammash amar lo vehaam al yehersu, perush kol ikkar, vehakkohanim lo yehersu limkom aharon, veaharon limkom moshe. veaz hiskil daat elyon al derech shepperashti shehammechush hu leval yadunu davar shehaya bakkelal vechulei, uremazo el elyon beseder haddibbur shehikdim lomar lo vealita vegomer vehakkohanim vegomer veachar kach vehaam al yehersu vegomer. uvaze matzanu nachat ruach bemaamar sheni sheamar Adonai lemoshe vealita atta vegomer, vekashe mimma nafshach: im hoda lo Adonai al teshuvato, im ken lamma chazar lomar paam sheniyya "vehaam al yehersu"? vedavar ze pashut hu ki kavvanato hi sheyyomar ken leyisrael, im ken lo nitkabbela teshuvat moshe. veim nomar gam ken shello hoda al divre moshe, lamma lo heshivo techef listor devarav ad shehikdim lomar "vealita atta veaharon vehakkohanim"? ki haya lo laAdonai ligmor inyan hashshelichut shehitchil letzavvoto alav sheamar lo "haed baam" vegomer, veachar kach yetzav hael davar chadash shehu inyan aliyyat aharon vehakkohanim shello hizkiro ad atta. uvema shepperashti yavo al nachon, ki leolam lo baa mitzvat "haed baam" ella letzad hetter gevulin shel aharon, ella shello himtin moshe ad gamran shel devarim. velaze bedivre Adonai elav hikdim tashlum haddevarim shello hispik moshe leshamam, shehu taam haazhara, veamar lo vealita atta veaharon vehakkohanim – hare hittir gevul mehahar leaharon ugevul lakkohanim, vegamar omer vehaam al yehersu laggevulin shel aharon vehakkohanim, ella kol hahar beissur.

Od nire lomar taam hahatraa paam sheniyya, leheyot ki hateraa rishona lo neemar bah zeman meematay matchil haissur, vahagam shehizkir sham "sheloshet yamim", lo neemru beferush beinyan issur hagebalat hahar shemmatchil miyyom hashshelishi, venimtza sheadayin lo yadu yisrael zeman hatechalatah. laze kesheyyarad Adonai techef amar lemoshe sheyyered lehaed vegomer, shehu mishshaa zo vaelach, uteshuvat moshe tzarich iyyun. veulay ki moshe chashav ki issur hagebalat hahar hi meet tzauotam, kevan shello nitbaer beferush "lo tigga bo yad" beyom peloni, hatechalat hammitzva hi meet haazhara, velo chen haya daat elyon. velaze haya alav devar Adonai chazak lachzor lomar ki ze hu zeman hahagbala. velichshennomar ki chen hayta daat elyon sheissur negiat hahar yatchil meet tzauoto, taam shehutzrach haazhara paam sheniyya, ki befaam rishona amar "ki sakol yissakel o" vegomer, hare zo mitat bet din, vechan chiddesh ki mi shello haraguhu yisrael she yifrotz vegomer. vedikdek lomar leshon rabbim, lomar shehagam sheyyehersu kullam lirot, yedinem bedin shamayim veyifrotz bam Adonai.

rashi: Lech red. vehaed bahem shenit, shemmezarzin et haadam kodem maase vechozrin umezarzin oto bishat maase (mechilta):

Vealita atta veaharon immach vehakkohanim. yachol af hem immecha, talo vealita atta, emor meatta, atta mechitztza leatzmecha, veaharon mechitztza leatzmo, vehakkohanim mechitztza leatzmam – moshe niggash yoter meaharon, veaharon yoter min hakkohanim, vehaam kol ikkar al yehersu et matztzavam laalot el Adonai (sham):
Pen yifrotz bam. aappi shehu nakud chataf kamatz eno zaz miggezerato, kach derech kol teva shennekuddatah melafum, keshehi semucha vaa bemakkaf, mishtanne hannikkud lachataf kamatz:
ohc: Red vealita vegomer immach. kafal lomar lech red, achat legufah veachat lomar lo leshon yerida. veulay shehayyerida hi ki mikkodem lo haya lemoshe makom mugebal bahar vehaya ole lerosh hahar, ucheshesserev amar lo red vealita vegomer, perush keshem sheaharon yesh lo gevul gam atta yesh lecha gevul, vehu amro "immach", hare hishva haachim bivchinat haggevul.

rashi: Achar shillucheha. kesheamar lo hakkabba bemidyan lech shuv mitzrayim vayyikkach moshe et ishto veet banav vegomer veyatza aharon likrato vayyifgeshehu behar haelohim (Shemot 4), amar lo mi hem hallalu? amar lo zo hi ishti shennasati bemidyan veellu vanay, amar lo vehechan atta molichan? amar lo lemitzrayim, amar lo al harishonim anu mitztaarim veatta va lehosif alehem amar lah lechi levet avich, natla shene vaneha vehalcha lah (mechilta):
ohc: Vayyikkach yitro choten moshe. perush, letzad shehaya choten moshe matza asot kacha shehalach lehar haelohim vegomer, shehinnichuhu miyyirato shel moshe ki nafla emato al kol haammim, aval zulat ze hayu monin oto millechet lichpor beemunatam, uma gam shechashud haya beenehem, vetimtza shekkol umma techayyev mita lakkofer beemunatam, uletzad heyot yitro lechoten moshe hi sheamda lo. veulay sheyyirmoz od ki hagam shehaya leyitro kinnuy shel gedulla likkarot "kohen midyan", maas bechinnuy ze velakach lo kinnuy "choten moshe", vehu amro vayyikkach yitro, uma lakach mehashshene yichusin sheyyichaso hakkatuv bitchilla, choten moshe lo kohen midyan.

Achar shillucheha – taam shehutzrach lomar "achar shillucheha", gam dikdek lomar leshon shilluchin, vezulat divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 4,4) shekkatavti befasuk "et kol asher asa" vegomer, nire lomar ki moshe gershah kesheraa shehaya osek bemitzvat shelichuto yitbarach, lo yada shiur hazzeman veshillechah mibbeto. vehabbanim – eliezer katan haya vetzarich leimmo shennolad badderech bammalon, vegershom min hassetam katan haya samuch leeliezer millefanav, o ledivrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (mechilta) shehitna im yitro ben echad labbat uven sheni laav, letaam ze nimtzeu shenehem beyadah. vechavvanat hodaat Adonai haddavar kan lomar shevach yitro umaalat moshe beenav, shehagam sheshshillechah lekachah vetarach bichvodo uveatzmo leholichah lo afillu achar shillucheha. ella ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba) sheamru shello shillechah ella samach al havetachat yitro ki yadav teviennah, nire lomar ki taam amro achar shillucheha perush shello haya haddavar ella ad shekkadma veshalcha lo lemoshe sheluchim veyada mekom tachanoto vehiskim al yadah, az hu shellakach yitro vegomer vayyavo el hammidbar vegomer.

rashi: Ushear yashuv benecha. sheerit meat sheyyashuvu elay al yadcha, vehem kevanecha:
El ketze tealat. sham timtzaehu. tealat – 596 109:
Berecha. keen mikve mayim sheosim ledagim:
Haelyona. bemorad hahar, veyesh berecha acheret lematta hemenna betachtito:

Sede choves. sade shehakkovsim shotchim sham begadim lenaggevam, kach tirgem yonatan. verabbotenu darshu (sanhedrin 104 1): nichna achaz lifne yeshayahu vesam al rosho ochla dekatztzare, kafa alav keli, perush keli menukkav shel kovsim shemmezallefin bo mayim al habbegadim:
targum: Vaamar Adonai lishaya puk kean likodamut achaz at ushear talmidach dela chato udetavu mecheta lisyafe mezikat berechata ileta di bechevash chakal mashtach ketziraya:

rashi: Vayyichad yitro. vayyismach yitro, zehu peshuto. umia naasa vesaro chiddudin chiddudin, metzer al ibbud mitzrayim, haynu deamre inashe "giyyora ad asara dare la tevazze arammaa beappeh":

Al kol hattova. tovat hamman vehabbeer vehattora, veal kullan asher hitztzilo miyyad mitzrayim; ad achshav lo haya eved yachol livroach mimmitzrayim, shehayta haaretz mesuggeret, veellu yatzu shishshim ribbo (mechilta):
ohc: Vayyichad yitro. targum uneklos "vachdi". vetzarich ladaat lamma yedabber hakkatuv kan aramit velo amar lashon barur shehu leshon hakkodesh. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (sota lev,1) beshivim lashon, af al pi chen davar yaggid beshannoto et tamo.

Venire ki yodia hakkatuv ki merov hassimcha nitchadded besaro, ki timtza keshettihye leadam simcha vehu davar shello kefi hameshoar bammussag haragil tivvaled bo haregasha beharekavat mizgo, velifamim yitallef velifamim yistakken mammash. veayyen ma shepperashti bevayyiggash befasuk (Bereshit 45:26) "lemor od yosef chay". vehinne yitro hagam shekkadam etzlo yedia mibbesorot hattovot, af al pi chen kesheshshama tochen hannes, uma gam birdifat hammalach otam kemo shepperashti befasuk (8) "vaysapper moshe" vehitztzilam Adonai, nitchadded besaro. vedavar ze muregash hu etzel kol baal chay margish.

rashi: Vekara ze el ze. notlin reshut ze mizze, shello yakdim haechad veyatchil veyitchayyev serefa, ella im ken patchu kullam keechad; vezehu sheyyissad beyotzer or: 'kedusha kullam keechad onim. umidrash aggada maase merkava hu; vechen tirgem yonatan:
Kadosh kadosh kadosh. shalosh peamim, ketargumo:
targum: Umekabbelin den min den veamrin kadish bishme meroma ilaa vet shechinteh kadish al ara ovad gevureteh kadish lealam ulealme almaya Adonai tzevaot malya chol ara ziv yekareh:

rashi: Ashan kullo. en ashan ze shem davar, shehare nakud hashshin pattach, ella leshon paal kemo amar, shamar, shama, lechach targumo tenan kulle, velo tirgem tenana, vechol ashan shebbammikra nekudim kamatz mippene shehem shem davar:

Hakkivshan. shel sid; yachol kechivshan ze velo yoter, talo boer baesh ad lev hashshamayim (Devarim 4), uma talo kivshan? lesabber et haozen ma shehi yechola lishmoa – noten labberiyyot siman hannikkar lahem; kayyotze bo kearye yishag (Hoshea 11), vechi mi natan koach baari ella hu? vehakkatuv moshlo kearye, ella anu mechannin umedammin oto livriyyotav kede lesabber et haozen ma sheyyechola lishmoa; kayyotze vo vekolo kekol mayim rabbim (Yechezkel 43), vechi mi natan kol lammayim ella hu? veatta mechanne oto, ledammoto livriyyotav – kede lesabber et haozen (mechilta):
ohc: Ashan kullo. perush, sheshshalat haesh begufo shel har venisrefu avanav kemishpat hakkivshan asher yisrefu bo haavanim laasot sid, umeatta avne sinay naasu sid. veamro vayyecherad kol hahar, ki chen derech haavanim kesheshsholet bahem esh bakkivshan yitzazeu veyashmiu kol charada:

rashi: Bishnat mot. keshennitztara (tanchuma tzav 13):
Veshulav. kemo "shule hammeil" (Shemot 28:34), tachtito. reitiv yoshev al kisse bashshamayim, veraglav bahechol, hadom margelotav bevet hammikdash, ladun al uzziyya shebba littol keter kehunna:
targum: Beshatta deitnaga bah malka uziya amar neviya chazeti yat yekara dayya share al kureseh ram umitnatel bishme meroma umiziv yekareh itmele hechla:

rashi: Bayyom hazze. berosh chodesh; lo haya tzarich lichtov ella bayyom hahu, mahu bayyom hazze? sheyyihyu divre tora chadashim alecha keillu hayyom netanam (berachot 63):
ohc: Bachodesh hashshelishi vegomer. hinne lema shekkadam meotzem chibbato yitbarach beyisrael vegodel cheshko latet lahem arusatam zot hattora, tikshe lamma nitakkev Adonai mittet hattora ad chodesh hashshelishi, ki min simane haahava hi shello yitakkev choshek mibbo lachashukato. veim letzad hadderech, halo matzinu sheafillu leeliezer eved avraham kaftza lo haaretz (sanhedrin 95,1) belechto lakachat ishsha leyitzchak, umikkol shekken vekal vachomer lachatunnat nesiat rosh ki tikpotz haaretz vegam hashshamayim im yitztarchu lah.

Asher al ken ba hakkadosh baruch hu venatan amatla laddavar, ki lo miut hacheshek hu hassovev, ella letzad hachesharat hechatan, ki lo hayu yisrael reuyim letzad shehayu baaretz hattemea vehayu lenidda benehem, vehutzrechu lispor sefirat tohoratam sheva shabbatot kederech shiva nekiyyim asher tzivva Adonai lezava (zohar 11 97:), vehu amro letzet bene yisrael, perush, lesibbat yetziatam meeretz mitzrayim hu hassovev akkavat haddavar ad hachodesh hashshelishi. veharaya, ki keshekkarvu yeme hachesharatam bo bayyom nasu bo bayyom bau, vehu amro bayyom hazze, perush, shennasu bo bayyom bau, vechen huva bedivrehem zichronam livracha (shabbat paz:) shebbayyom shennasu bo bau. vehitztzatzti bainyan vaere otzem chishko yitbarach beyisrael shennikkeret mittoch maasav, behair lamma hitricham Adonai badderech ad hachodesh hashshelishi. veim lassibba shekkatavnu adayin tikshe shehaya lo likpotz haaretz ulehaggia lemidbar sinay bo bayyom, vesham yitakkevu ad sefor shiva shavuot veyihye zeman hakkosher kannizkar.

Achen ze yaggid otzem cheshek netinat hattora leyisrael, ki legodel chishko baruch hu bahem lo ratza lahaviam ulehitakkev zeman aroch belo chatunna bevet chatnut, velaze haya memaet hayyamim berichuk makom. vetikkach lecha shiuran shel devarim mechashuk vachashukato, ki lo yitztaer beakkavato mibbo eleha kol zeman shello higgiu et dodim vaadayin lo alta kalla lechuppatah, asher lo chen beet kalla bechuppatah lo yaatzor koach leakkev biato eleha:

rashi: Ki yavo. kemo ki va, leshon hove:
Lidrosh elohim. ketargumo "lemitba ulpan" – lishol talmud mippi haggevura:
ohc: Ki yavo elay haam vegomer. kashe, ma teshuva zo osa, vahalo raa yitro ki va elav haam lidrosh, vechavvanat kushyato hu lamma yitnaheg beminhag ze ki yesh torach laam. udevarav barur millelu "atta yoshev levaddecha", perush, veen shoftim acherim ladun haam, velu yihye shello hevin moshe devarav, haya lo lishol gezerat haddibbur, lo sheyyomar lo devarim shealehem hu makshe.

Venire ki moshe hevin bedivre yitro bema sheamar asher atta ose vegomer, mashma ki moshe machricham umechayyevam shello laamod lifne dayyan zulato, veze sibba shessovlim haam hattorach, veim yachpotz yemanne alehem dayyanim veyelchu ladun lifnehem. laze heshivo ki lo mimmennu ella mehaam, ki yavo meatzmo elay velo lezulati chafetz lalechet. uletzad sheyyikshe lecha lamma yachpetzu betorach ze, hattaam hu ki yihye lahem davar ba elay, veamru zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 2 78.) ba elay haddavar atzmo veyitztaddek haddin laamitto, vedavar ze lo yimmatze bezulati.
Umeatta en metziut lemannot dayyanim veyelchu haam lifnehem, vegamar omer vehodati vegomer, perush gam davar ze i efshar bezulati.

Veyitro nistappek bemashmaut divre moshe shessovel shete derachim. haachat, ki letzad shebbaim etzlo haam hu chash al hammitzva ladun ben ish vegomer laasotah hu velo acherim, vehashsheniyya, ki haam lo yachpetzu lezulato letzad ma shepperashnu bidvarav. laze heshivo keneged hammuvan middevarav ki yivchar asot hammitzva beatzmo velo yimna asot tov amar lo tov haddavar asher atta vegomer, kaasher yevaer hattaam. ucheneged ma shemmuvan middevarav ki haam lo yitratztzu lalechet lezulato, amar iatzcha vegomer heye atta laam vegomer veatta techeze vegomer veshaftu et haam bechol et, perush, bechol din sheyyihye hammishpat ratzuy lishne baale dinim, umin hassetam kesheyyadunu lahem mishpat ratzuy lamma yivcharu battorach haggadol, vehaya vegomer, perush uchesheyyihye davar gadol shel hitatztzemut haddin, ben letzad hashshoftim shello yuchelu hasseg ben letzad hannishpatim shello yitratztzu shete hakkittot bemishpatam – yaviu elecha, velo letzad perat ze titchayyev bakkol.

rashi: El kanna. mekanne lippara veeno over al middato limchol al avodat elilim; kol leshon kanna anepareymenat belaaz – noten lev lippara:
Lesonay. ketargumo, kesheochazin maase avotehem bidehem.
ohc: Poked avon avot vegomer. perush, letzad ki amar shehu kannay baruch hu, veyadua hu ki hakkannaut tafil samuch laddavar hammitkanne alav, veroim anu hachechashat haddavar chas veshalom, kamma vechamma mardu ufashu veasu vehitzlichu velo naga yad hakkannay. laze amar poked, perush, veim raita hafekiyyut hakkina da ki ani poked, perush, zo hi middati sheen ani nifra meose resha miyyad umaarich appi ad dor sheni veshlishi urevii, perush lifamim, veen ani maarich appi ella ad zeman ze. vehattaam, ki im haya Adonai mitkanne laadam techef, en kiyyum lannivraim, laze mitchakkem Adonai leose risha umaalim ayin milleabbedam baolam hazze kede sheyyakumu benehem, ulay yetivu darchehem venimtza olam kayyam bahem, gam yoil laavot lezakkotam baolam habba keamram (sanhedrin 104,1) bera mezakke abba. veim dor sheni hitivu kemaase avot az yifkod alehem avon avotam ittam yimmaku, vaadayin yeshno lekanot resha haav befiron habbanim. velifamim yosif Adonai lehaarich appo gam ledor sheni vetole lahem ad dor shelishi lattaam atzmo haamur, uchesheyyarshiu yifkod alehem vechulei. velifamim yosif gam ken lehaarich appo gam ledor shelishi, aval dor revii en od tikva lahem, ki hushreshu bakkelippa lo yinnatku mimmenna, uvaara bam kinat Adonai avonam vaavon avot avot avotam middor rishon yecherav, vehattaam ki chullam bechinat ra shalshelet achat. veaskilcha ki beerech haadon baruch hu afillu kesheyyaarich appo ad dor revii yikkare miyyad, ki shelosha vearbaa dorot hem shelosh meot shana veyomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu elef shana, uchemo sheyyomar techef umiyyad beerech haadam shesh vasheva shaot kemo chen yihye beerech haadon shelosh meot shana. uvaze timtza yishshuv taam lamma heerich Adonai lomar al veal velo amar bederech kelal "poked avon ad ribbeim", keamro beose chesed laalafim, ki yishtanne ze mizze, vehaven, veayyen besamuch:

Veda ki hitbonnut bedavar ze sheen Adonai mitkanne beose resha hu davar mavhil, uma gam rasha maarich berishato umatzliach berum hahatzlachot. vehammaskil baggader asher gaval habbore shehu learbaa dorot yatzdik mishpat yashar, vehu sheamar asaf (tehillim ag,17) "avina leacharitam", perush, acharit kitzvat haddorot asher katzav Adonai. veda ki koach bechinat hara yeshno ad arbaa dorot velo yippara Adonai middor chamishi avon avot harishonim shehu chamishi lahem, ma sheen ken bechinat hattov shettigdal ad elef vaalafim.

rashi: Ki rosh aram. hi dammesek, veen lirushalayim immahem kelum:

Verosh dammesek retzin bedammesek yihye rosh, velo birushalayim, vegam pekach vaaseret hashshevatim beod shishshim vechamesh shana miyyom shennigzar bime amos "veyisrael galo yigle meal admato" (Amos 7:11):

Yechat efrayim. terotzatz efrayim meam, sheyyaglem sancheriv im malkam hoshea ben ela. tze vachashov minnevuat amos ad sheggalu aseret hashshevatim, vetimtzaem shishshim vechamesh shanim: nevuat amos hayta shete shanim lifne shennitnagga uzziyya, shenneemar (Amos 1:1) "shenatayim lifne haraash", veuzziyya nitnagga esrim vechamesh shanim, hare esrim vesheva, veshesh eshre shel yotam, veshesh eshre shel achaz, veshesh shel chizkiyyahu, shenneemar (Melachim 2 18:10-11) "vayyilkeduha bishnat shesh lechizkiyyahu hi shenat tesha lehoshea vayyigel et yisrael ashshura", hare shishshim vechamesh. uminnayin sheyyeme chaluto shel uzziyyahu esrim vechamesh shanim? shenneemar (Melachim 2 15:1) "bishnat esrim vasheva leyaravam ben yoash melech yisrael malach uzziyya ven amatzya al yehuda". efshar lomar? vahalo uzziyya veyaravam malchu keachat, lefi cheshbon shettimtza besefer melachim! ella shemmalach malchut menuggaat bishnat esrim vesheva lemalcho nitnagga, vehu malach chamishshim ushetayim shana. vei efshar limnot beod shishshim vechamesh shana miyyom sheamar yeshaya nevua zo, shehare bime achaz amarah, vehem galu bishnat shesh lechizkiyyahu. vechach meforash beseder olam (seder olam Rabba 28), shemmana hakkatuv linvuato shel amos:
targum: Are resh aram damesek veresh damesek retzin uvesof shittin vachamesh shenin yivtelun bet yisrael mimalchu:

rashi: Umoshe ala. bayyom hashsheni; vechol aliyyotav behashekama hayu, shenneemar "vayyashkem moshe vabboker" (Shemot 34):
Ko tomar. ballashon hazze vechasseder hazze:
Levet yaakov. ellu hannashim, tomar lahen belashon rakka (mechilta):
Vetagged livne yisrael. onashin vedikdukim paresh lazzecharim, devarim hakkashin kegidin (shabbat 87):
ohc: Umoshe ala vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma ala moshe kodem sheyyikra lo Adonai. od tzarich ladaat leeze makom ala, im lahar haya lo lomar el hahar beferush. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Shemot Rabba 108) ze hu sheamar hakkatuv (tehillim 68:19) "alita lammarom" vegomer. velidverehem kashe od, ki matzinu sheachar kach hayta hakkeria elav min hahar, dichtiv "vayyikra vegomer min hahar", veim hu kevar ala lashshamayim ma makom likria mimmakom namuch lemakom elyon. od yesh ledakdek lamma amar hakkatuv el haelohim velo amar el Adonai kemo sheggamar omer "vayyikra elav Adonai" vegomer:

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi, leheyot shekkadam Adonai veamar lemoshe bassene (Shemot 3:12) "behotziacha et haam taavdun et haelohim al hahar hazze", hu marehu ki sham hu mekom kabbalat hattora. asher al ken behaggio shamma, asa moshe mishpat eved neeman vekadam veala el hahar, velo hutzrach lehazekir hahar kevan shehizkiro besamuch dichtiv "neged hahar", vealav chozer amro umoshe ala. veamro el haelohim hu taam aliyyato, ki ma shayyachut baaliyya zo? laze amar "el haelohim" shekkadam etzlo mehabbore "taavdun et haelohim al hahar hazze". laze im haya mitakkev ad sheyyikra Adonai elav, yerae hitrashshelut umiut cheshek baddavar, laze techef kadam vehechin atzmo veala. vezulat ma shekkadam lo bemaamar Adonai "taavdun et haelohim" lo haya ole el hahar. uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim sheddikdaknu. veen beferush ze setira ledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru (Shemot Rabba sham) "alita lammarom", ki baaliyyato hahar shehu makom shehirkin Adonai shamayim alav, hinne hu nimtza ole lashshamayim.

Vayyikra elav Adonai. perush, keshekkadam hu veala techef kara lo Adonai. veyesh lecha ladaat ki bechinat hakkedushsha lo takdim ella lammazmin otah umeir al haddavar, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (Zohar 11 92.): beitaruta diltatta itaruta dilela, vehu sod amro (Bereshit 2:6) "veed yaale min haaretz vehishka" milmala "et kol pene haadama", veyirmoz beamro vayyikra leshon yekar ugedulla asa Adonai lemoshe al hachanato uzerizuto baddavar.

Min hahar lemor. perush, letzad ki devar Adonai ba min sheme hashshamayim, ki adayin lo yarad Adonai al har sinay, asher al ken ba lehodienu hakkatuv ki tzivva Adonai al hakkol sheyyaavor derech hahar, umishsham yishma moshe amarav, velo yifne latztzedadin, gam lo yishshama leozen moshe kodem sheyyaggia lahar, ella lahar yavo umin hahar yihye nishma elav. veze hu shiur hakkatuv vayyikra elav Adonai mimmakom sheshshemo sham kayyadua, ukeria zo min hahar lemor, perush, min hahar hitchil haamira velo kodem velo min hatztzedadim. veim lo amar hakkatuv tevat "lemor" haya bannishma ki hatechalat hakkeria haya min hahar uchevar yarda shechina shamma, velo chen hu.

Ko tomar vegomer attem reitem vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal tomar vegomer vetagged vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Shemot Rabba 28,2) "bet yaakov" hem hannashim, velahem yomar maane rach, velivne yisrael" devarim kashim kegidim. vekashe, halo lo matzinu sheamar Adonai bidvarav shene mine shelichut, ella lashon echad lechullam yachad, anashim venashim – im hem kashim yachad yishmauhu, veim hem rakkim yachad yishmauhu. veen lomar shekkesheyyedabber moshe yeshanne maane lashon misseder hannidbar chas veshalom, ki halo timtza ki besof divre Adonai amar elav (Shemot 19:6) "elle haddevarim asher tedabber el bene yisrael", veamru zichronam livracha (mechilta) veze leshonam: lo pachot velo yoter. velichshennomar ki kavvanat amro el bene yisrael hu al haanashim, yechsar derech asher yedabber bo lannashim. gam en ani roe devarim kashim bedivre Adonai laanashim ella devarim hamechayyim et hannefesh.

Achen kavvanat divre Adonai hu al ze hadderech, vekodem akdim hammussag etzlenu mikkol hattora ki haadon elohe yisrael middotav hem lehetiv, veyoter mecheshek hamekabbel chishko lehetiv, veze legodel hafelagat bechinat tuvo, veyoter mehemma livne yisrael, umitchakkem hu yitbarach leharebot secharenu vetovatenu ki ze hu asher yachpotz Adonai. vehinne matzinu lo sheggilla dato ki sechar hamekayyem torat Adonai umitzvotav miyyira hu mechtza mehaose meahava, mishshene ketuvim habbaim behodaat sechar hammitzvot: beechad amar (Devarim 7:9) "leelef dor", uveechad amar (Shemot 20:6) "laalafim", vedikdek besar haelef shehu hashshomer miyyira vesar haalafim shehu laose meahava.

Vehinne yesh bivchinat haahava tzad gorem raa, ki lo taspik livaleha lehishshamer bitmidut leval avor eze paam beakray, ki yomar shemmitztzad kurevato labbore vachavivuto lo yakpid alav al ze keminhag veseder haragil ben hannivraim. ulehaskilcha bainyan mimmoshe atta lamed, ki letzad rov kurevato vechibbato im Adonai shagag vedibber elav (Shemot 4:13) "shelach na beyad tishlach", "lama hareota" vegomer (Shemot 5:22), "lo hitztzalta" vegomer, veze haya sibba godel kerivato lifne Adonai nitkarra hayyira, ki peshita sheadam acher keshello yihye karev kol kach tippol alav emata vafachad. vehinne haadon Adonai tzevaot lo chen yachshov, kemo sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 10:17) "asher lo yissa fanim velo" vegomer, veyakpid adrabba beyoter al ahuvo leyassero betosefet merubba al avro afillu paam achat vaafillu al hakkalla shebbakkallim, keamro (tehillim 50:3) "usevivav nisara meod", veamru zichronam livracha (bava kamma 50,1) shemmedakdek im chasidav kechut hassaara.

Vaasher al ken beet netinat hattora chashav Adonai machshavot tovot lehoil bekabbalat hattora, ulefanav shete derachim: 1 ledabber divre ahava vechibba, veyesh baze tachlit davar tov kesheyyekabbeluha meahava, sheshshekel hakkodesh kaful hu bischaram, veyesh baze tzad acher, ki haose meahava lifamim lo yedakdek bifrat echad mehattora, kederech haav im beno hamegageo vehameshasheo, kevan sheen alav bechinat hammora, ma sheen ken keshettihye kabbalat hattora mechamat yira, midderech hayyare lifchod al dikduk echad keeved merabbo, venimtza tamid omed lishmor etz hachayyim, vechen hu bedivrehem zichronam livracha (yerushalmi berachot). vederech 2 hu ledabber devarim kashim kemelech sheggozer al avdo bizrikat mara veemat malchut, veyesh baze tachlit tov shello yezalzelu beachat mikkol mitzvot hattora vaafillu beakray vaaray, ella shemmaggiam machatzit sachar missachar hammaggiam baasotam meahava.

Asher al ken nitchakkem Adonai letzauot bishne ofanim, bederech ahava vederech serara vehafechada, veamar gam shenehem bemetek leshon tzaddik benose echad. vehu ma shehitchil lomar ko tomar, al ze hadderech: "ko" – perush keseder ze sheani omer lecha, tomar levet yaakov vetagged vegomer, perush, yesh bo amira rakka shehi derech ahava vechibba, vetagged – perush, yesh bo gam ken devarim kashim kegidim shehu derech hafechada veyira. vedikdek lomar bet yaakov baamira, uvene yisrael bekoshi, lomar chelek hechaser lechol echad mishshenehem al ze hadderech: ki bet yaakov hem madrega hakketanna shebbeummatenu hakkedosha asher lo yassigu avod Adonai meahava ella miyyira, laze hammitzva lahem shetztzerichin lehosif avod meahava harmuza baamira rakka kannizkar. velivne yisrael, shehem madrega hannivcheret vehameulla asher yassigu bechinat haahava, amar kenegdam vetagged, shello yaspik lahem bechinat haahava legabbe perat echad utzerichin hem leyira uleahava mittaam shekkatavnu. nimtzeta omer ki tovim hashshenayim vetzorech bahem lekiyyum hattora, vetzarich kol ish miyyisrael liknot shenehem ahava veyira. ushenehem yachad amaram el elyon binimut devarav beamro "attem reitem asher asiti" vegomer, kaasher avaer besamuch beezrat hashshem. vedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru (mechilta) ellu hannashim veellu haanashim – hem derech derash.

rashi: Vayyosef Adonai. "veosif neviyya da" (targum yonatan):
targum: Veosif neviya dayya lemalala im achaz lememar:

rashi: Vayyanach bayyom hashshevii. kivyachol hichtiv beatzmo menucha, lelammed hemennu kal vachomer laadam shemmelachto veamal vigia sheyyihye nach beshabbat (mechilta):
Berach, vaykaddeshehu. bercho vamman – lechaflo bashshishshi lechem mishne, vekiddesho vamman – shello haya yored bo (mechilta):
ohc: Vayyanach bayyom hashshevii. kan nitchakkem Adonai leesor melachot asher manu chachamim arbaim melachot [chaser achat] sheyyesh bahem melacha sheen bah shum torach kelal baasiyyatah, kemo shettomar hammotzi keli mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o lehefech vechaddome laze rabbim, vechiyyeva hattora mita alehem. veyomar adam: ma torach yesh bedavar ze lehitchayyev? laze amar hakkatuv ki sheshet yamim vegomer vayyanach vegomer, perush, dok vehasekel battaam veteda ki en haddavar letzad hattorach levad, vahare mi shenneemar bo (Yeshayahu 40:28) "lo yiaf velo yiga" uvo lo yutzdak lomar menucha, ella hakkavvana hi letzad happeulla hayyotzet anu danim, hagam shello tihye bah yegia vatorach. velaze kol sheshshem melacha aleha, hagam ki yaasenna adam belo haregashat davar, hare ze chayyav aleha.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech, ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai vegomer, perush ki lo asa bitchunat beriatam sheyyaamdu ella sheshet yamim, umeatta yitztarech Adonai lechaddesh habberia bechol yom, uveemtzaut nefesh haolam shehu hashshabbat shebbara Adonai nach mehatemadat hammelacha, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 10,9) shehaya haolam rofef veroed uvevo shabbat amad bekiyyumo, vehu amro vayyanach bayyom hashshevii, veyom ze maamid haolam od sheshet yamim, uvechol yom shishshi laerev shekkalta techunat haolam yavo shabbat vikayyem haolam od sheshet yamim acherim vechen al ze hadderech, veayyen parashat bereshit (Bereshit 2:2).

rashi: Asher hitztzil etchem miyyad mitzrayim. umma kasha:
Umiyyad paro. melech kashe:
Mittachat yad mitzrayim. ketargumo – leshon ridduy umarut; hayyad shehayu machbidim alehem hi haavoda:

Vayhi mimmochorat. motzae yom hakkippurim haya, kach shaninu besifre umahu mimmochorat? lemochorat ridto min hahar; veal karchacha i efshar lomar ella mimmochorat yom hakkippurim, shehare kodem mattan tora ie lomar "vehodati et chukke vegomer", umishshennittena tora ad yohakki lo yashav moshe lishpot et haam, shehare veyz betammuz yarad veshavar et halluchot ulemachar ala behashekama veshaha shemonim yom veyarad beyohakk; veen parasha zo chetuva kasseder, shello neemar vayhi mimmochorat ad shana sheniyya – af ledivre haomer yitro kodem mattan tora ba, shillucho el artzo lo haya ella ad shana sheniyya – shehare neemar kan vayshallach moshe et chotno, umatzinu vemassa haddegalim sheamar lo moshe "nosim anachnu el hammakom vegomer"(Bamidbar 10 29), al na taazov otanu" (sham lo), veim zo kodem mattan tora, mishsheshshillecho vehalach hechan matzinu shechazar? veim tomar, sham lo neemar yitro ella chovav, uveno shel yitro haya, hu chovav hu yitro, shehare chatuv "mibbene chovav choten moshe" (Shoftim 4):

Vayyeshev moshe vegomer vayyaamod haam. yoshev kemelech vechullan omdim, vehuksha haddavar leyitro shehaya mezalzel bichvodan shel yisrael vehochicho al kach, shenneemar (pasuk yad) maddua atta yoshev levaddecha vechullam nitztzavim:

Min habboker ad erev. efshar lomar ken? ella kol dayyan sheddan din emet laamitto afillu shaa achat, maale alav hakkatuv keillu osek battora kol hayyom ucheillu naase shuttaf lehakkabba bemaase vereshit, shenneemar bo vayhi erev vegomer (shabbat 10):
Min hahar el haam. melammed shello haya moshe fone laasakav, ella min hahar – el haam (mechilta):

Vayyagga al pi vegomer. vesar avonecha – ze leyasserecha, lechapper avoncha shecherafta et yisrael. vegadol kocho, shehammalach yare lekachtah ki im bemelkachayim, vehiggiah al sifte hannavi velo huzzak, betanchuma (tanchuma, vayyishlach 2). vezehu shenneemar "ki rav meod machanehu" (Yoel 2:11) – ellu malachim, vaatzumim mehem "ose devaro" (sham) – hem hanneviim. veyonatan tirgem uveyado ritzpa – "uvefumeh memallel". leshon "ritzpa" dibbur haratzuf bappe uvallashon. meal hammizbeach – kibbel haddibbur mippi hakkadosh baruch hu, mikkiso shebbashshamayim, shehaya mechuvvan keneged hammizbeach shebbahechol:
targum: Vesadar befumi vaamar ha shaviti pitgame nevuati befumach veyadun chovach vechetach yitkapperun:

rashi: Orach chayyim lemala lemaskil. kemo "serafim omdim mimmaal lo" (Yeshayahu 6:2), kelomar: lifne hechacham keshuta umuchana orach chayyim:
targum: Archa dechaye maleya lesucheltana denista min sheyol tachtita:

rashi: Mishshor avus. sheovsin lo hammaachol befiv al karcho kede lefattemo, vechen "barburim avusim" (Melachim 1 4:23). veyesh lemoshlo keneged kometz meat shel ani shechaviv mishshor chattat shel rasha. davar acher: tov aruchat yarak latet leani, veahava sham lehareot lo panim yafot mishshor avus lehaachilo basar shamen veyarenu panim zoafot:
targum: Tava sheruta deyarka verachamuta taman min tore mefatme bisgiata:

rashi: Levaavur nassot etchem. legaddel etchem baolam, sheyyetze lachem shem baummot shehu bichvodo nigla alechem:
Nassot. leshon harama ugedulla, kemo harimu nes (Yeshayahu 62), arim nissi (sham 49), channes al haggiva (sham 30) – shehu zakuf:
Uvaavur tihye yirato. al yede sheritem oto yarouy umeuyyam, tedu ki en zulato vetiru mippanav:
ohc: Al tirau. perush, sheyyedabber immachem od, ki levaavur vegomer, uchevar asa Adonai machashavto hattova veasa etchem nes shehem muvedalim letova, ki paska zuhamatam beemtzaut devar haelohim. vegam taam sheni baavur tihye vegomer, perush, ki baakirat hazzuhama mehem hinne kanta hayyira shehi shechinato yitbarach makom lihyot bitmidut al penehem, ki tzelem elohi asher yatzar Adonai et haadam betzalmo chazar lekadmuto. veharevachat shene devarim ellu hu "levilti techetau", ki kol mi sheyyesh lo boshet panim shehi yirato haamura, lo bimhera hu chote.
Od yirtze beamro levaavur nassot etchem, kede shello tihye lachem taana lamma lo yenabbe Adonai et kol yisrael, hare nissa otam binvua velo yachlu amod.

rashi: Vayyatztzileni mecherev paro. kesheggillu datan vaaviram al devar hammitzri uvikkesh laharog et moshe naasa tzavvaro keammud shel shayish (sham):
ohc: Veshem haechad eliezer vegomer. taam amro haechad, ki letzad taam keriat hashshemot tamo shel ze kadam letamo shel shem gershom, shebbattechilla hitztzilo mecherev paro veachar ba lemidyan vegar sham.

Vetaam shello hikdim keriat shem eliezer hu, ki kara lammeora shehaya bo az beeretz nachriyya, veachar kach halach lechappes meoraot kodmot. o lefi ma shepperashnu befasuk "ger hayiti" (Shemot 2:22), sheyyechavven al geruto baolam hazze, bechina zo kadma lehatztzalato mecherev paro velaze hikdimo. uletzad bechinat gerut sheniyya beeretz nachriyya kadam lo kavvana harmuza bikriat shem eliezer, ucheneged ze amar "haechad", velaze hutzrach lefaresh ma hu haezer shekkenegdo kara lo shem, veamar vayyatztzileni vegomer. uvaze yutzdak lomar alav shem haechad. vezulat amro "vayyatztzileni mecherev paro" hayiti mefaresh shehaezer hu achar haggerut, vehahakdama shehikdim lomar "ger hayiti" vegomer techayyeveni lefaresh ken, veyissatem befanay yediat taam amro "haechad".

rashi: Kol yeme ani raim. vaafillu shabbatot veyamim tovim, deamar shemuel (sanhedrin 100:): shinnuy veset techillat choli meayim:
Vetov lev. mi shellibbo tov beashro:
Mishte tamid. kol shenotav domot lo yeme mishte, lelammedcha sheyyehe adam sameach bechelko (avot 4:1). verabbotenu darshu ma sheddarshu bechelek (sanhedrin 100:-101.):
targum: Kol yome demiskena bishin uman detav libbeh mashkeya tedira:

rashi: Ola. kemashmaah, shehi kullah kalil:
Uzevachim. shelamim:
Vayyavo aharon vegomer. umoshe hechan halach? vahalo hu sheyyatza likrato vegaram lo et kol hakkavod? ella shehaya omed umeshammesh lifnehem (mechilta):
Lifne haelohim. mikkan shehannehene misseuda shettalmide chachamim mesubbin bah, keillu nehene mizziv hashshechina (berachot 64):
ohc: Vayyikkach yitro vegomer ola vegomer. hinne nitchakkem yitro lizboach shelamim rabbim, veze haya lo leot ki mazmin hu gedole yisrael al shulchano, velaze lo amar hakkatuv "vayyikra leaharon ulezikne yisrael leechol" vegomer ella vayyavo aharon vegomer, perush, meatzman bau, ki maasav mochichim hahazmana kede shello yavou kadashim lide notar, vechibbeduhu uvau meatzman aharon vehazzekenim velo hitrichuhu lehazeminam al hazzevach.

rashi: Atta yadati. makkiro hayiti lesheavar veachshav beyoter:
Mikkol haelohim. melammed shehaya makkir bechol aza shebbaolam, shello hinniach aza shello avadah (mechilta):
Ki vaddavar asher zadu alehem. ketargumo – bammayim dimmu leabbedam vehem neevdu bammayim:
Asher zadu. asher hirshiu. verabbotenu derashuhu leshon vayyazed yaakov nazid, bakkedera asher bishshelu bah nitbashshelu (sota 11):
ohc: Atta yadati vegomer. perush, ki hagam sheyyesh laummot sarim gedolim vaatzumim lehillachem baadam ulehara leoyvehem, vechol merim yad kenegdam, af al pi chen lo yechavvenu lehinnakem mehaumma hannegdiyyit bedimyon hammered, ma sheen ken elohe yisrael sheyyechavven limdod bammidda atzmah shel hammored veose risha, shikka shokehem vechulei. gam yesh litlot bammeora hara ki lo mitztzad shekkenegdo hukka, ma sheen ken elohe yisrael shekkol hammakkot vehayyissurin asher yisser paro hem mechuvvanim lema shezzadu alehem. vetze ulemad ma sheamru zichronam livracha (tanchuma) bechiuun hammakkot shekkol achat keneged midda achat raa shezzadu hammitzriyyim vechulei:

rashi: Hashemen lev haam hazze. kemo "hachebed et libbo" (Shemot 8:11), leshon haloch, leshon paol: libbam holech haloch vehashemen (633 belaaz), veaznav holchim haloch vehachebed mishshemoa:
Veenav hasha. tachim, keinyan shenneemar (Yeshayahu 44:18) "ki tach merot enehem", hattoach (Vayikra 14:43) metargeminan "deitsha":
Pen yire veenav natnu libbam shello yishmeu divre neviim, shehem yereim shemma yutevu beenehem devarav, veyavinu belibbam veyashuvu elay, vehi refuatam:
targum: Tappesh libbeh deama haden veudenohi yaker veenohi amam dilma yechezun beenehon uveudenehon yishmeun uvelibbehon yistakkelun vituvun veyishtevek lehon:

rashi: Haed baam. hatere vahem shello laalot bahar:
Pen yehersu vegomer. shello yehersu et matztzavam, al yede shettaavatam el Adonai, lirot, veyikrevu letzad hahar:
Venafal mimmennu rav. kol ma sheyyippol mehem, vaafillu hu yechidi, chashuv lefanay rav (sham):
Pen yehersu. kol harisa mafredet asifat habbinyan, af hannifradin mimmatztzav anashim horsim et hammatztzav:
ohc: Pen yehersu vegomer. perush, leval yachshevu bedatam ki yiru baruch hu hagam sheyyamutu, al derech amro (Tehillim 63:4) "tov chasdecha mechayyim", umitatam zo hi chayyutam. vehu amro pen yehersu, perush, yaskimu al harisatam, el Adonai lirot, perush keillu amar lirot el Adonai. veamro venafal mimmennu rav, perush tihye nefilatam nefila rabba, millevad sheyyamutu tihye lahem nefila achar nefila. o yirtze, ki letzad sheoro yitbarach memalle hammakom, kesheyyavou lirot yitztarech Adonai lesallek haor hahu leval yabbitu bo, veze hu amro pen yehersu el Adonai, perush, leoro lesibbat reotam. vahare ze maggid ki lo yassigu lirot im yavou lirot, velaze lo amar hakkatuv "pen yiru" ki lo yassiguhu kannizkar, ella hem yachshevu bedatam lirot. veshemma tomar en kan lo hakeravat hattoelet velo nezek, laze amar venafal vegomer, perush, millevad shello yiru, od lahem hakeravat hannezek. vedikdek lomar rav, perush, afillu yihye harav shebbahem lo yomar shello akpid ella al hamon haam, aval gedole yisrael haruyim lehasheraat shechina lo akpid, talmud lomar "venafal mimmennu rav".

rashi: Vehayu nechonim. muvdalim meishsha (shabbat 87):

Layyom hashshelishi. shehu shishsha vachodesh, uvachamishi bana moshe et hammizbeach tachat hahar ushetem esre matztzeva – kol hainyan haamur befarashat veelle hammishpatim – veen mukdam umeuchar battora:
Leene chol haam. melammed shello haya vahem suma, shennitrappeu chullam (mechilta):
Vayyomer choten moshe. derech kavod koro hakkatuv chotno shel melech:

Atta uvincha uvittecha. ellu ketannim; o eno ella gedolim? amarta, hare kevar muzharim hem, ella lo va ella lehazehir gedolim al shevitat hakketannim; vezehu sheshshaninu (shabbat 121), katan shebba lechabbot en shomin lo mippene sheshshevitato alecha:
ohc: Veyom hashshevii vegomer. perush, ki baasoto shabbat laAdonai baze atta ose Adonai ki hu elohecha, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 25) ki shakul shabbat kechol hattora kullah. veulay ki remuza hi kol hattora betevat shabbat al ze hadderech: 611 hem mitzvot shello shemaum mippi haggevura ella mippi navi, ushete mitzvot "anochi" velo yihye lecha" shehem shete mitzvot shennitztauu mippi haggevura, mitzvat "anochi" hi mitzvat ase velo yihye lecha" hi mitzvat lo taase. uchevar hodiunu rabbotenu zichronam livracha ki mitzvot ase yitkannu leshem harachamim lefi shehem bivchinat kabbalat sachar, umitzvot lo taase yitkannu leshem 65 lefi shehem bivchinat haddin laover alehem. vehinne cheshbon 26 65 ole 91 vetry hare shabbat.

Od yirtze al derech amram bemassechet shabbat (shabbat 118:) kol hashshomer shabbat kehilchato afillu oved avoda zara keenosh mochalin lo, vehu amro veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai baze naasa hu elohecha velo zulato, ha lamadta shennimchal lo ma shekkibbel leeloah zulato yitbarach.
Od yirtze beamro shabbat laAdonai, ki lo tihye hammenucha vehashshevita limnuchato ulemargoo, ella lemitzvat Adonai elohav.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: sheshet yamim taavod vegomer, veyom hashshevii gam ken yihye lecha melacha achat, uma hi? sheatta ose shabbat laAdonai elohecha, velo miatti lecha yom hashshevii ella mimmelachtecha shel atzmecha.

rashi: Zachor. zachor veshamor bedibbur echad neemru, vechen mechalleha mot yumat (Shemot 31), uveyom hashshabbat shene chevasim (Bamidbar 28); vechen lo tilbash shaatnez, gedilim taase lach (Devarim 22); vechen ervat eshet achicha (Vayikra 18), yevamah yavo aleha (Devarim 25); hu shenneemar achat dibber elohim shetayim zu shamati (Tehillim 62): zachor. leshon paol hu, kemo achol veshato (Yeshayahu 22), haloch uvacho (Shmuel 2 3), vechen pitrono: tenu lev lizkor tamid et yom hashshabbat, sheim nizdammen lecha chefetz yafe tehe mazmino leshabbat (mechilta):
ohc: Zachor et yom hashshabbat vegomer. perush sheyyizkerehu miyyom rishon, velaze hikdim hammeuchar, ki min harauy haya lehakedim lomar "sheshet yamim" vegomer veachar kach yomar "zachor", ella nitkavven lomar shehazzechira tihye miyyom rishon, al derech amram zichronam livracha (mechilta) shekkol yom yomar "hayyom yom 1 bashshabbat" vechulei, perush uvaze yekaddesho velo yite bo.
Gam yirtze lekaddesho leshon hazemana, al derech amram zichronam livracha (betza 16,1) mechad beshabba leshabba.

Gam yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (midrash tehillim tzav) ki yom shishshi shebbo nivra adam harishon vechata veyatza chayyav bedino, ba yom shabbat venaasa sanegor laadam lifne Adonai veamar: "ribbon haolam, lo neherag adam meolam vechi ani matchil" vechulei, venitztzol adam. uchesheraa adam kochah shel shabbat hitchil leshorer "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat". laze amar Adonai zachor, perush, sheyyizkor et yom hashshabbat asher beemtzauto nitkayyem adam veyotze chalatzav, verauy lehacheshivo ki hu davar hammaamid lechol ish yisrael vikaddesho. vetimtza ki mi shennaasa lo nes beyom echad yihye hayyom hahu mechubbad vechashuv beenav tamid midde shana beshana, veze yoter al bechina zo shehashshabbat atzmo hu hammatztzil, velaze amar zachor leheyot haddavar rachok mishsheshet yeme vereshit.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech zachor et yom hashshabbat, perush hazekir shemo shel shabbat, vehattaam lekaddesho, ki kesheatta mazkir shemo shel shabbat beyom ze baze atta mekaddesho. veze hu shiur hakkatuv zachor et yom, uma yizkor? shabbat. vetaam lekaddesho, ki shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu shabbat kemaamar rashbi (zohar 10 88:), veachar kach beer hakkatuv ma yom miyyamim veamar sheshet yamim vegomer ki sheshet yamim vegomer, ha lamadta ki al yom 7 shel sheshet yeme vereshit hu omer.

rashi: Veshaftu. vedaynin yat amma:
Yeviun. maytin:

Yishputu hem. kemo yishpetu, vechen "lo taavuri" (Rut 2), kemo lo taavri, vetargumo daynin innun; mikraot haelyonim hem leshon tziuuy, lechach meturgamin vidunun, yaytun, yedunun, umikraot hallalu leshon asiyya:

targum: Rachik hu elaha merashie utzelothon detzadike yishma:
Merachakteh deelaha machshevata devishta vedachyan mile vesimata:
Chalaf are melach alach aram bisha efrayim uvar remalyahu lememar:
Beta degevtana nesatter elaha viattad techuma dearmalta:
Libba demitbayen bae yediata ufumehon desachle shatyuta:
La rachem memikna leman demachsen leh ulevat chakkime la azel:

bart: Tenu lanu achat mikkem. sherotzim lavo aleha beones:
Yetammeu kullan. deen dochim nefesh mippene nefesh. uveha modu rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua:
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ven chorin. kegon eved shel shene shuttafim veshichrero echad mehem. i nammi shekkibbel rabbo mimmennu chatzi damav veshichrer chetzyo beotam haddamim:
Tikkantem et rabbo. sheeno chaser kelum:
Lissa shifcha eno yachol. mippene tzad cherut shebbo:
Bat chorin eno yachol. mippene tzad avdut shebbo:
Kofin et rabbo veosehu ven chorin. vehu haddin im haya eved shel mea shuttafin veechad mehem shichrero, shekkofin et kullam leshachrero:
Mecham. keli shemmechammemim bo hammayim:
Bechomer. tit av:
Charsit. dak kecheres. veyesh mefarshim, ketishat charasim:
Hannogea bachomer tame. lefi shehu nidbak umitchabber bammecham vachashuv keatzmo shel keli, hilkach im nitma hammecham nitma hachomer shessevivo kemoto, vehoochalim hannogim bachomer temeim:
Uvacharsit tahor. decharsit eno nidbak umifrich venafil, vela chashiv keatzmo shel keli:
Kumekum. yoter gadol mimmecham. uvelaaz korin lo 298:
Sheeno yachol lekabbel et hachammin. shehazzefet nittach venames bemayim chammin. veaf al pi sheyyachol lekabbel et hatztzonen eno chashuv keli vetahor:

Vechen haya omer bichle zefet. kelim haasuyin min hazzefet atzmo, shehen tehorin, hoil veen yecholin lekabbel et hachammin katztzonen. verabbotay pershu bichle zefet, bechelim hazzefutim, umefaresh veazel ketzad, kele nechoshet shezzefatan tehorim. im hayu hakkelim temeim venaga adam o ochalin umashkin bazzefet, tehorim, deen hazzefet chibbur veeno nechshav keatzmo shel keli:
Veim leyayin. veim zefatan mittechilla lasum betochan yayin veen dato lehishtammesh bahen bechammin kelal:
Temein. deaz have hakkeli tzarich lazzefet vehave zefet chibbur:
Haeven shehaya shofet aleha veal hattannur. vehaeven mechubberet betit:
Aleha veal haeven. hayenu achat betit veachat shello vetit:
Veal hassela. hamechubbar mishsheshet yeme vereshit:

Tehora. dichtiv yuttatz temeim hem, et sheyyesh lo netitza yesh lo tuma, et sheen lo netitza en lo tuma. mikkan amru, even shehaya shofet aleha veal hattannur, aleha veal hakkira, aleha veal hakkuppach, temea, mippene sheyyesh lahen netitza. aleha veal haeven, aleha veal hassela, aleha veal hakkotel, tehora, mippene sheen lahen netitza:
Kirat hannezirim. levashshel shalme nazir shellokeach mehen hakkohen hazzeroa beshela:

Kirat hattabbachim. shemmochrim larabbim, umesadderim harebe avanim zo achar zo veshoftin alehen kederot harebe, shennimtzet even achat lishte kederot, ucheshennitmet haachat haacherot tehorot, midi dahava akkalmarin hametoamot ditnan leel beferek 2‏ [mishna 7] sheim nitmea achat mehen lo nitmeu chullan:
Shalosh avanim sheasaan shete chirayim. shehaeven haemtzait meshammeshet lezo ulezo:
Haemtzait hameshammeshet lattemea. chetzyah shel haemtzait hameshammeshet lachitzona shehi temea, temea. vechetzyah hameshammeshet lachitzona shehi tehora, tehora:
Nechleta haemtzait letuma. vechullah temea:
Lishpot alehen. al shete hachitzonot:
Hechezirah. laemtzait:
Tehora. shebbatla chira rishona ucheillu nittatz kirat hayyora haggedola:
Mekabbelet tuma mishsheyyassikenna. devae hessek kechira chadasha:
Keli cheres habbari. sheeno lo raua velo shavur:
Metammein. im nitma hakkeli meaviro, temeim ochalim umashkim shennagu vattefela, mippene shehi chashuva chakkeli atzmo:

Hattofel et habbari tahor. dedavka hakkeli raua shetztzarich leotah tefela hu dachashiva hattefela chichli venitmeu hoochalim hannogim bah keshehakkeli tame, aval tefelat habbari enah chashuva chakkeli. vahalacha kachachamim:

Vechen bechidduk keruya. keshem shennechleku rabbi meir verabbi shimon im chachamim bitfelat habbari kach nechleku vechidduk keruya, vehi delaat yevesha vachalula sheshshoavin bah mayim, uregilim lehaddek sevivoteha beiggul shel etz o shel barzel kede shello tishshaver im tiggof baeven. derabbi meir verabbi shimon dimtammein bitfelat habbari metammein af bezo, vaafillu hayta hakkeruya veria. vachachamim omrim, im hayta hakkeruya veria veenah tzericha leogel ze la chashiv haogel kegufah shel keruya, veim nitmet hakkeruya lo nitma haogel:
Eved shennishba ufedauhu. yisraelim acherim leachar shennityaesh rabbo mimmennu:
Im leshum eved yishtabed. lerabbo sheni:
Leshum ben chorin lo yishtabed. lo lerabbo rishon, velo lerabbo sheni. lerabbo sheni lo, deha leshum ben chorin parkeh. lerabbo rishon lo, dilma mimmani. velo parke:
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ben kach uven kach yishtabed. lerabbo rishon. shello yehe kol echad veechad holech umappil atzmo ligyasot umafkia atzmo miyyad rabbo:
Appotiki. po tehe kae. mizze tigbe chovcha velo mimmakom acher:
Veshichrero. rabbo rishon:
Shurat haddin en haeved chayyav kelum. lerabbo sheni. shehashshichrur sheshshichrero rabbo rishon mafkio mide shibud:
Ella mippene tikkun haolam. shemma yimtzeennu rabbo sheni bashshuk veyomar lo avdi atta veyotzi laaz al banav:
Kofin et rabbo. sheni, veosehu ben chorin. vechotev lo haeved shetar chov al damav, kelomar kefi ma shehu shave limmacher bashshuk, lo kefi hachov im haya hachov yater al damav:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer en haeved kotev. shetar chov, shehu eno chayyav kelum. ella rabbo rishon shehizzik shibudo shel ze, hu shetztzarich leshallem lo damav, shehammazzik shibudo shel chavero chayyav. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Al zo veal zo. al zo shennolad lah sefek tuma, veal zo sheholechet leibbud, amar rabbi yehoshua sheeno muzhar al tumatan, veotah shemmuzhar aleha bal tetamme, ketzad, haya over vechulei, dekaamar rabbi yehoshua yanniach lefanav achat al hassela kede shello yigrom tuma laacherot, veaf otah achat yanniach al hassela velo yittenenna veyado, shello yetammeenna bayyadayim. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Yiddaleku. sheaf haetz neesar, vechile hakkerem teunim serefa, dichtiv (Devarim 22) pen tikdash hammelea, pen tukad esh:
Umechashshev kamma zera yesh bahen. ditruma nittelet bemachashava uveomed haddaat:
Veen tzarich lehaferish et haetz. veaf al pi shettaam etzo ufiryo shavin:
Veim hifrish. kodem ketisha, eno yachol lichtosh ulehafrish min hazzera veyishshaer haetz leatzmo, dechevan shekkara alav shem teruma tzarich litteno lakkohen:

Kohen kore rishon vechulei. keshehen shavin bechachma. aval im hayyisrael gadol bechachma, kodem lakkohen velallevi, demamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz. haden hu dina digmara. vehaidna nahug shekkohen afillu am haaretz kodem lechacham gadol shebbeyisrael:

Mippene darche shalom. demiddeorayta yachol hakkohen latet reshut lemi sheyyirtze sheyyikra battora lefanav, umippene darche shalom amru sheyyikra hu rishon velo yitten reshut leacher sheyyikra, delo lete leinnetzoye velomar mippene ma hirsha laze velo leacher. velo shena beshabbatot veyamim tovim dishchiche rabbim, velo shena besheni uvachamishi bazzeman hazze, leolam kohen kore rishon veeno yachol latet reshut leyisrael sheyyikra lefanav, ki hechi delo letu leinnetzoye. veim en sham kohen, nitparda hachavila, velo yikra levi sheni ella kefi chashivuto, veit deamre lo yikra levi battora chelal, vechen hamminhag:
Mearvin bevayit yashan. bene chatzer shergilim litten eruvan bechol shabbat bevayit echad, en meshannin et mekoman litteno bevayit acher:
Mippene darche shalom. shebbene adam shehayu regilim lirot haeruv beoto bayit, achshav sheen roim oto yomru shemmetaltelin belo eruv, veikka chashada:
Bor shehu karov. lemotza ammat hammayim habba min hannahar:
Mitmalle rishon. veacharav yitmalleu hattachtonim:
Metzudot chayya. sheen lahem toch delikne leh kelav:
Yesh bahen gazel mippene darche shalom. velo nafek bedayyanim:
Rabbi yose omer gazel gamur. middivrehem. venafek bedayyanim. umihu mode rabbi yose delo have gazel deorayta laavor alav belav. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Hamenakkef. chotech. kemo venakaf sivche hayyaar (yeshaya 10):
Hachashuda al hashsheviit. lishmor perot sheviit ulehatzniam min habbiur vaelach:
Lo tavor velo titchan immah. lesayyeah, mippene sheasur lesayyea bayyadayim yede ovre avera bishat haavera:
Leeshet am haaretz. hachashuda al hammaasrot:
Uvoreret vetochenet. lefi sherov amme haaretz measserin hen:
Aval mishshettattil hammayim. baissa:
Lo tigga immah. lefi shemmishsheggilgela hutbela lechalla, veka mittammea mechamat kelim temeim shehare huchshera lekabbel tuma, vezo mesayyeah legalgel, veasur ligrom tuma lachalla:
Vechullan lo amru kulei. lo hittiru lehasheilam kelim ulesayyeam belo sheat avera atzmah, ella mishshum darche shalom:
Umachazikim yede goyim. lomar lahem techezakna yedechem:
Veshoalim bishlomam. kol hayyamim vaafillu beyom chaggam. veaf al pi shemmetil shem shamayim al hannachri, sheshshalom echad mishshemotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu:
Rabbi yehuda omer lo yachazir. shemma tinnase veteled veyomar illu hayiti yodea shekken, afillu hayu notnim li mea mane lo hayiti megarshech:

Vachachamim omrim yachazir. shello chayshinan lekilkula. uvaggemara mefaresh man chachamim, rabbi meir, deamar bainan tenay kaful. vehacha bemay askinan delo kafleh litnaeh, shello amar lah have yodaat shemmishshum aylonit ani motziech, veim en at aylonit lo yehe get, dehashta have get afillu enah aylonit:
Vehi tovaat ketubbatah. shehaaylonit en lah ketubba. veachshav shennimtza sheenah aylonit, tovaat ketubbatah:
Shetikutich yafe lich middibburicha. sheyyomar illu yadati shessofi litten lach ketubba lo gerashtich, nimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerim:
En osin temarim devash. im hem shel teruma o shel maaser sheni. shehattemarim ochel vehaddevash mashke, veen machazirim haochel mashke:
Ella bezetim vaanavim bilvad. divferush amra tora bahem (Bamidbar 18) kol chelev yitzhar vechol chelev tirosh:
En sofgim et haarbaim mishshum arla. perot shel arla shessechatan vehotzi mehen mashke, en loke min hattora hashshote oto mashke ella bezetim vaanavim bilvad:
Veen meviim bikkurim mashkin. dichtiv (Devarim 26) et reshit peri haadama, peri atta mevi vei atta mevi mashke:
Ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim. degamar bikkurim mitteruma:
Veen makrivim al gabbe hammizbeach. ella shemen limnachot veyayin linsachim:
Chatacho chulyot lerachbo. kemo shechotech shefoferet shel kane:
Pachot mearbaa tefachim. im yesh bechulya pachot mearbaa tefachim uvaa mittannur gadol delekka rubba, tahor. aval ikka arbaa tefachim, tame, af al gav dahave miut:
Mercho vetit. bae hessek ketannur chadash:
Hirchik mimmennu et hattefela. tippul shel tit sheasa, lo chibbero lattannur ella rachok mimmennu:
Venatan chol o tzeror. ben hattefela lattannur, veal yede kach hattannur mekayyem chummo veofim bo:
Hannidda vehattehora ofot bo. dela chashiva hattefela chibbur lattannur, kevan shehi merucheket mimmennu:
Vehu tahor. sheeno mekabbel tuma:

Veenah yechola lehittaltel bachatzi kav gerogarot. mittoch shehi reua vehaggerogarot machbidim nishberet legamre vetiltulah. ulechach shiaru vachatzi kav, dehu shiur seuda achat. dekav gerogarot hu shiur shete seudot, kidmuchach besof massechet pea gabbe en pochatin leani vaggoren mikkav gerogarot. vechol delo chazya letaltel bah shiur seuda achat, kishvura damya:
Gistera. keli cheres shennechlak lishnayim, venaasa gise tere:

Sheen sheyarim lishyarim. keli shalem chasim alav umishshum sedek pureta lo shadu leh, umeviin sheyarim shel keli dehaynu shever keli umesimin tachtav, aval shever keli mikki nisdak bemotzi mashke mishda shadu leh, sheen omrim have shever keli acher lehaniach tachat shever keli ze:
Barishona. lo haya mevattelo bifne haishsha velo bifne hashshaliach, ella bammakom shehaya omed haya mevattelo bifne shelosha:
Mippene tikkun haolam. shehashshaliach sheeno yodea baddavar molicho lah vehi nisset bo. umikkoach takkanat rabban gamliel malkin al mi shemmevattel hagget o moser modaa al hagget:
Barishona haya meshanne shemo ushemah. keshehayu lo shene shemot, echad kan veechad bimdinat hayyam, haya megarshah bashshem hannoheg bimkom ketivat hagget, velo haya makpid lichtov et shenehem:

Mippene tikkun haolam. shello yotziu laaz al baneha min hashsheni, lomar lo gershah balah sheen ze shemo. veadam shehuchzak bishne shemot bishne mekomot, chad bimkom hakketiva vechad bimkom hannetina, enah megoreshet ad sheyyichtov shem shel mekom hannetina veshem shel mekom hakketiva immo. aval im huchzak bishne shemot bemakom echad vechatav echad min hashshemot, bediavad hagget kasher. mihu lechattechilla tzarich lichtov shenehem. vehecha deshinna shemo o shemah bagget, af al pi shekkatav achar kach vechol shem sheyyesh li, hagget batel:

Tannur shennitma. hattannur asuy chikdera gedola sheen lah shulayim umittaltel, ucheshebba lekavo mechabbero vaaretz umedabbek tit mibbachutz umeabbehu chede sheyyishmor chummo, vekare la tefela, shemmetappelah umechabberah lo:
Ketzad metaharim oto. kamma tehe shevirato utehe metaharto:
Cholko lishlosha. lakkeli atzmo mibbifnim. dei lishnayim, haggadol tame, deikka rubba:
Vegorer et hattefela. sheddavek alav, sheggam hi mechabbarto:
Ad sheyyehe vaaretz. kelomar mappilah ad hakkarka. i nammi, acholko kae, delo saggi vachalukka ad rubbo, ella cholek ad sheyyaggia lakkarka:
Velo ad sheyyehe vaaretz. velo lechalleko ad lematta samuch laaretz:
Ella memaato mibbifnim. ad shello yishshaer arbaa tefachim shehu shiur techillato shel tannur. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Tzarich lehassio. af al pi shechilleko, lo taher ad sheyyafrid hachalakim ze mizze. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Haggadol tame. mishshum deikka rubbo shel tannur:
Lo faslu et tziran. dehekellu betzir shel chagavim temeim sheeno oser, mippene sheen lahem dam veeno ella lachluchit bealma:
Shehu tahor. lo mibbaya deeno oser et taaruvto, ella hu atzmo tahor. vahalacha keeduto shel rabbi tzadok:

Ella reach kammon. dedavka reach shel (pittum) [kammon] nichnas letoch happat, verecha lav milleta hi, ben bitruma ben bechol issurin shebbattora. vei mishshum dehussak hattannur bitruma, en issurah issur hanaa:
Lo haya sikarikon. nachri rotzeach. kelomar lo danu din sikarikon, lomar shehakkone karka shel yisrael miyyad hannachri rotzeach, yihye chayyav liddon im habbealim:

Bishat haruge hammilchama. beshaa shehayta haggezera kasha al yisrael lehareg bammilchama. shehallokeach mimmennu beotah shaa haya mikkacho kayyam velo haya tzarich liddon im hayisrael baal hakkarka, mishshum deaggav onseh deyisrael hava gamar umakne lesikarikon. vekayma lan [bava vatra 47:] taluhu vezavin zevineh zevine:
Aval meharuge milchama veelach. shello hayta haggezera lehareg, danu din sikarikon, lomar shehakkone mimmennu yaase din im habbealim. kemo shemmeforash bammishna:
Mikkacho vatel. deamrinan miyyira avad:
Lakach min haish. karka hameyuchad lichtubbat ishto:
Mikkacho vatel. deamra nachat ruach asiti levaali:
Noten labbealim revia. sheshshiaru desikarikon mittoch shebbechinnam ba leyado mozil gabbeh riva:
Musaf hattannur. tosafto shel tannur shemmosifin begavho chede lishmor chummo:

Mippene shehu somech alav et hashshappud. shel basar, shergilim litzlot bo vasar, vehave devar tzorech lattannur. verachamana amar utemeim yihyu lachem, lechol shebbetzarchechem, kiddarshinan leel [bemishna 2]:

Mippene shehu ofe vo keshehu nidchak. kesheyyesh lo uchlusin merubbin vetzarich lefat merubba. verabbi yochanan lo saggi leh betaama detanna kamma mippene shehu somech alav et hashshappud, disvira leh devainan sheyyehe tashmish hattosefet keen tashmish gufo shel tannur:

Musaf hayyora shel sholke zetim. derech sholke zetim vetzabbaim sheyyesh lahem yorot gedolot veosim lahem tosefet tit al sefatam sheyyaalu vah hammayim beet retichatam. veshel sholke zetim tame, lefi sheotah tosefet tzericha lakkeli umishtammeshim bah:
Veshel tzabbaim tahor. delo mishtammesh beh ki hechi dela lifsid tziveh. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan hassandelar:
Yabbelit. min esev sheshshemo yabbela. uregilin latuach bo hakkaddot haggedolot shello yifletu hayyayin shemmeziin:
Pittasin. kaddot gedolot. kemo hallalu baale fittasin divmassechet betza [daf 15:]:

Al hachereshet shehissiah aviha. veaf al gav dehavya eshet ish gemura shehare kibbel aviha kiddusheha keshehi ketanna, afillu hachi yotza beget, umekabbelet et gittah keshehi chereshet, veaf al gav delet ba data, deishsha mitgareshet beal karchah, hilkach lo bainan datah:
Veal ketanna vat yisrael shennisset lechohen. vehi yetoma, delo have nissuim ella midderabbanan:
Sheochelet batteruma. derabbanan. velo gazrinan teruma derabbanan attu teruma deorayta:
Marish. kora:
Bira. bayit gadol:
Mippene takkanat hashshavim. sheim atta matzricho lekakea birato ulehachzir hammarish atzmo, yimmana millaasot teshuva:
Shello noda larabbim. shehi gezula:
Shehi mechapperet. veen tzarich lehavi acheret:
Mippene tikkun mizbeach. shello yihyu kohanim atzevim sheachlu chullin shennishchatu baazara, venimtza mizbeach batel, shennimnaim millaavod avoda:

Yoter mitztzarkah. keneged hannekev hu tzarkah, uma shehu shello keneged hannekev have yoter mitztzarkah, vela chashiv chibbur, kevan delo tzarich lechavit. verambam peresh, yoter mitztzarkah kegon sheasa hassetima ava veyoter ad sheyyuchal lehinnatel mimmenna vetishshaer setuma, vaafillu hakkol keneged hannekev:
Zefet shennatfa al hechavit. sheenah nekuva:
Hannogea bah. betippat hazzefet:
Tahor. af al pi shehechavit temea. sheen hazzefet chibbur lechavit kevan sheen hechavit tzericha lah:
Sheppekako vezefet. shessatam pi hannekev shel hammashpech heasuy lehachenis mimmennu yayin lechavit:
Rabbi elazar ben azarya metamme. dachashiv leh setima, ben beshel etz ben beshel cheres:
Verabbi akiva metamme veshel etz. mippene shehazzefet hu mino, shehazzefet yotze min haetz:

Umetaher beshel chares. sheeno mino vela chashiv chibbur. velo dame setimat pi hammashpech listimat nekev hechavit dachashiv chibbur, lefi shehannekev shebbefi hammashpech sheasao hayyotzer mittechilla chalak hu veniklaf hazzefet mimmennu veeno mitkayyem, aval chavit shennikkeva leachar shehusseka vakkivshan i efshar lannekev lihyot chalak veshave veen hazzefet niklaf mimmennu, i nammi, nekev shebbefi hammashpech sofo lehasir setimato chesheyyirtze lishpoch yayin bechavit, hilkach la chashiva setima ella vemashpech shel etz lefi shehu mino, aval chavit shennikkevah en sofo lehasir hassetima:
