Rabbi yose metaher bishnehem. distimat pi hammashpech la chashiva setima, vahare hu cheillu lo nistam veen lo bet kibbul. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Shel even veshel mattechet tahor. shel even tahor legamre. veshel mattechet tahor middin kele cheres, sheeno mittamme meaviro, veyesh lo tohora vemikve:

Vetame mishshum kele mattachot. shemmekabbel tuma miggabbo venaase av hattuma. veim hu mechubbar lakkarka eno mittamme, dechol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu chakkarka, chutz mittannur vechirayim shel cheres dichtiv behu (Vayikra 11) tannur vechirayim yuttatz, et sheyyesh bo netitza:
Nikkav nifgam nisdak. veasa tippul shel sid listom hannekev vehappegam vehassedek, o sheasa al piv tosefet shel tit, tame, kedin tannur shel cheres:
Vechen bechira. vechen shiur nekev shel kira, kede sheyyetze mimmennu haur, keshiur nekev shel tannur:

Veasa lah pitputin. hacha lo tane veasa lah tefela, [lefi] sheen osin tefela lechira shennikkeva o nifgema kemo sheosin letannur, ella cheshennikkeva o nifgema hakkira bimkom moshavah regilin bimkom hannekev laasot pitputin, hen ragle hakkira, kemo 313 belaaz, shehakkira yoshevet al otan pitputin:

Merchah betit. tehora. sheen meruach shel tit moil ella vetannur sheofin hallechem betocho, aval lo vechira, lefi sheen ofin umevashshelin betoch hakkira atzmah ella mannichin betochah o al gabbah hakkedera. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bemakom acher pasul. shehabbaal makpid, sheen retzono sheyyalizu alav sham:
Hare hi vemakom peloni. eno ella kemare makom, sham timtzaennah:
Verabbi eliezer machshir. desavar ihu demiddateh megaresh ikka kefeda, ihi dival karchah mitgareshet mara makom hi lo. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Shekkevashan im zete teruma. derech zetim lechavshan bemayim uvemelach, ucheshezzete chullin petzuin, dehaynu ketushim o merussakim, bolim mizzete teruma, af im zete teruma hem shelemim, veaf im kevashan bemayim shennichbeshu bahen zete teruma, asur:
Aval sheleme chullin. keshezzete chullin shelemin, af im kevashan im zete [teruma] petzuin, en bolin mehen:

En nifraim minnechasim meshubadim. kegon love shemmachar benonit shello shehi meshubedet levaal chov, en habbaal chov yachol litrof otah min hallokeach im nishar etzel hallove nechasim bene chorin, veaf al pi sheenan ella zibburit:
Have li gitti ochelet batteruma. im eshet kohen hi, ad sheyyaggia get leyadah:
Leoto makom. shekkach amra lo lo tehe sheluchi ella sham:

Verabbi eliezer oser miyyad. mishshepparash meetzlah. verabbi eliezer letaameh demachshir keshekkibbelo bemakom acher, demara makom hi lo umishsheat kabbala iggarsha lah, lefichach mishshaa shepparash millefaneha asura, shemma metzao chutz lair vekibbelo hemennu. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Vechayyevet bemaasrot. maaser rishon vesheni. vehu haddin bitruma:
Uvemaasar ani. im hi shana shelishit o shishshit shel shemitta shemmaaser ani noheg bahen:
Hachovet. giddule teruma hallalu bemaklot, hare ze meshubbach, kede shello yitztarech lachasom et habbehema sheddash bah, sheasur lehannichah leechol bitruma im enah parato shel kohen:
Kefifot. sallin:
Meoto hammin. shel chullin, im chittim chittim veim seorim seorim:
Nimtza lo zomem. kelomar eno chosem venoten zemem letoch piha, shehare hi ochelet meoto hammin:
Velo maachilah teruma. demishshel chullin shebbakkefifa hatteluya betzavvarah hi ochelet:
En notnin devela ugerogarot. shel teruma:
Letoch hammureyas. shumman shel dagim:
Mippene shehu meabbedan. shekken derech devela ugerogarot hannetunim bemureyas lesachatan ulehotzi et memehen veachar kach mashlichan:

Aval notnim et hayyayin lammureyas. regilim hayu latet yayin lammureyas shello haya vo shamnunit kol kach kede lematkko velatet bo taam. hilkach muttar litten yayin shel teruma letocho, velo amrinan laavure zuhama bilvad hu noten et hayyayin vahava kimabbedo:
En mefattemin et hashshemen. shel teruma beikkere vesamim, shebbolim et hashshemen veazel leibbud. i nammi delo chaze hashshemen laachila keshehu mefuttam:
Yenumelim. notnim letoch hayyayin devash ufilpelin:
Mamito. shemmitchasser umitmaet al yede habbishshul. veit dimfarshe shemmamito mishshotav, sheen bene adam regilin lishtot yayin mevushshal kemo chay:
Mippene shehu mashbicho. umitkayyem yoter. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hazzorea teruma shogeg yofach. choresh umehappech kede shello yigdal, veen bechach kelum:
Umezid yekayyem. kevan shennikra shem teruma al hassade haya nire kimabbed et hatteruma:
Veim hevia shelish afillu shogeg yekayyem. mishshum deasur leabbed et hatteruma:
Uvefishtan mezid yofach. vaafillu hevia shelish, kede shello yehane bakkismin veyachashov shehazzera bilvad hu dahave teruma veasur, veikkar pishtan mishshum kismin hu velo mishshum zera:

Hashsholeach vehiggia bashshaliach. shello haya mitkavven lirdof acharav lehassigo, ella shennishtaha hashshaliach badderech vehaya lo laze derech lesham veraahu uvittel hagget, afillu hachi batel, velo amrinan litzurah bealma mechavven, sheim haya vedato levattelo haya rodef acharav:

Eno yachol levattelo. ha ka mashma lan deaf al pi dechazinan leh demahadar aleh meikkara levittuleh, lo amrinan iggallai milleta lemafrea devattole vatteleh. vehecha deyahiv eynash gitta lidvithu lizman o al tenay, i amar lah hare ze gittech meachshav velizman peloni o im yitkayyem tenay peloni, mikki mate gittah leyadah lo matze tu levatleh, vetihye megoreshet leoto zeman o kesheyyitkayyem hattenay. vei lo amar lah meachshav, afillu levatar dimta gittah leyadah matze mevattel leh:
Tannur shehussak meachorav. sheen hattannur mekabbel tuma ad sheyyassikennu, veim lo hussak mibbifnim ella mibbachutz, chashiv hessek:
O shehussak shello ledato. [afillu mibbifnim]:
O shehussak bevet haumman. kodem shennigmar melechet asiyyato:
Tame. garsinan. veyesh sefarim sheggorsin tahor, veshibbush hu:
Mishshum shem ra. sheyyatza aleha laaz zenut:
Mishshum neder. shennadra vehu omer i efshi beishsha nadranit:

Lo yachazir. vaafillu nimtzeu haddevarim sheker, o hanneder hittiro chacham. shemma telech vetinnase leacher veyimmatze hallaaz shel zenut sheker, vehanneder yattirenu chacham vehi lo tihye perutza bindarim, veyomar illu hayiti yodea shekken afillu hayu notnim li mea mane lo hayiti megarshah, venimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerim. lefichach omrim lo heve yodea shehammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra umishshum neder lo yachazir olamit, umittoch haddevarim hallalu hu gomer umegaresh gerushin gemurim velo matze tu lekalkelah:

Rabbi yehuda omer kol neder sheyyadu vo rabbim lo yachazir. rabbi yehuda savar detama deamur rabbanan hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra umishshum neder lo yachazir, kede shello tihyena benot yisrael perutzot baarayot uvindarim. umishshum hachi kaamar deneder sheyyadu vo rabbim, asara miyyisrael o yoter, ikka peritzuta tefe, ukenasuha velo yachazir. veshello yadu vo rabbim lekka peritzuta kulle hay velo kenasuha:

Lo yachazir. derabbi meir savar tama mishshum kilkula. hilkach neder sheeno yachol lehafer aval chacham yachol lehattir, yachol hu lekalkel et hagget leachar shettinnase leacher veyomar illu hayiti yodea shechacham yachol lehattir lo hayiti megarshah:

Vesheeno tzarich chakirat chacham. ella hu yachol lehafer, lo hutzrechu chachamim leesor alav millehachzirah, lefi sheeno yachol lekalkelah velomar illu hayiti yodea kulei, shehare neder patuach hu vehaya lo lehafer velo hefer:
Lo asru ze. shetztzarich chakirat chacham, lehachazir:

Ella mippene ze. sheeno tzarich. divtzarich lo haya lanu lachush lekilkula, lefi sheeno yachol lomar illu hayiti yodea shechacham yachol lehattiro lo hayiti megaresh, daanan sahade sheaf al pi chen haya megaresh, sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din bifne chacham lelech levet dino velishol al nidrah. ella mippene neder sheeno tzarich chacham uvaal yachol lehafer, asru et kullan, shello yomar illu hayiti yodea shehayiti yachol lehafer lo hayiti megarshah:

Amar rabbi yose verabbi yehuda kulei. baggemara mefaresh dachasure michassera vehachi katane, bamme devarim amurim, keshennadra hi, aval nadar hu sheyyegarshenah vegershah, yachazir velo chayshinan lekilkula:

Veamar rabbi yose verabbi yehuda maase nammi betzayyedan beechad sheamar leishto konam im eni megarshech. kelomar yeasru kol perot shebbaolam alay im eni megarshech, vegershah, vehittiru lo chachamim sheyyachazirenna:

Mippene tikkun haolam. kelomar shello amru chachamim hammegaresh et ishto mishshum neder lo yachazirenna ella mippene tikkun haolam dechayshinan lekilkula, veha lo shayyach ella mishshum neder didah, aval keshennadar hu sheen kan mishshum tikkun haolam, hittiru lehachazir. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kol shennittelu azneha. chashuva gistera, vaafillu hi shelema, hoil veen lah aznayim letaltelah mimmakom lemakom. veim nitroaa, shiurah kemotzi mashke:
Hayu vah chiddudim. setam cheres shennishbar yotzin mimmennu chiddudim. kemo [iyyov ma] chaddude chares:

Kol hamekabbel immah bezetim. im en kazzayit yotze ben chiddud lechiddud, chashuv toch kemo haggistera atzmah umittamme afillu vaavir. aval im yotze zayit mibbentayim, eno mittamme vaavir. aval mittamme vemagga mittaam yad:
Hayta mutta al tziddah. shennechleka learkah kemin areva veenah yoshevet ella al dafnoteha veyesh lah chiddudim:

Kol hamekabbel immah bezetim. kederech shemmittammea chesheyyoshevet al shuleha kach mittammea yoshevet al tziddah. usetam matnitin kachachamim dilel dimtammein bechavit shennechleka chemin shene arevot:
Kattedra. kisse shel nashim haholchot al haagala:
Korfiyyot. al shem mekoman. vehen kelim chaddim sheen yoshvim shello mesummachin:

Vekosim. leshon kesot hannasech [bemidbar 5], uvesanhedrin haggonev et hakkasva, vehu shem lichli sharet. vekosin hen mine chelim sheshshulehen chaddin ucheshemmevashshelim bahen mannichin otan al keli varzel shekkorin 323 belaaz, ucheshemmoridim otan somchin otan beefer hakkira:
Hatztzidonin. shennaasim betzidon:
Chatacho chulyot. shechatacho lattannur berachbo lechulyot, vehinniach chulya al gabbe chulya:
Venatan chol ben chulya lechulya. vetach oto betit veasa lo tefela chederech sheosin letannurim:
Rabbi eliezer metaher. dechevan deyesh chol ben hassedakim, keshavur dame:
Vachachamim metammein. shehattefela osa et kullo echad umechabberet et hassedakim, veaf al pi sheyyesh chol ben chulya lechulya:

Vezehu tannuro shel achnay. lechach nikra tannuro shel achnay, shehikkifuhu halachot keachna zo vetimmeuhu. achna, nachash sheddarko leasot kaagulla lehachenis zenavo letoch piv, kach hikkifu vitshuva ureayot rabbi eliezer vachachamim ze et ze, al tannur ze. ulevassof mippene shehaya rabbi eliezer yachid keneged rabbim, nifseka hahalacha kerabbim delo cherabbi eliezer. veheviu chol tohorot shettiher rabbi eliezer userafum baesh venimnu uverchuhu, mippene shehaya machazik bammachaloket keneged rabbim:
Yorot haarviyyin. leefot pat hen asuyin. kedimfaresh veazel:
Shel ben dinay. rabbotay pershu shem adam shehaya ose tannurim hallalu. vaani shamati al shem sheddanu vo dinim harebe:
Bitvalim asurim. kegon tevalin shel teruma o shel arla vechile hakkerem:
Afillu chelmon. haodem shel betza shehu mibbifnim, vechol shekken hachelbon shehu mibbachutz:
Me chevashim ume shelakot. shennichbeshu o nishleku vahen teruma, asurim lezarim:

Chavit shennitroaa. kemo chotel raua. shello naflu charaseha aval hi reua chol kach sheim yetalteluha vachatzi kav gerogarot betochah tishshaver legamre. utehora hi kidamrinan lekamman beidach pirkin [mishna 2]:
Utefalah. shettach paneha:
Biglalim. kede shello yippelu hacharasim:

Nishbera. shennaflu hacharasim vedibbek hashshevarim bekolan shel sofrim, o shehevi charasim mimmakom acher vedibbekan veachar kach tefalan biglalim, tehora. vehu haddin tefalan betit, kol zeman shello chazar utzerafah bakkivshan:
Cheres machazik reviit. uchegon shehacheres baa mechavit hammachzeket millog vead sea, deshiurah birviit kidfareshna leel:
Kullan mittammein bemagga. dechullan naasim yad leoto cheres, umittammein mishshum yad. uchenegdo bilvad mittamme baavir, deen avir leyad kele cheres:
En almana nifraat. ketubbatah:
Minnichse yetomim, ella vishvua. shello nitkabbela kelum:

Nimneu millehashbiah. shemmippene shehi torachat lifne hayyetomim mora hettera leatzmah lishshava shello lakcha kelum. veaf al pi shellakcha davar muat sevura shebbischar tircha notalto veeno mippiron ketubbatah. ulefichach nimneu millehashbiah vehayta mafsedet ketubbatah:
Hitkin rabban gamliel shettehe noderet laytomim kol ma sheyyirtzu. kegon konam mine mezonot alay im neheneti mikketubbati:

Vegova chetubbatah. veim nisset leacher kodem shehiddiruha hayetomim al ketubbatah, veim yaddiruha achar shennisset, shemma yafer lah balah, ketzad yaasu, mashbiin otah chutz levet din shevua derabbanan sheen anshah merubbe, venotelet ketubbatah achar shennisset. ucheshebbat ligbot ketubbatah kodem shettinnase leacher, harshut beyad hayetomim, ratzu mashbiin otah chutz levet din, o maddirim otah bevet din:

Haedim chotmim al hagget mippene tikkun haolam. attarvayhu kae, gabbe almana shettehe noderet layyorshim kol ma sheyyirtzu, mippene tikkun haolam, sheyyihyu hannashim nissaot levaalehen velo tidagna lehafesid ketubbatan. vegabbe edim chotmim al hagget mippene tikkun haolam, dehoil veede mesira karte, shehaedim shennimsar hagget bifnehem laishsha hem ikkar haggerushin, lo haya tzarich sheyyachtemu edim bagget, ella mippene tikkun haolam, dechayshinan shemma yamut echad min haedim shennimsar hagget bifnehem, venimtza hagget shebbeyadah belo edim kechaspa bealma:

Hillel hitkin perozbul. sheraa et haam shennimneu millehalvot ze et ze veavru al ma shekkatuv battora (Devarim 15) hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha beliyyaal, amad vehitkin perozbul. veze gufo shel perozbul, moser ani lachem peloni ufeloni dayyanim, shekkol chov sheyyesh li etzel peloni, sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze:
Kira. mekom shefitat shete kederot. ufeamim shennotnim hakkederot levashshel betochah ufeamim al gabbah:
Techillatah shalosh. gavhah en pachot mishshalosh etzbaot:
Mishshettiggamer melachtah. meematay mittammea techillatah, mishshettiggamer melachta:
Betza kalla. betzat tarnegolet. veammay kare la betza kalla, shehi kalla levashshel yoter mikkol habbetzim:
Terufa. keshehi terufa ushevura vakkeara:
Unetuna veilpas. shehucham kevar, shehi memaheret lehitbashshel:
Hakkuppach. shiur shefitat kedera achat. vechummo rav mechom hakkira. ufeamim sheofin bo fat:
Shiuro kattannur. kede leefot sufganim:
Shiuro kakkira. levashshel bo vetza kalla:

Haeven hayyotze. regilim lechabber even battannur shebboletet mimmennu lachutz kede sheyyihye lo levet achiza, uchetannur damya. veim nitma hattannur nitmet haeven, venitma happat shennaga bah, mippene shehu yad lattannur, uchetiv (Vayikra 11) tannur vechirayim yuttatz vegomer‏ temeim yihyu lachem, lechol shebbetzarchechem, lerabbot et hayyadot shehen tzorech lakkeli:

Lo amru. deyoter mittefach battannur umishshalosh etzbaot bakkira lo have chibbur, ella cheshehaeven ben hattannur velakkotel, mippene shemmeakkevet sheen yecholin lekarev hattannur lakkotel vedochek et habbayit, hilkach yoter mittefach omedet linnatel hi. aval letzad habbayit, afillu gedola harebe, yad hi lattannur. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Vehashshear tahor. detanya vetorat kohanim, yachol sheani merabbe yoter mikkashshiur, talmud lomar temeim hem:
Harode. hotzaat happat min hattannur nikret rediyya:
Unetanah al pi chavit shel yayin shel teruma. dehashta happat koletet veshoevet mereach hayyayin:
Rabbi meir oser. desavar recha milleta hi:
Verabbi yehuda mattir. desavar recha lav milleta hi:
Mippene shehasseorim shoavot. moshchot millachluchit yayin shel teruma. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Hattevel giddulav muttarim. baachilat aray, (kesheachal) [kishar] tevel shello nigmera melachto:

Bedavar shezzaro chale. hasheta mefaresh tana lemilleteh ditnan leel hattevel giddulav chullin lo haveya ella bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale. afillu giddule giddulin asurim baachilat aray:

Hashshum kasseora. kelomar hashshum chashuv zaro chale kemo hasseora. venakat seora lefi sheen battevuot davar sheyyihye zaro chale veneevad mehera kemo hasseora. perush acher hashshum shehu gadol kisora en zaro chale, aval pachot mikkisora zaro chale. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Yatza ven chorin. im barach min hannachri, o shekkansu oto bet din lifdoto min hannachrim, kidamrinan kofin oto lifdoto. veachar sheppedao lo yishtabed bo. ukenas chachamim hu, lefi shehifkio min hammitzvot. vechen lechutza laaretz yatza lecherut, lefi shehotzio meeretz yisrael:
Mippene tikkun haolam. shello yimseru hannachrim atzman leharebot lehavi shevuyin kesheroin shemmochrin otam beyoter mikkede demehem:
Veen mavrichin et hashshevuyin mippene tikkun haolam. shemma yiktzefu al hashshevuyin haatidim lavo leyadam veyittenum beshalshelaot veyasimu bassad raglam:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mippene takkanat hashshevuyin. delo chayesh rabban shimon ben gamliel al haatidim lavo bashshivya, ella al otam shehem shevuyim atta immo. sheim en shavuy ella hu yechidi, mavrichin oto, veen lachush kan mippene takkanat shevuyim acherim kesheen shevuyim acherim immo. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Vechen chavit shel shemen. tehora shennishpecha vechullah holechet leibbud, pelige kedilel. ulehachi katane gabbe shemen nishpecha velo nakat kemo gabbe yayin, mishshum divchavit shel shemen [shennishbera] baggat haelyona, uvattachtona chullin temeim, mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora yatztzil veim lav tered veal yetammeenna bayyad, mishshum deshemen rauy lehadelik velo chashu lehefsed muat. uveyayin nammi lo nechleku ella davka bidikka battachtona pachot mimmea chullin, shennaasin hachullin kullan medumma veikka hefsed, aval i ikka mea chullin kullehu modu deal yetammeenna bayyad, mishshum delekka hefsed:
Hammanniach perot lihyot mafrish alehen kulei. somech al ellu veochel tevalim acherim sheyyesh lo, veomer, hare terumatan beotan perot shehiktzeti lechach:
Veim avdu. halach levadkan umetzaan sheavdu:
Hare ze choshesh. leotan tevalim shettikken behavetachatan shel ellu. veim lo achalan tzarich lehaferish mehem, shemma kesheamar hare terumatan bapperot shehiktzeti kevar hayu avudin:

Meet leet. shel bedika. keshebbedakan umetzaan avudin choshesh shemma meetmol baet hazzot avdu, veim asaan maaser toch meet leet al perot acherim tzarich lehaferish alehem missafek. utefe mehachi lo achmur rabbanan lemechash, ella somchin achazaka:
Bodkin et hayyayin. shehinnicho lihyot mafrish alav, tzarich levadko shemma hechmitz, veen tormin min hachometz al hayyayin:
Bekadim shel motzae hechag. keshemmenashshevet ruach kadim bemotzae hechag:

Uvishat kenisat mayim. keshehen kefol hallavan nikraim boser. ucheshehallachluchit nichneset ugedela betocho sheyyachol laatzor mehen kol shehu, hayenu kenisat mayim. perush acher, hayu kotshim haanavim keshehen boser venotnim letocho mayim veosim chometz letabbel. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haose shelosha fitputim. shelosha raglayim yoshvim baaretz:
Vechibberam betit. lemala verosham, keen keli varzel shekkorin 313:
Kava shelosha masmerim. shennaatz otam bakkarka:
Tehora. dichle mattachot hamechubbarim lakkarka kekarka damu veen mekabbelim tuma:
Vechibberam betit temea. kechira shel cheres, shehattit shebberoshan noten lahen torat cheres:
Ad sheyyaase shelishit. keen shelosha fitputin:
O ad sheyyismoch lakkotel. shehakkotel yismoch et hakkedera mitztzad echad:
Achat betit. achat chibber lachavertah betit beroshah:
Veachat shello vetit. shehashshelishit lo chibber. verabbi yehuda hi, veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haomer hitkabbel. im ratza lachazor yachazor. deget chov hu lah, veen chavin leadam shello middato:
Lo yachazor. dechevan deihi shavviteh shaliach hare hu keyadah, venitgarsha miyyad bekabbalato shel ze:
Af haomeret tol li gitti. leshon kabbala hu. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Meafar ulemattan mittamme vemagga. im naga sheretz battannur mittocho lemala min heafar nitma ma shellematta min heafar. aval im nitla hashsheretz baavir velo naga bedafne hattannur mittocho, lo nitma ella ma shellemala min heafar:
Bor. chafira lematta baaretz:
Dut. kevor hu asuy, ella shehu vinyan lemala min hakkarka:
Venatan sham even. ben habbor uven dofen hattannur, lehachazik hattannur shello yippol letoch habbor:

Im massik millematta. im keshemmassik haur millematta betoch habbor, hattannur nissok mittocho lemala derech shulav, tame. veim lav, sheeno nissok mehessek haur shellematta vetoch habbor, tahor. ufelugta derabbi yehuda verabbanan davka vehessek rishon shehu gemar melachto shel tannur veal yede oto hessek hu mekabbel tuma, rabbi yehuda savar tzarich sheyyehe hattannur mechubbar laaretz behessek rishon, dichtiv tannur vechirayim yuttatz, veen shayyach leshon netitza ella vimchubbar lakkarka, divmittaltel nofel leshon shevira lo leshon netitza, hilkach im hattannur nissok derech shulav mehessek shebbetoch habbor, chashiv kimchubbar labbor vekarinan beh yuttatz, veim eno nissok mehessek habbor hare hu nittotz veomed vei efshar lekayyem bo tu yuttatz:

Vachachamim omrim hoil vehu nissok mikkol makom tame. deamar kera utemeim yihyu lachem, mikkol makom, vaafillu im massiko cheshehu taluy vetzavvar haggamal have hessek venigmera melachto vechach. vehakkol modim behessek sheni leachar shennigmera melachto shehu mittamme afillu vetzavvar haggamal. vahalacha kachachamim:
Sefayot. milleshon safa. sheyyesh lo shalosh sefatot lefiv, vaavir bentayim ben safa lesafa:
Happenimit odefet hakkol tahor. kol ma shehu chutz mimmenna nechshav kegabbo shel keli veen keli cheres mittamme miggabbo. aval ma shebbetoch happenimit tame:

Hachitzona odefet hakkol tame. dahave chutza lah kegabbo shel keli velifnim mimmenna chashuv toch. vechen im emtzait gevoha, mimmenna velachutz chashuv gav velifnim chashuv toch, shehakkeli mitmalle ad haggevoha:
Hayu shavot. sheen achat min hassefatot odefet al chavertah:
Vachachamim omrim hakkol tahor. hassafa shennafla hattuma vaavirah bilvad hi temea, vehashshear hakkol tahor. vechen halacha:
Mishsheyyitzrefem bakkivshan. vekodem tzeruf hen kele adama veen mittammein:

Vehu gemar melachtan. veaf al gav dilachar tzeruf hakkivshan tzerichin tikkun lemarchan lehachelikan ulehashvot sefatan, af al pi chen mishsheyyetzarfem bakkivshan chashiv nigmera melachtan umittammein:
Yetomim shessamchu etzel baal habbayit. laasot maasehem al piv, velo shennitmanna lahem appotroppos, afillu hachi keappotroppos hu.
Appotroppos. bilshon romi korin laav 290 velakketannim 161. uferush appotroppos avihen shel ketannim:
Shemminnahu avi yetomim yishshavea. dei lav deit leh hannaa minneh lo hava leh appotroppos, umishshum shevua lo ate leammenue:
Minnahu vet din lo yishshavea. detovat chinnam hi shezze ose levet din lekabbel divrehem velitroach chinnam, vei ramit aleh shevua ate leimmanue:

Abba shaul omer chilluf haddevarim. minnahu bet din yishshavea, divhahi hanaa deka nafek aleh kala deeynash mehemana hu deha samche aleh be dina, mishshum shevua lo ate leimmanue. minnahu avi yetomim lo yishshavea, detovat chinnam ose lo litroach im banav, vei ramit aleh shevua ate leimmanue. vahalacha keabba shaul:
Hametamme. tohorotav shel chavero:
Vehamedammea. mearev teruma bechullin shel chavero, umafsido, shetztzarich lemachro lakkohanim bezol:
Vehamenassech. shemmearev yen nesech beyayin kasher veosro bahanaa:
Bemezid chayyav. uvedin hu sheyyehe fatur, dehezzek sheeno nikkar lav shemeh hezzek, ella mippene tikkun haolam, shello yehe kol echad veechad holech umetamme tohorotav shel chavero veomer patur ani:
Hakkohanim sheppiglu. karbanot, sheshshachatu vezarku damam bemachashevet leechol mehem chutz lizmanno. velo huretzu labbealim:
Mezidim. sheyyadu sheppesulim bechach:

Chayyavim. leshallem demehen labbealim, shehare tzerichin lehavi acherim, vei nammi nedava hi sheeno chayyav betashlumin, mikkol makom kashe beenav shello hikriv karbano shehare lehavi doron haya mevakkesh:
Tzericha. lehavi lefanenu shete chitte edim:
Shenayim sheyyomru befanenu amara. lo lekabbelo:
Ushenayim sheyyomru befanenu kibbel vekara. uvishat hashshemad shanu, sheggazru al hammitzvot vehayu korim hagget miyyad, shello yerae:
Vaafillu hen kulei. shehashshenayim sheamra vifnehem hem atzmam rau keshekkibbelu:
O achad min harishonim veachad min haacharonim veechad. shelishi, shennaasa ed bezo uvezo, mitztaref immahem:
Hi veaviha. o hi o aviha. hi yesh lah yad deha gedola hi. veaviha nammi zakkay lekabbelo:
Enah mitgareshet. vaafillu bekabbalat aviha, dichtiv (Devarim 24) veshillechah mibbeto, mi shemmeshallechah veenah chozeret, yatza zo shemmeshallechah vechozeret:

Giddule teruma teruma. midderabbanan, avdu rabbanan takkanta mishshum teruma temea beyad kohen, ki hechi delo lishhe la legabbeh ad zeman hazzera kede lezarah veate vah lide takkala, umishshum hachi gazru sheyyihyu giddule teruma kitruma:
Vegiddule giddulin chullin. im chazar vezara otan giddulin, giddulehen chullin:
Hattevel. giddulav chullin, mishshum derubbo chullin:
Umaaser rishon. nammi mishshum derubbo chullin:
Usefiche sheviit. lefi sheenan metzuyin veenan nohagim bechol shana:
Uterumat chutza laaretz. nammi lefi sheenah metzuya:
Vehamedumma. sherubbo chullin:
Uvikkurim. sheenan metzuyin, [sheenan] nohagim ella beshivat hamminim:
Giddule hekdesh umaaser sheni chullin. sheim zara mehen sea achat vehosif kamma sea, chullin, af bedavar sheen zaro chale:
Ufode otam bizman zaram. pode kol haotzar bidme otah sea:
Veamar kol hashshomea et kolo. uferesh shemo veshem iro:
Ratza lesachek bah. hoil velo amar tenu:
Maase bevari. mefaresh baggemara dachasure michassera vehachi katane, veim hochiach sofo al techillato, hare ze get, umaase nammi bevari vechulei. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Sitvaniyyot. anavim sheenam mitbashshelim ad yemot hassetav, uregilim laasot mehen chometz:
Ushear kol me ferot. chutz miyyayin veshemen:
Mechayyev keren vechomesh. lezar haochlan beshogeg, dechashiv lehu mashke teruma mammash:
Verabbi yehoshua poter. michomesh. aval keren chayyav, ulechattechilla asurim lezarim:
Metamme mishshum mashke. temeim, umetammeim, umachshirim zeraim lekabbel tuma kishar mashkim, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) asher yavo alav mayim yitma vechol mashke asher yishte:

Kemone fetamin. kappattam hazze shemmone tzerorot besamim shello shello vedikduk vechozer umosif alehem, aval chachamim bedikduk manu shiva mashkim, sheellu bilvad temeim umetammeim umachshirim hazzeraim lekabbel tuma, veen lehosif alehem. veshiva mashkin shemmanu chachamim hem mayim, tal, yayin, shemen, devash devorim, chalav, dam. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Samach lazo even achat mikkan velazo even achat mikkan. venimtzeu achshav shalosh kirot, haemtzait temea vehachitzonot tehorot. hilkach shete avanim emtzaiyyot chetzyah shel zo vechetzyah shel zo [shel tzad hattahor] tahor, shemmeshammesh lattahor:
Nittelu hachitzonot hattehorot. chazru emtzaiyyot letumatan kevattechilla vechullan temeot, shehare en kan meshammesh lattahor:

Rabbi yose omer kol hannishlakim im hatteradim asurim. rabbi yose paleg attanna kamma, vesavar dechol shear yerakot enan osrim afillu nishlakim, chutz min hatteradim shel issur, kegon shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem, shehen notnim taam bishlikatan:

Keruv shel shikya. haggadel beeretz yevesha shetztzarich lehashekotah, im [shelako] im keruv shel teruma haggadel beeretz lacha, sheen tzarich lehashekotah, asur, deshel shikya mechamat yavshuto hu bolea:

Rabbi akiva omer. kol issur vehetter hammitbashshelim ze im ze, vehem min echad, muttarim, sheen notnim taam ze vaze, chutz mibbesar issur vehetter shennitbashshelu yachad deasur. velet hilcheta kechad mehanach tannae, ella ketanna kamma bilvad deamar kol hannichbashim muttarim chutz min hachasit, aval mevushshalim o shelukim kullan osrim:
Hakkaved oseret. kaved shel terefa shebbishshelah im hetter, oseret kol hammitbashshel immah:

Veenah neeseret. im nitbashshela im devar issur, demittoch shehi teruda liflot tadir ribbuy dam shebbah, lo vala. vehilcheta kaved shennitbashshela afillu hi shel hetter asur leachlah, veoseret kol ma shennitbashshel immah, lefi shehi melea dam, ufoletet vechozeret uvolaat mehaddam sheppalta. veen lah takkana bevishshul, ella im ken hivhavah baur techilla yafe, vechen nahagu haam:
Mea ligna shel teruma. sade shennizrea arugot arugot, veyesh bah mea arugot shel teruma veachat shel chullin, velo yedia he dechullin:
Kullan muttarim. kulla hu shehekellu begiddule teruma, daaruga achat shel chullin matteret arugot rabbot bedavar shezzaro chale:
Aval bedavar sheen zaro chale. achat shel teruma oseret mea shel chullin, lefi sheen hakkarka ola beachat umea:
Garav. chavit:

Kol garav shehu machazik satayim. im nichbash dag tame im harebe dagim tehorim betoch chavit, vehechavit machazik satayim, veyesh mitztzir dag tame mishkal eser zuzim shel yehuda, shehem chamesh selaim shel galil, vechol hashshear tzir dag tahor, shennimtza tzir shel dag tame echad mittesha meot veshishshim shel dag tahor, asur. veim haya hatztzir shel dag tame pachot mikken, muttar:

Rabbi yehuda omer reviit lesatayim. kesheyyihye reviit log shel tzir tame betoch satayim shel tahor asur hakkol, pachot mikken muttar. veshiur ze hu karov lematayim. veaf al gav derabbi yehuda savar min bemino lo batil, shane tzir, dezea bealma hu veen issuro ella midderabbanan, lechach amar rabbi yehuda devatel bekarov lematayim:
Verabbi yose omer. devatel beshishsha asar. vehilcheta detzir batel beyoter meelef, im yesh yoter meelef middag tahor veechad middag tame hakkol muttar, veim lav hakkol asur:
Kitvu iggeret vechulei. shehagget karuy iggeret, shekkach katuv bo veiggeret shevukin:
Pitruha lo amar kelum. dilma leshon petur vechova kaamar, lehakel mealeha chovot shechayyevet:
Parnesuha. leshon asiyyat tzeracheha kemo motziim lapparnasa vechulei. hilkach lo yadinan i tzarche hagget hu, shello tehe zekuka leyavam, i tzarche malbush uchesut hu:
Kannimmos. kachok. lo yadinan i chok get i chok mazon uchesut. vechen karauy:
Hayyotze vekolar. lehareg bedin hammalchut:
Veamar kitvu. af al pi shello amar tenu:
Yichtevu veyittenu. deaggav pachdeh tared velo faresh:
Hamefaresh. layyam:
Vehayyotze vishyara. lammidbariyyot:
Hammesukkan. chole. vahalacha kerabbi shimon shezuri:

Hannizzakin shamin lahem beiddit. af al gav demiddeorayta hi, dichtiv (Shemot 22) metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem, hay tanna savar demetav sadehu denizzak kaamar kera, umippene tikkun haolam amru chachamim sheyyeshallem hammazzik meiddit shebbinchasav, af al pi shehem tovim meiddit shel nizzak, kede sheyyehu nizharim millehazzik:

Uvaal chov bevenonit. demiddeorayta lo gave ella mizzibburit, dichtiv (Devarim 24) vehaish asher atta noshe vo yotzi elecha et haavot hachutza, veen darko shel adam lehotzi ella happachut shebbinchasav, umippene tikkun haolam amru baal chov bevenonit, kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin:
Uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit. delekka lemechash bah linilat delet. deyoter mimma shehaish rotze lissa, ishsha rotza lehinnase:
Rabbi meir omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Romez venirmaz. ma shehu romez o sheacherim romzim lo venitratztza, hakkol kayyam. remiza, beyadav uverosho. kefitza, akimat sefatayim, shenneemar (Iyov 5) kaftza piha. veeno siman nikkar kemo remiza:
Bemittaltelin. im machar mittaltelin. veen halacha keven betera:
Happaotot. hakketannim keven sheva keven shemone im hu charif veyodea betiv massa umattan, o keven tesha uven eser im eno charif kol kach:
Mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar bemittaltelin. umattenatan mattana. echad mattenat bari, veechad mattenat shechiv mera. echad mattana merubba, veechad mattana muetet:
Tiltan. baaravi 47, uvelaaz 362:

Aval lo vaetz. af al pi shettaam etzo ufiryo shave en haetz mitztaref im happeri leesor yayin shel chullin, lefi sheen haetz kadosh bitruma. aval sheviit vechilayim vehekdesh af haetz asur. vehaetz shel tiltan bayyayin noten taam leshevach hu:
Ateret kira. binyan agol asuy al rosh hakkira chede lishmor chummah:
Tehora. veim nitmet hakkira lo nitmet haateret, dela chashiva ateret chibbur lakkira:
Tirat hattannur. chatzar hattannur, leshon bachatzerehem uvetirotam. makom lifne hattannur mukkaf mechitztzot shennotnim bo hallechem kesherodin oto min hattannur:
Bizman shehi gevoha arbaa. keshiur gavho shel tannur shettechillato arbaa:
Afillu al shalosh avanim. shello hayta mechubberet chibbur yafe ella munnachat al shalosh avanim bilvad udevukka lattannur, chashiva chibbur:
Bet happach. makom asuy betzidde hakkira shemmannichin bo pach shemen lehafeshir:
Bet hattevalin. makom shemmannichin bo et hattevalin:
Bet hanner. makom shemmannichin bo hanner:

Mittammein bemagga. im naga sheretz betoch hakkira nitmeu hammekomot hallalu vetumat hakkira. vechen im nitma echad min hammekomot hallalu vemagga sheretz nitmet hakkira immahem, dachashive chechira vehem davar echad leinyan tumat magga:

Veen mittammein baavir. im nitla sheretz baavir kira velo naga bah, af al pi shehi temea, dichli cheres mittamme vaavir, hen tehorin, sheenam chibbur lah ella leinyan magga. mishshum demin hattora enam chibbur lah, verabbanan hu degazzur alayhu tuma, vaavadu rabbanan hekkera dela littammeu vaavir, ki hechi dela lisserfu alayhu teruma vekadashim:
Verabbi shimon metaher. afillu vemagga, kol makom shello naga vo tuma, dechol chad vechad keli veanpe nafsheh hu. vahalacha kerabbi meir:

Lihyot mafrish alehen mechelkan. kesheyyafrish hatteruma yimkerennah viakkev haddamim leatzmo bishvil chovo sheyyesh lo al hakkohen. umaaser rishon umaasar ani yeakkev veyochal bishvil hachov sheyyesh lo al hallevi veal heani, ella shemmafrish mimmaaser rishon terumat maaser lakkohen. veim hu ragil litten terumotav umaasrotav laze hakkohen o hallevi o heani shehilva lahen, en tzarich lezakkot lahem maasrotav uterumotav al yad acher, ella lokchan leatzmo miyyad achar sheyyafrishem. aval im ragil litten terumotav umaasrotav laacherim, eno yachol leakkevan bechovo ad sheyyezakke lahem al yede acher techilla, veachar kach yachazor veyittelem bechovo:

Tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshim. sheyyarshu mehem karka meshubedet levaal chov, tzarich littol mehem reshut im rotzim lifroa chov ze mitterumot umaasrot hallalu, deshemma rotzim hem likkach mattenotehen velifroa chov morisham mimmakom acher:

Tannur techillato arbaa. setam tannur asuy kemin kedera gedola sheen lah shulayim, umechabberim oto vetit al gabbe karka, veritzpat hakkarka hi tachtito shel tannur. veaf al pi shemmeatzmo en lo vet kibbul, af al pi chen tame, divtocho tala rachamana vahare yesh lo toch:
Techillato arbaa. en gavho shel tannur pachot mearbaa tefachim:
Usheyarav. im haya gadol venitma veachar kach nishbar, lo taher ad shello yihye vishvarav arbaa:
Bamme devarim amurim. ditchillato usheyarav arbaa:
Begadol. heasuy leefot velitzlot bo chederech hattannurim:
Aval bekatan. heasuy letinokot letzachek bo:
Techillato kol shehu. velav davka chol shehu, divtzir mittefach lo have:

Usheyarav berubbo. baggemara beferek haor veharotev [chullin daf 124] makshe al matnitin dehacha, uvetzir mittefach lemay chazi. umeshane, hay usheyarav berubbo aggadol kae, velo attannur katan. umotvinan, begadol, ha kaamar usheyarav arbaa, deha katane bamme devarim amurim begadol mashma delo felige chachamim al tanna kamma vegadol kelal. umeshane, ha vetannur bar shiva ha vetannur bar tisha, kelomar bar shiva sheyarav berubbo, veaf al pi dela havu arbaa veen tannur pachot mearbaa, hoil umittechillato haya cheli chashuv mishtammeshin bishyarav af al pi sheenan reuyin kol kach. uvetannur shel tisha derubbo have shiur gadol, metamme bishyarav bearbaa, kitchillato:
Mishshettiggamer melachto. attechillat tannur kae. meematay hattannur mittamme, mishshettiggamer melachto:

Mishsheyyassikennu. af al gav dishar kele cheres saggi lehu vetzeruf kivshan, tannur devae ledabbek bo tit leabboto lehachazik chummo lo nigmera melachto ad sheyyassikennu. umihu lo vae hessek gadol kede leefot bo fat, ella chede leefot bo sufganim, pat shebbelilatah rakka haasuya chisfog, divhessek muat saggi la:

Mishsheyyassik et hechadash kede leefot bayyashan. dechadash kede leefot bo sufganim bae hessek merubbe min hayyashan. veim hussak hechadash hessek muat divhessek kaze haya yashan rauy leefot bo sufganim, hayenu gemar melachto. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
En podin oto. vehu sheragil bechach. kegon shemmachar veshana veshillesh:
Lokeach umevi vikkurim. bechol shana tzarich likkach mehannachri bikkure feroteha bedamim, umevian lirushalayim:
Mippene tikkun haolam. shello yehe ragil limkor karka beeretz yisrael lenachrim. veim machar yitrach lachzor velifdot:
Tappuach. shel teruma sherisseko unetano keshehu merussak vechatush letoch haissa vechimmetzah, hoil vechullin mechamat hatteruma nitchammetza, haissa asura lezarim:
Af al pi shehivishu. mechamat hasseorim shel teruma, memav muttarim:

Tannur shebba mechuttach. sheasao haumman dappim dappim kede lechabberan yachad al yede misgerot, hen zirim shekkorin 731, keen sheanu osim lechaviyyot shennotnim bahen yayin. uleotan zirim umisgerot kore hattanna limmudin:

Unetanan alav vehu tahor nitma. leachar shennatan alav hallimmudim vehaya hattannur tahor mittechilla lefi shehaya dappim dappim velo haya mechubbar, chazar lihyot mekabbel tuma al yede hallimmudim hallalu shemmechabberim oto:

Sillek et limmudav. venitparku haddappin ze mizze, en lecha netitza gedola mizzo, venithar hattannur. veaf al pi shehechezir hallimmudim paam sheniyya shuv eno mekabbel tuma, sheen hallimmudim meviin lo hattuma ella befaam rishona vilvad keshebba mechuttach mibbet haumman:
Mercho vetit. letannur ze sheen hallimmudim meviin lo hattuma, tame al yede merichat hattit.
Veen tzarich lehassiko. kishar kol tannurim sheen mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyassikem, lefi shekkevar hussak befaam rishona keshebba mechuttach mibbet haumman:

Batzal shennetano letoch adashim. [shel chullin], vehu haddin batzal shel teruma shennetano letoch adashim. [taut hammatik yesh kan vechach tzarich lomar, batzal shennetano letoch adashim. batzal shel teruma shennetano letoch adashim shel chullin], vehu haddin levatzal shel chullin shennetano letoch adashim shel teruma. umayre kegon shennetano baadashim achar bishshulo veyatzu mimmennu memav, sheaz en habbatzal keshehu shalem polet baadashim velo volea mehem. aval im nitbashshel habbatzal baadashim peshita deyahev uvala taama af keshehu shalem:
Benoten taam. detaem lehu kohen, shemmuttar bechullin uvitruma. i it behu taama ditruma hakkol asur lezarim, vei lo hakkol chullin keshehaya:
Ushear kol tavshil. kegon shum vekaflot, vechayyotze vahen:

Mattir betzachana. im natan batzal shel teruma betzachana, shehem dagim ketannim hakkevushot betzir, notel et habbatzal vehatztzachana muttar, uvilvad sheyyihye habbatzal shalem, shello nimmoach velo nitarev im hatztzachana. sheen habbatzal nittan letocho ella lehaavir zuhamat haddagim velo chede litten bo taam. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hakkalatut shel baale vattim. basis heasuy lechira, umekom moshavah nikra kelet:
Shennifchata. karkaitah. vehaya omek happechat pachot mishshelosha tefachim, hare hakkira mekabbelet tuma, sheim yassik bappechat millematta titbashshel hakkedera shebbakkira millemala:
Yater mikkan. im haya happechat amukka yoter mishshelosha tefachim:
Tehora. shehare haesh rechoka min hakkedera shebbakkira veenah mitbashshelet:
Natan even o tzeror. al mekom happechat kede shello yihye omek happechat shelosha tefachim, tehora, lefi sheenah chashuva mikkarkait hakkira:
Merchah. leeven zo betit:
Mekabbelet tuma. hakkira, mikkan ulehabba. sheeven zo mikkarkait hakkira hi nechshevet, vahare en omek happechat shelosha tefachim:
Vezo hi teshuvat rabbi yehuda. keshennechleku rabbi yehuda vachachamim leel beferek tannur techillato arbaa:
Betannur shennetano al pi habbor o al pi haddut. mikkan hevi rabbi yehuda reaya lidvarav, dechi hechi devainan hacha sheyyehe massik millematta ukedera beshela millemala, hachi nammi vainan hatam:

Hacheres sheeno yachol laamod. kegon cheres happoresh min hechavit umin hakkedera bimkom haozen, veeno yachol laamod belo semicha mippene choved haozen shemmachbid umachrio, o mippene shehaya bo chiddud shehu chad betachtito veeno yachol lashevet shello mesummach:
Nittela haozen tahor. dichli cheres kevan shettahar shaa achat shuv en lo tuma leolam:
Verabbi yehuda metamme. delet leh hach sevara:
O shennechleka. learkah kemin shete arevot, veenah yechola leshev al tachteha ella al dafnoteha:

Rabbi yehuda metaher. desavar rabbi yehuda deha ditnan haddakkim shebbichle cheres yoshvim shello mesummachim shehen temeim, hayenu min hashshulayim velo min haddefanot, shetztzarich sheyyihye shever hakkeli yoshev al shulav kederech sheyyoshev keshehu shalem:
Vachachamim metammein. desavre chelim asuyin lehoshivan al dafnotehen lifrakim:
Bidme teruma. degiddule teruma asurim lezarim:
Lo yelakketu ella aniyye chohanim. dechayshinan addimlakkete leh shadu lefumayhu:
Im ken lo yelakketu ella tehorim. deha kohen tame asur bitruma. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Chavit shennikkeva. bemotzi zayit, vetahara, keshechazar vaasaah bezefet, mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba:

Chazra venishbera. lishvarim harebe. veoto hashshever sheyyesh bo hazzefet machazik reviit veyoshev shello mesummach, tame. uvechavit hammachzeket millog vead sea askinan, keditnan befirkin dilel millog vead sea birviit. veaf al pi sheen setima moelet lenekev habba leachar shevira, shane hach setima, shennaaset kodem shebbatal shem keli mimmenna. dechavit shennikkeva shem chavit aleha af al pi shettahara, aval cheres happoresh min hechavit batal shem keli mealav af al pi shello nikkav, lefichach en moelet setima vannekev shello:

En motziin laachilat perot uleshevach karkaot. haggozel sade umecharah leacher, uzeraah vetzamcha veasa perot, uva nigzal ugevaah im peroteha min hallokeach, eno meshallem lallokeach ki im hayyetzia, vechozer hallokeach al hammocher vegove deme hakkarka minnechasim meshubadim, shehare mecharah lo beacharayut vechatav lo shetar mechira vahare hi milve vishtar, veet happerot minnechasim bene chorin velo mimmeshubadim:
Vechen leshevach karkaot. im hishbichah hallokeach bintiat hailanot o bezevel vechayyotze vaze:

Velimzon haishsha vehabbanot. ditnay ketubba hu, veat tehe yatva beveti umittezna minnechasay, uvenan nukevin diyhavyan lichi minnai yehavyan yatvin beveti umitteznin minnechasay vechulei, keshebbaot ligbot mezonotehen en govim ella minnechasim bene chorin velo mimmeshubadim:
Mippene tikkun haolam. shehem devarim sheen lahem kitzva velo yeda kamma hem velo matze mizdaher:
Vehammotze metzia. vehechzirah, vehabbealim omrim shello hechzir kullah:
Lo yishshava mippene tikkun haolam. sheim atta omer yishshava, en lecha adam shemmetappel bimtzia lehachezirah:
Hamenakkesh. tolesh asavim raim haggedelim betoch hattevua vehayerakot:
Bachasiyyot. kegon hashshum vehalluf vehabbetzalim vehakkarti, kol ellu nikraim chasiyyot:

Af al pi shepperotav. shel oved kochavim tevel, desavar hay tanna en kinyan leoved kochavim beeretz yisrael lehafekia min hammaaser, vegiddule tevel tevel bedavar sheen zaro chale, afillu hachi ochel mehen aray:

Shetile teruma. kegon shetile cheruv uteradin: shennitmeu ushetalan taharu milletamme. dechevan shennitchabberu lakkarka nitbattelu mittorat ochel. veim tomar kevan deikkar gezera giddule teruma kitruma enah ella mishshum teruma temea beyad kohen, dilma mashhe la gabbeh veate lide takkala, akkatti kevan detaharu mashhe la gabbeh. veyesh lomar ditruma nimkeret bezol harebe lefi sheenah reuya ella lechohanim tehorim veim nitmet teuna serefa, hilkach afillu im hayu notnim lakkohen teruma kede lezarah lo haya (mevattel) [mafsid] sadehu, aval im hayu haggiddulin chullin haya mashhe teruma temea kede lezarah:
Vaasurim leechol. maala bealma hi:
Ad sheyyagom haochel. yachtoch kol harauy laachila, uma sheyyigdal achar kach yehe muttar:
Ad sheyyagom veyishne. sheyyachtoch ma sheggadal gam bappaam hashsheniyya, uma sheyyigdal mishsheni veelach yihye muttar. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kol hannichbashim ze im ze. yarkot chullin shennichbeshu im yerakot shel teruma, en hatteruma oseret et hachullin:

Chutz min hachasit. shum veluf uvatzal vecharti keruyim chasit, deaggav chorfayhu yehave taama bechol mide denichbashin immahen. ucheshehen shel teruma osrim ben yarak ben chasit shel chullin. ushear yerakot shel teruma enan osrim keshehen nichbashim, aval mevushshalim o nishlakim osrim:
